I’m asking you to chip in $3 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?] to help me defend one of the most competitive House seats in the country.

They know this is one of the most competitive seats in the country – that’s why national election analysts just moved this race to "Toss-up."
They also know control of the House hinges on the outcome of our race.

I’m backed by working people chipping in what they can because they want someone in Congress who understands the challenges they're facing.
That's why your $3 matters.

* $3 helps us fight back against the flood of outside spending and attack ads that are already on the way.
And if enough people step up, even with just a few dollars, we'll have what it takes to win one of the closest races in the country.
So I'm asking: Can you chip in $3 right now to help us defend this seat and keep fighting for working families? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]

subject: 🗳️What's next for Dr. Annie Andrews Senate Campaign?
body:
📣Meet Annie at Miles with the Mayor this Saturday at 8am.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/51d4a853f813/kathryn-harvey-for-congresscampaign-kickoff-6427032?e=edbde6c9b1)

---
| |
# Life is so much bigger than politics.
---
| |
After the sudden passing of longtime Senator Lindsey Graham a rapid fire Republican Primary contest for his seat has begun. Yesterday, Governor McMaster announced the appointment of Darlene Graham, Lindsey’s sister, as the interim Senator to fill his seat through January 3, 2027. This turn of events has catapulted Dr. Andrews, our Democratic Nominee for Senate, into the spotlight. Listen to her message and read how her race in transforming.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/6oruo9PB_fI?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
| [Listen to Annie’s message](https://us.list-manage.com/_39Z6AwRitw?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/q6XkiGDQRWI?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
| |
# What this means for Dr. Andrews campaign
---
| |
**You can’t gerrymander an entire state.** South Carolina isn’t a red or blue state - it’s a non-voting state. We already know the majority of independents in South Carolina are looking for something else to vote for other than Republicans who are hitching themselves to Trump and his agenda. And boy, do we have a ballot full of options. Dr. Andrews and our other statewide candidates also have the energy of 124 house candidates pulling votes from every district in SC to the top of the ticket.
**And nevermind that she is the most disciplined candidate I’ve ever worked with.**
Her core message doesn’t change. She’s been focusing on key issues that impact the majority of South Carolinians (like healthcare) since day one, and that’s what she’ll continue to do.
---
| |
-She will no longer be challenging a 20+ year incumbent.-She handily won the Democratic Primary with 61% of the vote.-She has considerable name recognition and money in the bank.-None of the potential Republican Challengers will come close to Lindsey’s name ID.-Republicans will have to spend a considerable amount of funds in the knock down drag out special election, and whomever comes limping out will have only two months to run.-She will continue to run a disciplined race that focuses on the needs of our state.\- This could be a perfect storm.
---
| |
# Come meet Annie this Saturday in Spartanburg at Miles with the Mayor 8am - 180 Magnolia St.
---
|
---
| |
# Here’s what comes next.
---
| |
-Filing period for US Senate Republican Primary**July 21 to July 28** -Early Voting **August 5-7** -Special statewide Republican primary election Tuesday, **August 11** -Republican Primary runoff Tuesday, **August 25** -General election voter registration deadline **October 4** -Early voting **October 19 - 30** -Election Day Tuesday, **November 3**
[**You can find information on all the candidates in August on the South Carolina Voter Guide.**](https://us.list-manage.com/15vLeBKLSId?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/4kh9Dfx6Ef2?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
| |
# Check out our latest pod on the SC Senate Race
---
| |
Lindsey Graham's sudden death has reshaped South Carolina politics overnight. We discuss what happens next, who could replace him in the U.S. Senate, how the special election process works, and why this moment could change the future of South Carolina politics. We also look at the Republican primary field, the implications for Annie Andrews' campaign, and what voters should expect in the months ahead. The race for Lindsey Graham's Senate seat is already underway, and the decisions made over the next few weeks could shape South Carolina politics for years to come.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/xD_AkarEUns?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
| |
# The election breakdown with Bakari Sellers
---
| |

Bakari Sellers joined me to break down the 2026 South Carolina elections, what the primary results revealed, and why building a competitive Democratic Party is a long term strategy rather than a single election cycle. We discuss the senate campaign, legislative races, fundraising, voter turnout, candidate recruitment, and what it will take to compete statewide over the next decade.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/1AL9qEhxD9N?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
|
---
| |
# Meet the Democratic women running in 2026 on Aug 20!
---
| | If you live in Spartanburg County you’ll have women to vote for on your ballot from County Council to the US Senate. Join us on Thursday, August 20th at Party Headquarters to meet these trailblazers, learn about their campaigns, and how you can best support them. Tickets will go on sale next week. This event is hosted by the Spartanburg County Democratic Party and proceeds will benefit our Get Out The Vote efforts in 2026.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/159egbxMUfV?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
|
---
|
---
| |
**The SC Legislature failed to pass a budget. That’s it. That’s the whole post.**
Fourteen days without a state budget. That's unacceptable. Republicans control South Carolina's government, and they have no excuses. After decades of one-party rule, they still failed to do one of their most basic jobs. South Carolinians deserve leaders who will put our state first.
---

* **Aug 3** SPCDP Meeting 6pm TK Gregg Center: Youth Voices Panel
* **Aug 3** Spartanburg County Delegation Meeting 5:30pm
* **Aug 20** Meet the Dem Women Running for Office in Spartanburg 6pm Party HQ
* **Aug 27** Pacolet Town Hall with Lekesa Whitner and Courtney McClain
* **Sept 14** SPCDP Meeting: Dr. Jermaine Johnson for Governor

Democracy is a participatory sport y’all, but sometimes you need a rest. Stay with me!

name: Rob Bonta
subject: re: Trump’s Justice Department
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROB BONTA FOR CALIFORNIA ATTORNEY GENERAL 2026 FPPC ID #145642
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
This week, I led a coalition of 12 state Attorneys General in taking Paramount and Warner Bros. to court to stop their unlawful merger.
Here’s the bottom line: monopolies give too much power to too few people . That’s why we have antitrust laws like the Clayton Act, which has been on the books for more than a century to prevent this exact situation — and which this proposed merger violates.
If you need proof that antitrust enforcement works, just look at California: We are the fourth largest economy in the world AND we have some of the strongest antitrust and consumer protection laws on the books. That’s no coincidence.
Antitrust enforcement is good for the economy, good for consumers, and good for businesses that play by the rules.
So if all of this is true, why is Trump’s Justice Department allowing this massive merger to continue?

It’s a check on billionaires currying favor with the President so he’ll do their bidding and hand-pick winners and losers, bypassing both the law and the meritocracy that makes our economy thrive.

Every time I'm out in the community, I'm reminded why this campaign exists. These conversations in coffee shops, on sidewalks, and in parking lots are not photo ops. They are the work. They are how you build trust, understand what people are dealing with, and earn the right to represent them.

Too much of what we see in Washington is performance. Viral posts, culture war stunts, and constant outrage distract from the fact that everyday problems are not getting solved. While politicians chase attention, families are struggling with rising costs, healthcare access is shrinking, veterans are falling through the cracks, and communities are being pitted against one another.
### **How Do We Beat the Circus?**
One word: **TOGETHER. I 'm running for Congress to get our families a seat at the table. [Are you in?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4d103f7d-90c0-47f0-b588-5105cdf5eaee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---
[JOIN MIKE'S MISSION!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4d103f7d-90c0-47f0-b588-5105cdf5eaee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
My campaign is built around a simple idea. **Hometowns over Headlines.** I believe leadership starts by showing up, listening, and doing the unglamorous work of governing. Not yelling. Not posturing. Not turning public service into a spectacle. **I 'm going to serve our communities, and make sure MAGA bootlickers don't get in the way.**
The MAGA circus only works when people feel disconnected and powerless. The way we beat it is not with louder noise. **It is with stronger community.** Neighbors talking to neighbors, organizing locally, and refusing to let outrage politics define our future.
## **We need You.**
[ DONATE $15!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4d103f7d-90c0-47f0-b588-5105cdf5eaee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We are running a fully people powered campaign. No corporate money. No special interests. body:
Hello, apologies for the error in the email sent earlier tonight.
You can call Governor Shapiro at 717-787-2500 to ask him to end ICE collaboration in Pennsylvania.
---------- Forwarded message ---------
Date: Thu, Jul 16, 2026, 7:12 PM
Subject: Re: ICE murders again. This is not normal.
https://www.apipennsylvania.org [https://www.apipennsylvania.org]
Hi Peter,
[https://secure.everyaction.com/npIH-E4iR0aHxi8U2uZ5kQ2?contactdata=W36gHuv4KkMXaIFcb3xHZ53iCVp78uiKxacoOMhf1PvX20iLsTacAVjX+JtMMEZLTVVM2xdJ0kOGXApyjMuoUzB48atbMDGC2GnBUHVqciklV/I/ANSY3zR0IhXfJj/m1PYNOhSbAzRE/y/FPVxcpSiuFb9vWQzhNeF6RMPQtg4=]
[https://secure.everyaction.com/82Y1BXHF6Uiojy5pDtjPDw2?contactdata=W36gHuv4KkMXaIFcb3xHZ53iCVp78uiKxacoOMhf1PvX20iLsTacAVjX+JtMMEZLTVVM2xdJ0kOGXApyjMuoUzB48atbMDGC2GnBUHVqciklV/I/ANSY3zR0IhXfJj/m1PYNOhSbAzRE/y/FPVxcpSiuFb9vWQzhNeF6RMPQtg4=]
[https://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/local/vigil-at-philadelphia-city-hall-calls-for-ice-accountability/4433451/] This week, our communities gathered in rage and grief for vigils [https://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/local/vigil-at-philadelphia-city-hall-calls-for-ice-accountability/4433451/] in memory of two men shot and killed by ICE.
Lorenzo Salgado Araujo in Houston was on his way to work when he was murdered. In Maine, ICE agents killed Joan Sebastian Guerrero with his three year old daughter in the backseat. Both were long-time, legal residents in their communities. Nobody’s suspected citizenship status should determine if they live or die. Yet, we have seen over half a dozen murdered by ICE, and 22 dead under ICE’s watch in inhumane detention facilities this year.
This is not normal. But this is the case if we continue to let ICE’s recklessness and violence run amok. Our communities, our neighborhoods, and our streets are not safe as long as ICE remains unchecked.
Right now, millions of Americans live in towns and counties that permit the local government to collaborate with ICE — including neighborhoods across Pennsylvania. We don’t want our local and state resources going to help an out-of-control agency target, harass, and attack our neighbors.
We’re calling on our leaders to be accountable to the communities they serve: Give Governor Shapiro a call at 717-287-2500 to ask him to end ICE collaboration in Pennsylvania. We deserve to live and thrive free from fear and harassment from ICE.
We’re standing in solidarity with communities in Texas and in Maine. We’re mourning with them, and we’re taking action with them on behalf of our neighbors and loved ones. We keep each other safe — and that starts with kicking ICE off our streets.
[https://secure.everyaction.com/npIH-E4iR0aHxi8U2uZ5kQ2?contactdata=W36gHuv4KkMXaIFcb3xHZ53iCVp78uiKxacoOMhf1PvX20iLsTacAVjX+JtMMEZLTVVM2xdJ0kOGXApyjMuoUzB48atbMDGC2GnBUHVqciklV/I/ANSY3zR0IhXfJj/m1PYNOhSbAzRE/y/FPVxcpSiuFb9vWQzhNeF6RMPQtg4=]

In solidarity,
Mohan Seshadri

[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/16nbkMiMX0F?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | | The Pentagon is about to check every soldier over 30 for testosterone. Pete Hegseth announced it Wednesday, branded it the "High-T Department of War," and [Mark spent the hour with Victory News' Mike Garofalo](https://us.list-manage.com/EEJy4hSYQnY?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) sorting out whether it's brilliant or nuts.
Meanwhile, a parasite outbreak has spread across 34 states.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/pcR15nIQebo?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | 💪 **THE "HIGH-T DEPARTMENT OF WAR" IS OFFICIAL**
Screening is mandatory over 30, optional under. Come up low and replacement therapy is on the table, though that part stays the soldier's call.
Mike covers this beat every day, and he thinks it might be Hegseth's best idea yet. Mark dug up a prescription stat buried in Pentagon records that explains why this was even on someone's radar.
We're not printing that number here. You'll want to hear Mark read it out loud.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/f5ms72f1XLK?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | 🦠 **THE OUTBREAK THAT FOUND THE RONCHETTIS**
The CDC is probing Taco Bell's lettuce for its role in all this. Sounds like somebody else's headline, right up until you hear where it showed up.
Ava's at a debate camp in Michigan. That's the hardest-hit state in the country. What she texted Mark and Krysty late one night, you need to hear for yourself.
**And Mike has a confession about his flight home from DC. Braver man than most.

** ⚖️ **A BULLETPROOF VEST IN A JUSTICE'S BEDROOM**
Amy Coney Barrett told Congress her security detail sent her home with a bulletproof vest during the Dobbs leak. Her 12-year-old son found it, and what he asked her stopped the room cold.
Then came the swatting at her home six weeks ago. One thing kept that morning from going very, very wrong.
Mark also pulls up a chart about Barrett's voting since Dobbs that's making the rounds. He won't tell you what to conclude. But you should see it.
---
| [WATCH NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/vQkVfWpFxbI?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | 🏔️ **THE MARK VS. THE MOUNTAIN SEASON FINALE IS HERE**
Seven episodes, one house at 11,000 feet, and it all comes down to this. There's a disaster right before the finish line, and then the reveal you've been waiting all season for.
Krysty designed every inch of the inside, and you finally get to see it.
Watch it on Pure Flix or Great American, or catch the whole season on Prime Video. Every view gets us closer to season two.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/fhpXLsfhw6D?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
|

Come see us in person! We're hosting the Republican Party of New Mexico's biggest night of the year — a black-tie dinner celebrating America's 250th, Saturday, July 25 at Isleta Resort & Casino.
You'll hear from gubernatorial nominee Gregg Hull, plus a keynote from Nick Shirley, the independent journalist whose undercover investigations have been making national news all year. It's going to be a fun night, and we'd love to see you there.

name: Mary Peltola
subject: First poll showing us down
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
We need to respond.
There have been six polls in the six months since I launched this campaign for Alaska’s U.S. Senate seat. We were leading in the first five.
Then, after my opponent and the billionaires and super PACs that back him started spending millions on attack ads against me, **the New York Times/Siena University poll released this month shows us down two points.**
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260716-2.buQBWq&refcode=em20260716-3555&t=1&akid=3555%2E21716%2ENliYAU)
We need your help to respond.
Election forecasters like Cook Political Report, Sabato’s Crystal Ball, Split Ticket, and VoteHub have all called Alaska’s U.S. Senate race a toss-up.
They shifted the race in our favor because they know we can win, and that all eyes are on Alaska this year in what’s shaping up to be the most competitive and consequential race on the Senate map.
They know we can win because Alaskans are fed up with the rigged system that’s pricing us out and threatening our way of life while DC politicians and their donors make themselves richer.
They know we can win because my opponent, Dan Sullivan, is the least popular senator up for reelection, and Alaskans want someone who will fight for their healthcare, jobs, disaster relief, and public media – not gut them.
They know we can win because I’ve won Alaska statewide – _twice_ – against our former governor Sarah Palin, and now we’re building a movement that’s ready to take on the rigged DC system so we can lower costs, save our fisheries, and bring abundance back to our state.
**They know we can win this toss-up Senate race if we can raise the resources needed to overcome the attack ads and get our message out.**
Our fight for fish, family, and freedom resonates in every region of our big, beautiful state – _and in a state as big as Texas, Montana, and California combined, that’s a pretty broad coalition!_
We’re criss-crossing as much of Alaska’s 586,000 square miles as we can to bring every village and every voter into our campaign, and we’re doing all we can to fight back with ads online and on the airwaves.
But this is without a doubt the most expensive state on the map to run a Senate campaign. To win in Alaska means building a strong ground game and winning the screen war – reaching communities on and off the road system, from the Aleutians to Anchorage to the Arctic.
No one ever said flipping Alaska’s Senate seat was going to be easy. But we do know that this is our best chance to do it.
**I know we can pull this off, and here’s why:** If everyone getting this email split a donation between Sarah McBride and my campaign, we’d have enough to match the tens of millions in outside spending from the billionaire-backed super PACs propping up my unpopular opponent.
**[Split a donation today »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260716-2.buQBWq&refcode=em20260716-3555&t=2&akid=3555%2E21716%2ENliYAU)**
That’s the power of a grassroots movement. We can win this when we all chip in together.
But not everyone will read this or give today, and that’s okay. But that’s why it’s all the more important that you do. You’ve already made it this far, and I really appreciate it.
Your support makes a huge difference. I’m humbled to have you with me in this campaign for Alaska’s toss-up Senate seat, and even more so in this fight for fish, family, and freedom. 🐟❤️🇺🇸
Let’s go win.
\- Mary
* * *
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/receive_fewer_emails/?t=3&akid=3555%2E21716%2ENliYAU)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/update_your_information/?t=4&akid=3555%2E21716%2ENliYAU)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=5&akid=3555%2E21716%2ENliYAU)

Email us: [info@sarahmcbride.com](mailto:info@sarahmcbride.com)

body:
There’s been a lot of speculation about what Trump will say in his speech tonight.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260716-2&t=1&akid=3736%2E587540%2EXo16fr)
Peter,
In a couple hours, Trump will take the stage in Georgia for a speech in which he promises to reveal “really big news” on election security.
But we know what this speech is really about — a way for him to do whatever it takes to distract, divide, and keep people from focusing on what really matters in this moment.
We don’t know exactly what he’ll say tonight, but we can bet that he’ll spread more irresponsible, conspiratorial lies about the security of America’s electoral system. Because when someone like Donald Trump is afraid they’re about to lose, their last resort is to call the whole game into question.
But honestly? Regardless of what Trump says, our mission stays the same. We can’t afford to lose focus or fall into despair while he manufactures chaos in the final months before the midterms.
**So tonight, I’ll be thinking about two things:**
🔴 Defeating Republicans in red-to-blue races to break the GOP’s grip on power in state legislatures and in Congress — with our candidates like **Randy Villegas** (CA-22), **Tim Hayes** (PA-HD-143), **Trevor Jung** (WI-SD-21), and **Kristian Carranza** (TX-HD-118).
🔵 Primarying asleep-at-the-wheel Democrats by backing young, bold progressives who will meet this moment with the energy and fight it demands — with our candidates like **Patrick Roath** (MA-08), **Donovan McKinney** (MI-13), and **Mai Vang** (CA-07).
That’s the work. That’s always been the work. And no speech, no matter how loud it is, changes that.

name: Tim,  Team Lanier
subject: I'm Tim Lanier and I need you to read this
body:
| | | Hi Friend,
I encourage each of you to keep fighting the good fight. The next few months can define the future of our party in this State and I'm tired of going 0-fer at the ballot box.
I've focused my campaign on building deep roots with county parties, state candidates and the down ballot candidates. I've done so particularly in counties that are underperforming or need a little help.
Recently, I've spent my time in your counties talking about how WE win, now and especially later. I've spent my time actively signing people up to run for county offices and I've promised to be their first campaign manager.
For Bledsoe, Sequatchie, Marion, and Cannon y'all know this because I've gotten Dems committed to run in the next election cycle in front of you. I've followed up with most of them (13 so far!!) and I'll make sure they're ready to go when the time comes. Right now is the best time to think and recruit talent for the next election, even if nobody else is doing it. I'll get these people involved in the general election to learn the ropes.
I'm also trying to SHOW what real leadership should look like. It's not stump speeches and $, it's getting people excited then getting them organized. It's taking action on their behalf.
That's why I'm the best Dem candidate in our field of 5, plus my work ethic and moral compass. I'd like to be our first nominee to the US House in the new 4th district. I won't let you down. It will be much easier to recruit and organize the people of the 4th if I'm the candidate. But I will continue my mission either way, the fight is too important.
I ask that you forward this to your people. Forward to the brass at the TNDP and anyone you think can understand and support me. If we keep focusing all our efforts on winning now, we'll never win later.
To anyone reading this, please research what position you can run for in the next election cycle. My name is Tim Lanier and I'm here to help. Reach out via the links below. I'm also asking for your vote starting Friday July 17th. I'm 4th on the Democratic ballot and I will make tomorrow a little better than today.
💙 Love y'all, Tim

Friend, Donald Trump just delivered a primetime address to the nation, where he peddled conspiracy theories about voting in America, just as he has peddled lies about our elections here in Georgia for years.

Peter,

In just a moment, we are going to ask you to fund our ballot chasers in Arizona. Please give us a chance to explain why this request – _especially today_ – is so important.

Here is the truth:

Arizona's primary election is July 21st. Early voting is already underway, and every single day between now and then matters. _We have to get our ballot chasers in front of voters right now, while there's still time to make a difference_.

Now here is why this actually matters:

**Arizona isn't just another swing state. It's the single most important state on the map.** The state carries 11 electoral votes, soon to be 12, and without winning it, most of the realistic paths to the White House disappear. If Arizona doesn't hold, the odds of keeping America First in power collapse with it.

That's not a talking point. That's math.

Winning Arizona now doesn't just decide one election. It protects Republican pathways in 2028 and beyond, and it's the difference between building on President Trump's mandate or watching it get erased.

But we need to fund the ballot chasers who make it happen. Right now.

Every $50 we raise sponsors a ballot chaser for a single day in the field – knocking on doors, building real relationships, and chasing every ballot before July 21st.

Contribute $50 to make sure the radical left does not steal the election.

Contribute $50 because every dollar goes directly to boots on the ground in Arizona – not consultants, not TV ads.

I expect a lot of talk will be centered around drugs pouring through their community as they are smack-dab in the middle of one of the largest routes for international drug trafficking routes in North America.
Just over the last month and a half, authorities have seized more than [130 pounds of cocaine](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kvRjO6YmWfLNQVVODcbm3uvdVFDRd3_oQ87cgOv8drPXNroKhNoSmwlh4bZO-puQce3YrFOx-0QNcm3k1GhOjWaUSt-d5SXgNF9QwVcHw7ndKzHCzKDdgWyd5S0bJzgJvtYtzg7S8NwPjrHlRIv2EVCnY5BHBfqlkESpi0dMV6MVaXuS88IDbNr_celwe82ciBT_URBekp7ZplGupo_OzX8S6zQa1pvfA-sfh015NlkRyVcT9JgdnevPt-dSvpiVx6KhhBgo2bIfs5aZmEOXAd4yuQo_lE9bwvoR18HxUXf9AZYj_wRXcFEDkTrkGkKT&c=hXHjdMc-4FOwMG-2IYTEhPqPS-89IzbXwa-5QvfXzhbYHbJWrMdMNA==&ch=ImBZN7-f7VOFb24oonRkIZ1SeEfY8wh2UN0IeJXfMxaQYsuHjHmZqQ==) from a commercial truck and [45 pounds of poppy pods](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kvRjO6YmWfLNQVVODcbm3uvdVFDRd3_oQ87cgOv8drPXNroKhNoSmwlh4bZO-puQ4qt6YYGQJPluB_U7q2oX25g5bNxAmKPwTc0sqddtN_jFDVxBeMHoyuvixfyI-ssCrPfa3UTeu5Huyuz0Wf0nMD4eUUjwDnh6dm_hFRT2e8QjG50ug4mPHGvdjSg5Evd0dhmtOLxEE_4dMigNHl5N4MABW23LewKkdtnzIOvdW-ZYcHL-4K5Z6fefR6Mkig8LAcbgpVVeHCjtzIut_NJyQ_1EqZQPckDWAl9Lp8WOvMs=&c=hXHjdMc-4FOwMG-2IYTEhPqPS-89IzbXwa-5QvfXzhbYHbJWrMdMNA==&ch=ImBZN7-f7VOFb24oonRkIZ1SeEfY8wh2UN0IeJXfMxaQYsuHjHmZqQ==) from a commercial vehicle in St. Clair County. Earlier this year, Canadian officials busted a truck coming from Michigan that was attempting to smuggle nearly[ 600 pounds of meth](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kvRjO6YmWfLNQVVODcbm3uvdVFDRd3_oQ87cgOv8drPXNroKhNoSmwlh4bZO-puQaWgafo2Bu6YAp70evTWHivJeLmBBz_tJExk7Kj0bMQXzMMmr6nNxDqzwCbG2To5zsO-sAf4G9T_ltQhG-ES_JHJ5BjnO10_Z2Gug-K4xLcc6qPG7ScB6Va6JEgvCYLawTMcQK5cAEnPoUY-w2078LmlTmWLt81yW2fI7xKebex7PAOYQIfhvvum-Icu6fHDoiXfPV2tmO7BM-euXKPYhCA==&c=hXHjdMc-4FOwMG-2IYTEhPqPS-89IzbXwa-5QvfXzhbYHbJWrMdMNA==&ch=ImBZN7-f7VOFb24oonRkIZ1SeEfY8wh2UN0IeJXfMxaQYsuHjHmZqQ==) across their border on the Blue Water Bridge.
Our next Attorney General must have the experience and commitment to end the drug trafficking trade.
I started my public service in Jackson County where I worked my way up to Chief Trial Attorney in the Drug and Arson Unit, handling complex and often dangerous cases that directly impacted public safety.
I returned home to Eaton County a few years later to serve in its prosecutor's office as a drug prosecutor. While I was in that role, I prosecuted a case involving the first major meth lab in mid Michigan.
As Eaton County Prosecutor, I am more passionate about getting these poisons off our streets and getting Michiganders hooked on them clean and sober. We have continued to prosecute large-scale drug trafficking cases and I was appointed by the Senate Majority Leader and the Speaker of the House to fill a vacancy on the State Drug Treatment Court Advisory Committee.
We need an Attorney General who understands the scope of our drug trafficking crisis and will work with local, state, and federal law enforcement officials to end it.
I am that candidate for Attorney General. My opponent, on the other hand, has gone a different route as the Washtenaw County Prosecutor. Upon taking office, Eli Savit immediately decriminalized drugs and refused to charge people found to have contraband or illegal substances on them during routine traffic stops.
He legalized things like psychedelic mushrooms, which has led to people opening businesses to sell them in storefronts in his county.
Port Huron and St. Clair County don't need someone who will turn a blind eye to drug trafficking. They need someone who will partner with them to stop it and prosecute organizations that are smuggling narcotics through their community. I will be that partner as Attorney General and I look forward to hearing what law enforcement will need from me when we speak later today.
Sincerely,
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecutor Republican Nominee for Attorney General

## Trump Declassifies Election Intel Files
President Donald Trump used a [primetime White House address](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFurDAQxvHTQGdkGx5mCxevodu0KZGxxzDJYCPbC9nbR6yUXCD1SH_N73u_T3eDhGF5Mxvo4uMU4MwEpUCaSnpsuwNLJmf0kIHAFowBJ8llz7hiQk3OID2nrnbaA0hoa9BCDZ0c5CBEvepeOeVmI8G2hs9-9t6LbrBCSj8MppU16qvGlVCC8_4fb1rrbrzl4E3bdzcjq46DwxJT8xExlBU8PeMBqbFxq0mvpey5av9XcqzkeJ5n4-PXpbjulRz3SFjQ5kqOLxBLQGAyZPZLQ3DsB8cwFCDCBYIFls0zswQHGMosr9F-YljY8aAAycx4lSHXSbv9RCLMvao6vmwG6fVd-dOkh5bfAQAA__9--pDi) on Thursday to announce the declassification of intelligence on foreign threats to U.S. elections, four months before the midterms. Trump said the documents, posted to the White House website during the speech, reveal "shocking vulnerabilities" tied to hacking, exploitation, and foreign interference. He charged that China illegally obtained [220 million voter files](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQhZ8Gd0Qw_sEuKLZxl223tCYwxKywsWDiKG9_5bzC7Y50pE_nO__uyx1jivvzL25kOeRlp3dNxExl4fLaDk8uYa0xUKVEjmPe4wIKBqmM1GbxGNNn6RpvAxFQ25DVZuxghFHrZrX9pMCFse_DFMi5EZXuwKhHGCZ6YOebaC-aMtpopYZe3VrnJ9UqCtgO3YQgOkU-ci63_znuvFJIn3xSubm8NcmuzEcV7R8Bs4B5_xy58lUJmC-wgFkZAbO-0qvKy0_A_HWThU7CVKVb446yck4kz8xUZKFnrFzw8pUeGWUoeZMAapO4UYkO94vTFOuPd0wp1sGITj03jOm7jH9152nhJwAA__-r_Ina) beginning in 2020, including names, addresses, voting history, and party affiliation. A White House official said the materials do not allege votes were changed or machines hacked in 2020, and Beijing denied any interference. Trump called on the director of national intelligence, the Department of Justice, the FBI and the CIA to launch an investigation and press criminal charges against those involved. ABC and NBC [declined to carry](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO6yAQheGnwZ2jYbCNXVDcxl1uu6XFwhDPLgYL2ER5-1XyClsf6ZPO_3HdrpYjp9t_e5BpIW-JHjVSa1S2Vn6O05OLtlYOVCmSa5wTbwg49aB7qTdvOT63ofMmECGpjozU84AzzlJ2uwEdlmWcPudRumUG5aYAg5okEc4LAHVsXhpoqSXANMJFOb-AAgpWTcNiUQxAnlsul6_Mqe0U4jPfqVxcPrpo9tbOKtQ_gavAte20c4yvTeB6kGcrcB0XrRSOfaL2yOW79im33tlSnpxu_ftnX08itwtcu2L8-eAYuU5aDHA7LL_Brv2p0N3gbwAAAP__XxF5tw) the address live on their broadcast networks, opting to stream it instead, while CNN said it would monitor the speech and run a live feed online.
## Iran Warns of 'Red Line' as US Ramps Up Attacks
Iran declared that the Strait of Hormuz was [an inviolable "red line"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL_GdHuyFw6OwkUaukubEhm8HBsZG9l7hy5fH5FfSDfSjJ5m5us-3h0Hjo9Pt5GVJY2RjhJIhPIo-bntnubgSuGFCgWahVPkETW2oDsw3egdh_fYVN4uREh1RdZ0twZveDOmWq1x16Y2_dz7fqqNnvy1nSbXtKhnaqdpqdieNN2ZzmjdXvWlnn2va02Lq9umd6gaTZ4l5ct34igrLeGdXpQvc9qqYFeRvaj6Q-GgcIjvPRU5LYXDCVY46E7hYE51pBw8nBMVDpxdhMPlWKBIdiyQFlhT3p4_wAUcZPIQOBK46OHgECBT4SLwjMIBZCWg6BUOVbZ-PwNc2k41-rE5Dn_15F-fviz-BgAA__8rR4tx) on Thursday, warning it will "resist until the end" and strike infrastructure across the Gulf region if President Trump attacks Iranian power plants and bridges. The exchange follows a fifth consecutive night of [U.S. strikes targeting Iranian missile sites,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFupDAURb_GdB6ZBwNMQbENXbbdEr3Y18NbGRvZzpD8_YrsJ6S9Oro6On_e1jeWIPH5m3fM1ac14iwBtSKvNX_sh4MNXIp4FATYKinKSoYGbUbdjqtjCV9r37jZA4SuwdyOU08TTW3bbDP1Le40sqW-I7aeYWCngcHeeGfRyHy9mbEdW2OGu7l11j1MZ-C5G_oHk-oNnNSUb3-TxLrBh6_0Qr7ZtDdh3mo9iup-KVoULed53k4um8RnTRGfvEv8jypavl11itrBIxYoWvrhbh7jpGj5KPo97e8Sn1oyR72BX4JSdeYKXSRa6JOzDuB4QTWdnJ3G58HRXUM6kPnqUxQtTZ7dcUoIUoZR9ea5s4Rv4_qjzK-Z_gUAAP__xjKVxQ) coastal defenses, and command centers as U.S. Central Command ramped up its air campaign to the heaviest rate since the start of the war. Iran has also [lashed out at U.S. allies](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFygzAQRL8GOjHiwBIuVKShc9qUzFk6mUsEYiRhxvn6DP6F1G92Z99-3aYbcuD18YkLmeLjtNKRA5VCaSppXzZHNmDO7ClTIFs4rjyBBCWkFq2eHHJ4TX3tjCcC6moyrR56GGBo23o2ji6OrJYDtspir-QAoK-9VwCOuruv2ZxtUre6lVJdZNNZd5WdJI-d6q8IVS_JcYmp-Y68lpl8eMUnpcbGpQ5mLmXLVfdRwVjBeBxHY-_5tDh5BWPgJ4l9c1goVzBywlXsWRyYxFtQ5JKQi4hezDEt-6_YKGXGVTz24E_KP-9knYzbDg6Bs9JVLx8LcniPKP967mngLwAA__9YGIU6), with Kuwait, Bahrain, and Jordan reporting incoming Iranian missile and drone attacks. Tehran's top negotiator, Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, called it "an essential and existential war with America." ## House Sets Cash-Rounding Rules for Stores

House Sets Cash-Rounding Rules for Stores The House passed what it called "the Common Cents Act" by voice vote, setting to the nearest nickel and legally ending penny production in the U.S. Under the new bill, if an amount has 1, 2, 6, or 7 as the last cent digit, it can generally the nearest nickel. On the other hand, if an amount ends with 3, 4, 8, or 9 as the last cent digit, it can be rounded up. The legislation also authorizes the Treasury to test a redesigned, lower-cost nickel made with zinc instead of the current copper-heavy alloy. Currently, every 5-cent nickel cost nearly 14 cents to produce last year, and the U.S. Mint lost roughly $18 million on nickel production alone. ## At Least 1 Dead in Hill Country Flooding
At least [two people died](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAMhp8mdEFJFghTpLiGbq-9EnmIA9EFgmKz7Lz9KXOPsJUt2f5_f_-fz_kTYorH-ht2dPwd8nzgTQmZscxbTGnJ18HlFVLOnu54rMT5nI0yg1RWajt7iOk1d413T-UfukGn7diZcdDaNpszIahn6JUfDBoPD9_33WNUAaDrDX7oJroqpqy2Wivd963Bxftx8RjsU4MH0Sn0kXNpeUPGb6CQXvkLS7vkvUluYz5JfPwSZhJmuu-7_UvAdSjMVGlqAY75gCTMVN2EmZQVZtK1e0vKN2A8VklXWZFkKHmX27WiLBAP4lx2kkCyIC0XFpLnlZI8MZ8J_y-XSPX-BsZSPZvi_HnHlCINVnRq3SGm98_8s6S_nPkXAAD__1-aloo) in Central Texas as catastrophic flash flooding swept the Texas Hill Country, a year after the region's deadly July 2025 floods. The Guadalupe River crested at a [near-historic 37 feet](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2SgyAUhZ8GOx24ISIFxTZ22XZLB-WqzBLJwE3Qt9_RV9juFOdnvvPzGB7WB78t3_aJhvY5DhuWHJAI07D6EKb43igdc4jR5eK3JVN8DcChrbmqhRqc9eEYZOXMyJ0WFRqhOgldK4SqVgNyvHGhAVqtAfVN6k5pp1s5o1Sgx8qbs4wroYTg4n5vACfnusnhrEZhnWWSo_MUU0MrEu42z-GIH0zNFJ9VMCvRK7PbF4OeQV9Kaea4yxPjNDDoT8mgv6L1BeK3pf7FlOqL7qjxY6e3JR-3XCXjXsWH4HOrmOTL0_pwLdH__vkY-AsAAP__1id83g), and the gauge downstream at Center Point [rose 32 feet](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQhZ_GdI48DmAoXNyGLrfdEjnMAJYmOLInf2-_IlntC2x9Zo7O932dxlOIHLflf7iQl-ecxo0ehUmE8rhG5indNsmvmVPC8ojbUiRdR2tsq43T4EYMkV9jXaE_G-yhIg-uq23XArhq9eeAfd3aBnoLAE03h-Ac4nEy0Lupwyr6vcw4cAAGmuZgaULsJqTZnSFgULUhjJLyQVYSeoYy8yvdKR-mdKnYryLXoo7_lB2UHUrYwrYQJ4532i-UHXakT6Q_mbLDL0Gr7PBu1Tuu_uHVaxQdtiQrZY37V063ot8aquzx-ojMsbRO1Wa5hMjvMfI3hXdvvwMAAP__XgSIMw) in four hours. The National Weather Service warned of a "large and deadly flood wave" moving toward Comfort. Up to [20 inches of rain](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DvO5CAQBODT4IwRjR-MA4JNnP2bbmi1oW0jYbCg5-Hbr2au8Mclfaqqfz_zD4YY0vYXD7L8XvOc6FUjMVOZ9xCjy4_E5Vpjzr6-Qtoq53PWSg9SGQlm9hjiNXeNt4vyIzRkwdw7fR8ATLPbHjrsFEDfEriFVmyV1wvSsIJp_dI3wX4wZcAAKOj7mybn_d15Ws0C6FF0inzgXG68E9Mb6xqv_KRyc_loot2ZzyraP0JPQk-4OGg_idBT5Vwuoac1Yt3ld4Kkg8pGyV0yO_coJaRNVjxIfmVZaAs5SYfHKY-rcnCSC27kPw6MPYztaISemmL9-QoxhjoY0antwBC_hfh3Nz6t_h8AAP__N2iJ2Q) fell near Uvalde in 48 hours, roughly six months' worth, and rescuers pulled people from homes and vehicles in Hunt, Kerrville, Uvalde, and Knippa. Gov. Greg Abbott said disaster declarations covered 59 counties, with more than 1,300 state personnel deployed. "_We are dealing with and responding to a flood that is likely going to break records_ ," he said Wednesday.
## Abbott Pitches Insurance Cost Relief
Gov. Greg Abbott proposed a $400 million taxpayer-funded grant program to provide Texas homeowners [with up to $10,000](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0Luu8yAQBOCnsTsiwBfiguJv3OVvT2mtYR0jYdaCJZe3P0pe4fTfjEbzc1tuEGJI9_9woOXXRkvCZ4nIjHnZQ4yOauL83iKRL8-Q7oXpXLTUo5BGKLN4CPG99K23q_STatEqc-31dVTKtLs1IFUnjeuGbZzM2K8KB-wmwGnoN2_6NthPmTTKKCXVMFw0Ou-vzuNmVgUeml6iD0z5wjsyvqBs8U0PzBdHRxvtznyWpvvX6LnR8xeslD3mtZaQsJSPa_QM60rMoqYHhljEGSEJ3oGFoxq9cJXFNyx2OlBA8gIqkwip1AzJoXBUuDR6brP15zPEGMpoml7eDwjxO4b_duHD6t8AAAD___1uisY) to help fortify their roofs against hail and wind, part of a legislative push he says will bring down insurance premiums. Speaking Wednesday at a [Houston campaign stop](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGysyAUhJ9GOxxAI6ag-Bu7_O0tHYSDMkFOBo4xvv0d8wq33_1m9_t5TA8TYkjLf7OBpo_HKcFRIhBBntYQo8U9UT59RHTlCGkphK9JctkzrphQkzMhnlNXOz1zdxc1aKGGTg69EKpetVJybr0R3A73Wag7dNxbI1vbtX3bc1UHfcG4EkoILm63RoJ1brAOvJqFcabqOLhAmBtageBjio8nviE3Frc66pXoVar2XyXHSo7HcTQeP7JfcS-E6QpVcrxeVXJcrl7CzMw8IxEzKeGeLBSWIQbw7MtnK26AR4JcmDcWWHmeGe0TKKSFhVT2bJIFZrFQqbN2ryPEGEqvqo4vmwnxO43-JvSt5W8AAAD__9f-kKs), Abbott said Texas ranks first nationally in hail damage and hail insurance claims, and that similar roof programs in states like Louisiana and Oklahoma cut premiums about 8%. The Legislature would review those programs before appropriating funding. House Speaker Dustin Burrows [called the roof plan](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGu4jAQgOHTOB3IM8QZp3CxW6Rjq5V2u8jYE2LJxMgeCNz-iXeF1_7FV_z_zvPZp5y26x9_Yyevpcwb7y2zCNd5TTmH8tikvpdcSmx72q5Nyn1GjcNB0wFojj7l99x30V10HKFjB2R7tAMAdasjG2AYAcCwNkM42REDoqEQAW1k3yX3wTQBAWgw5ogcYrQh8kIX8NGrXnNMUupRVhZ--bbkd3lyPYZy67JbRe5NnX4pnBROr09VOP1-1Fr21v_9r3Bq4uXRFE6oiXoiMicwBsYRremqi_c95ZzaQKrX15tP-ZuWnw15OvwKAAD__yN4cxc) a "great initiative." The governor also wants to change state law so insurers can factor driving records into auto insurance rates, which he said industry estimates show could cut some premiums by as much as 30%. "_Home insurance and auto insurance are equally skyrocketing, and Texans were demanding relief_ ," Abbott said, adding that the combined reforms would save Texans "hundreds of dollars a year, more likely thousands."
## Texas Launches State Wildfire Air Fleet
The Texas A&M Forest Service [announced Thursday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOpCAUBeCnwQ4DjIJTUGxjN9tuaZB7GcmiGLgzjm__x3mFvzvJSb6cnH-P6eFiitvzr1vR0ifkacOjJiTCMi0xJZ9fG5UzpJyhHnF7Vsr7pITSXBguzQQupnPqGrCzgLts0EozdGrQUppmsaHrUA5aa3EPnYH-BuiHfkYACVrfsYn2woSRRkoh-75V6AEGDxjMLB041gmESLm0tCDhx9WQzvzG0vq8NskuRHtltz9MjUyNx3G0_6ngVTI1XjZTozBMjfJKX4C7lYdcsBKvWN7RI59fZ-WKL5iizzthqTy51-YXfsQEIRbkLhZfXCAeEiIxNTbFwn7ElGLVhnXiubqYvqvod1--rfoJAAD__x_piyo) it has purchased two helicopters, the first aircraft in a state-mandated wildland firefighting fleet. The first Subaru Bell 412EPX is [due to arrive in December 2027](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSgyAYhJ8GOxwgKqaguMYu117pIPwocwgO_Anx7W_MK1z9zbc7uz-P-aF98HH91jsofLs0R6glACLkefMhmPSMmE8XUrKl-rgWTMcsmBgok5TL2WofzrlrrFqYvfMGFJdjJ8aBc9lsSsgBuJSOWTaMYrmzgbPe9dIs_c1KA41XVxiTXHLOeN-3Aoy1o7Hg5MK11aRjYD2m3OIGCG9dXDjTC3Jr0t4EtSEehdy-iJiImGqt7e9bxwsSMV1riJg-GhGT3qlLGQrSrOMKudDleVKsiWqfTdYOL06dz0AzlCPFApfXZGWP6kPwZZCkY-uuffj04_9eeynxFwAA__8qroSx), with the second following three to six months later. The purchase kicks off a two-year expansion, funded by the Legislature's 2025 appropriation of $257 million, that will add multimission fixed-wing planes and large airtankers. The agency and local fire departments responded to 6,304 wildfires that burned 132,366 acres in 2025, and the Forest Service delivered more than 1 million gallons of water and fire retardant during those responses. Its aerial partnership with the Texas Military Department will continue while the fleet comes online. The agency calls the fleet's objective simple: get aircraft on a fire as quickly as possible. Democrats have a real chance to flip the U.S. Senate this year, but they need as many viable paths as possible to get there. We won’t mince words—this is a significant blow.
| | | | | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BDyG9w2APaMsXSG4LOWnRSuX01-lAjYfJDdwI9zfSvLH6AQVpWvtY50THEjy4QTAFtwD1XNENAPlZGObIthyEGqUp6M_dpt_C1ZhrVtEPyOma9B14de5wc_FHic62Ob7ADxmVlz8y8srWEpT-aCgkce73cLndqnkjLHkBEcJkdCwNQle-M82dEmG4fXTHJzynC3m6cQE5E4eDL2VXoWciQ==&c=Oyb3kqtcuVZV1Z0TIfGdrqnM2MFeOZ1rCnqi_bGuN7jCX1U9L_8pUg==&ch=WbGDjmmt-RRNIEnpsLFQBO4phw9edVEuaRtpQu_vEPHyxOZPIkvxnw==)

| Peter,
We have an alarming update from a key state with a real chance to flip a red U.S. Senate seat this November.
For the first time in Louisiana's 214 year history, Republicans just took the voter registration lead from Democrats:
---
| | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BDyG9w2APaMsXSG4LOWnRSuX01-lAjYfJDdwI9zfSvLH6AQVpWvtY50THEjy4QTAFtwD1XNENAPlZGObIthyEGqUp6M_dpt_C1ZhrVtEPyOma9B14de5wc_FHic62Ob7ADxmVlz8y8srWEpT-aCgkce73cLndqnkjLHkBEcJkdCwNQle-M82dEmG4fXTHJzynC3m6cQE5E5KqdudR9jdYg==&c=Oyb3kqtcuVZV1Z0TIfGdrqnM2MFeOZ1rCnqi_bGuN7jCX1U9L_8pUg==&ch=WbGDjmmt-RRNIEnpsLFQBO4phw9edVEuaRtpQu_vEPHyxOZPIkvxnw==)
---
We won't mince words--this is a significant blow. Democrats have a real chance to flip the U.S. Senate this year, but they need as many viable paths as possible to get there. Louisiana is one of those paths, where Democrat Jamie Davis is taking on Trump backed Julie Letlow this fall.
Jamie Davis is running a historic campaign. He is the first black U.S. Senate candidate to make it to the general election in Louisiana in over a century. He swept the Democratic primary with over 80% of the vote just weeks ago.
Davis has real momentum and it's raising eyebrows. Legendary Democratic strategist James Carville has said he believes Democrats have a real "fighting chance" to win this race.
But after losing the voter registration lead, the math just got even harder for Louisiana Democrats.
That's why the Louisiana Democratic Party is taking emergency counter measures. We just launched our No More Silence - Roll to the Polls Tour which will see us visit 14 cities across 7 regions with a goal to register 50,000 new voters, recruit No Party voters, and make sure every voter in Louisiana knows how, when, and where to cast a ballot.
---
| [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BDyG9w2APaMsXSG4LOWnRSuX01-lAjYfJDdwI9zfSvLH6AQVpWvtY50THEjy4QTAFtwD1XNENAPlZGObIthyEGqUp6M_dpt_C1ZhrVtEPyOma9B14de5wc_FHic62Ob7ADxmVlz8y8srWEpT-aCgkce73cLndqnkjLHkBEcJkdCwNQle-M82dEmG4fXTHJzynC3m6cQE5E58iju6nwWNrw==&c=Oyb3kqtcuVZV1Z0TIfGdrqnM2MFeOZ1rCnqi_bGuN7jCX1U9L_8pUg==&ch=WbGDjmmt-RRNIEnpsLFQBO4phw9edVEuaRtpQu_vEPHyxOZPIkvxnw==)
---
Our first stops in Shreveport and Monroe this past weekend were roaring successes. Louisianans are fired up and showing up--packing rooms, registering to vote, and making plans to get to the polls. The tour is grabbing headlines across the state.
But an operation like this doesn't come cheap, we need your help to keep the show on the road, rebuild our voter registration lead, and flip the Senate blue. [We need Democrats across the country to pitch in today: Can we count on you to rush a donation of $25, $10, or even just $5, to help Louisiana Dems register voters, retake the lead, and flip the U.S. Senate blue?](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BDyG9w2APaMsXSG4LOWnRSuX01-lAjYfJDdwI9zfSvLH6AQVpWvtY50THEjy4QTAu-X-SxjLc0vlLg95Q09eJ6GHELONCOcPWPqITXwH0G5dTatjPdasD_1kQCp98PmCWT6qoPwME7Axm0KutgoAzq1xqD3Dv_Vj-v0vjeQkzsuv9RtSzGn5RI1Z5ocw6oDMV6X8pVdLFyBwwVrHE0Iw24HNdPSRh0VDjuW9ZwDenMw=&c=Oyb3kqtcuVZV1Z0TIfGdrqnM2MFeOZ1rCnqi_bGuN7jCX1U9L_8pUg==&ch=WbGDjmmt-RRNIEnpsLFQBO4phw9edVEuaRtpQu_vEPHyxOZPIkvxnw==)

**Congressman Jim Himes ' response to President Trump's speech last night on "The Last Word" on MSNBC on election integrity--and his preemptive New York Times op-ed--amounts to fearmongering and political hyperbole.**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/60a49fe7-cb5c-44e1-a02a-88b49aca9867?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The American public should not be pressured into drawing conclusions before seeing the evidence. I believe in our legal and investigative processes, and I will wait to review the investigation and documentation that President Trump has said will be presented to the American people.
Transparency should not frighten anyone. The facts should be released, examined, and evaluated through the proper process.
CNN's own polling analysis found that **83% of Americans support requiring photo identification to vote** , including strong majorities of Democrats, Black voters, and Latino voters.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/74b497c7-d185-4e8e-90c7-c3a7e1d03ea3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Election integrity is not something Americans fear --it is something they overwhelmingly support.**
Congressman Himes needs to look no farther than Bridgeport, one of his strongest voting bases, and the scandal involving "Wanda the Ballot Stuffer."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/27b27c0d-8ff0-42de-8e38-1884c52a50b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Election misconduct is not an abstract concern. It has occurred in his own congressional district and has brought national embarrassment to Connecticut.**
Before pointing fingers at President Trump, Congressman Himes should explain why he opposes stronger safeguards, including the SAVE Act and commonsense voter identification for federal elections.
As Connecticut voters know, a person who does not present accepted identification at the polls may generally sign a sworn statement affirming their identity. If state officials insist that stronger verification cannot be applied to every election, then Connecticut should consider using separate federal and state ballots.
Federal ballots could follow enhanced identification and citizenship-verification standards, while state ballots could continue under Connecticut's existing rules. That would allow officials and the public to compare the two systems, review any discrepancies, and determine which safeguards produce the greatest confidence and transparency.
Perhaps Congressman Himes's reaction is an invitation for President Trump to finally focus national attention on Connecticut by making the Fourth Congressional District a pilot program for election integrity.
_**In the meantime, voters must come out in record numbers for the August 11 federal primary and again this November.**_
The answer to fearmongering is not fear. It is transparency, due process, voter participation, and elections that are free, fair, secure, and worthy of the public's trust.

name: Rep. Torrey C. Harris | TN House District 91
subject: Early Voting has Started. The Polls Are Open TODAY!
body:
Don't leave it to chance, get out and vote today!
| | | | |
---
| |
---
# The Polls Are OPEN! Early Voting Has Started!
---
| Friend,
Polling locations are open across Tennessee and Shelby County, and Early Voting has officially begun! This election isn't just a name on a ballot. It's about our schools, our neighborhoods, and a District 91 that fights back against Nashville overreach. And in a race this close, it comes down to who actually shows up.
This is the moment we've been working toward: Early voting is open right now and runs through Saturday, August 1.
You don't have to wait for Election Day on August 6 -- and you shouldn't. A vote cast early is a vote that can't be lost to a long line, a busy schedule, or bad weather.
Here's how to vote early: • When: now through Saturday, August 1 (Election Day is Thursday, August 6) • Where: [Any early-voting location in Shelby County](https://tlxxd7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0011jkdz8VszNvGHW41gsrjH220bXn8CIqhjHzfXk-WPKQmrIYwa-yq1mFfutHjn1We20JabXS6zRcVt9-rlRatLtZtPRtusUoo9PM1ObBOKzfaAbNoyQ6hFw-QCDI817i7-ERZo6a-3k4EEkOzME15ttpmJ0eRwZ0qNLufru_WK6o_vUboUELf80kRO7gCE-J_&c=hR2qLt1-377RXHHWX_mMpim5MXGxqF-5KJ_nudi04nWt4mJ7wZuheA==&ch=MqZKZ8CqFTVDbCcFXkqotBNov8fJc9e_U-B_qV6bTe8_FHG8yM2yUQ==) << Click Here for Locations • Bring: a valid photo ID -- and a neighbor
If you've already voted -- thank you. Now will you help get three more neighbors to the polls? Forward them this email. That's how the 91st wins.
See You At The Polls!
Rep. Torrey C. Harris TN House of Representatives, District 91 Chairman, Shelby County Legislative Delegation

Lead Story · The Iran War
SIXTH NIGHT OF STRIKES SEVERS IRAN'S BRIDGES AS THE WAR OVER HORMUZ WIDENS
What's Happening
* U.S. Central Command carried out a **sixth consecutive night** of strikes into Friday, saying it hit "military logistics infrastructure" and "maritime capabilities" in southern Iran.
* The strikes hit at least **six bridges and a railway junction** around Bandar Abbas — the Strait of Hormuz port that hosts an IRGC naval base — in an apparent bid to cut it off from Iran's interior.
* Iranian state media said at least **eight people were killed** and 20 wounded, and reported power outages at the port.

The Situation
* Tehran struck back at U.S. allies across the region — Qatar (where a child was wounded by falling shrapnel), Kuwait, and Jordan — and, for the first time, launched a **direct attack on Syria**.
* The IRGC warned that as long as U.S. action in the strait continues, "not a single drop of oil or gas" will leave the region.
* Traffic through Hormuz remains largely halted; the White House said Trump would hold Iran "accountable" but is "always open to diplomacy."

The Perspective
The president warned Tehran the bridges would come if it kept firing on ships — and this week they did. Follow-through, not bluff, is what rebuilds deterrence. But a widening war carries real costs: civilian casualties, rattled Gulf allies, and a chokepoint that is still closed. Strength has to be paired with an off-ramp that actually reopens the strait, not just punishes Iran.
[Read the full story at NBC News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_CxFUquvFkw68OM0iDID0yDKuMxr5GhZ2dUdh-jyubZsfIHFATavNITtHwk4DYhFVT27I26ADnHY43wZFEP3ozgROKgsS5LcBNBkxgnMYZMM7q6e2nh4tUtOeXEKOb7eid1iiQq6awGKWU0vCz545OWc5xp53Mmyl1iEVZ7MYrROu_JllBqbUFmwZ9PpITvC5-QHJFej1S3t9jAg4kPPxiKLp4lzDiTPHUA1f_emKoJu5v4RZfggCLIyYxZqecu6BPz8wXwk0pKtRLeoWd_lNuT-v-XGuicCv-jTXBXS5LMxufyUQxS4On5u5ebluvVpUlZfXNCj9uS1oWjOqxsvydc/4se/VEdF96HJQZGfZm8c0GWofQ/h6/h001.UV2dHyFSsyVq9bsLtG0Y5OFTlRRnrhwFqxIr6py_c-c)
Election Integrity
TRUMP TAKES HIS ELECTION FIGHT PRIMETIME, RELEASES DECLASSIFIED FILES
What's Happening
* In a roughly **25-minute address** from the White House East Room on Thursday, Trump said he was declassifying intelligence he described as revealing "shocking vulnerabilities" in U.S. election infrastructure.
* He pointed to **"five major areas of concern,"** including alleged Chinese efforts to influence American elections, voting-machine security, and noncitizens on some state voter rolls.
* The administration posted the documents to the White House website.

The Situation
* Trump used the speech to renew his push for the **SAVE Act** , which would require proof of citizenship to register and ID to vote. RNC Chairman Joe Gruters echoed the call to pass it.
* The bill has been **stalled in the Senate** for months.
* NPR notes that intelligence reviews under both the Trump and Biden administrations found no credible evidence that any foreign government altered votes, and that in-person voter fraud is rare.

The Perspective

A Metamask billboard in Times Square. Photo by Noam Galai/Getty Images.
Fort Worth-based blockchain firm Consensys, creator of the popular Ethereum-based MetaMask crypto wallet, accidentally hired a software developer linked to North Korea, according to internal messages obtained by Drop Site News.
North Korean nationals have increasingly targeted American software companies, posing as engineers and securing software development roles in order to expropriate trade secrets or infiltrate the software development supply chain. The DPRK-linked engineer, who was hired by Consensys as a consultant, used the alias "Tyler Knapp" and GitHub handle "[imyugioh](https://substack.com/redirect/b6bdfd80-b2fb-4ef3-ae74-22d7af98f16c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
The revelation comes as Republican senators are planning[ to brief President Donald Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/847443f8-b70d-4bbe-9c9a-9cf09315ce62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on new crypto legislation, the Clarity Act, details of which have yet to be released publicly.
Internal Slack communications indicate "Knapp" worked on core platform code for the MetaMask wallet, and contributed to parts of the platform related to conversion between crypto and fiat currency via third-party payment providers. Drop Site has confirmed that the public GitHub profile associated with "Knapp" also made contributions to MetaMask's mobile wallet platform; his contributions abruptly stopped in April 2026--the same time his access to the Consenys team was terminated. The contributions began on March 9, meaning the actor had roughly a month to roam inside the system.

Abortion bans hurt everyone | | | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/135437376/634241126/2141984067?sourceid=1151469&utm_campaign=27emcrm-0701aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=repromatters&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDM0MDQ0OS1lMjgxLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cu9qWN-L0chFLcDLwQHT_Gq0dlnBCVTVmoM-0TUP7MU=&emci=dd155267-3681-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=c0340449-e281-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=954237)
---
| |
# ReproMatters

---|---
| Peter—

The Trump administration has let contraception worth millions of dollars go to waste—contraception meant for foreign aid, which could prevent hundreds of thousands of unintended pregnancies and hundreds of maternal deaths for women and girls in sub-Sarahan Africa. Multiple humanitarian organizations have offered to buy the birth control, but the administration has refused.

This is just one of many actions by the Trump administration that threaten access to essential reproductive health care around the world and in the United States. On the first day of President Trump's second term, his administration announced a [freeze](https://click.everyaction.com/k/135437377/634241127/1106568426?sourceid=1151469&utm_campaign=27emcrm-0701aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=repromatters&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDM0MDQ0OS1lMjgxLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cu9qWN-L0chFLcDLwQHT_Gq0dlnBCVTVmoM-0TUP7MU=&emci=dd155267-3681-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=c0340449-e281-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=954237) on all foreign aid. It then dismantled the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID), [terminating](https://click.everyaction.com/k/135437378/634241128/-1459043461?sourceid=1151469&utm_campaign=27emcrm-0701aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=repromatters&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDM0MDQ0OS1lMjgxLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cu9qWN-L0chFLcDLwQHT_Gq0dlnBCVTVmoM-0TUP7MU=&emci=dd155267-3681-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=c0340449-e281-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=954237) its international family planning programs.

The Center [sued the Trump administration](https://click.everyaction.com/k/135437380/634241129/43200966?sourceid=1151469&utm_campaign=27emcrm-0701aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=repromatters&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDM0MDQ0OS1lMjgxLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cu9qWN-L0chFLcDLwQHT_Gq0dlnBCVTVmoM-0TUP7MU=&emci=dd155267-3681-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=c0340449-e281-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=954237) over its decision to let the contraception—and millions in taxpayer money—go to waste, after it failed to respond to our Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request. We have filed more than 30 FOIA requests and brought multiple legal challenges to demand transparency and hold the administration accountable for policies and actions that threaten reproductive health and rights.

The U.S. was previously the world's largest donor to international family planning efforts and one of the largest global purchasers and distributors of contraception. In 2024 alone, U.S. family planning aid prevented 17.1 million unintended pregnancies and 34,000 maternal deaths. The cutoff of U.S. support for family planning and birth control has had—and will continue to have—a devastating impact on the lives and health of millions of women and girls.

But we are undaunted: we will continue leading the fight to protect and restore access to reproductive health care, advance reproductive autonomy for all people, and hold the Trump administration accountable.

The Repro Rights Team

clean_body: Abortion bans hurt everyone | | | | | ReproMatters ---|--- | Peter— The Trump administration has let contraception worth millions of dollars go to waste—contraception meant for foreign aid, which could prevent hundreds of thousands of unintended pregnancies and hundreds of maternal deaths for women and girls in sub-Sarahan Africa. Multiple humanitarian organizations have offered to buy the birth control, but the administration has refused. This is just one of many actions by the Trump administration that threaten access to essential reproductive health care around the world and in the United States. On the first day of President Trump's second term, his administration announced a on all foreign aid. It then dismantled the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID), its international family planning programs. The Center over its decision to let the contraception—and millions in taxpayer money—go to waste, after it failed to respond to our Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request. We have filed more than 30 FOIA requests and brought multiple legal challenges to demand transparency and hold the administration accountable for policies and actions that threaten reproductive health and rights. The U.S. was previously the world's largest donor to international family planning efforts and one of the largest global purchasers and distributors of contraception. In 2024 alone, U.S. family planning aid prevented 17.1 million unintended pregnancies and 34,000 maternal deaths. The cutoff of U.S. support for family planning and birth control has had—and will continue to have—a devastating impact on the lives and health of millions of women and girls. But we are undaunted: we will continue leading the fight to protect and restore access to reproductive health care, advance reproductive autonomy for all people, and hold the Trump administration accountable. The Repro Rights Team P.S. The following guidance should be followed regarding membership on ward and town committees under M.G.L. c. 52.

1. Elected members serve fixed four-year terms. Members elected at the presidential primary hold their seats for the term fixed by state law. Under the statute, a seat ends early only if the member moves out of the town or ward, changes or cancels their Republican enrollment, or resigns.
2. Committees may not remove or demote elected members. A committee should not vote to expel an elected member, declare an elected member's seat vacant or forfeited, or change an elected member's status to non-voting or "associate" membership.
3. Please be aware of the legal exposure. A member affected by an action of the kind described in paragraph 2 may go to court, and Massachusetts courts have the power to order a member restored, to declare the committee's action void, and to call into question votes the committee took in the meantime. Defending such an action is costly for the committee and its officers, whether or not it succeeds.
4. Organization requirements still apply. Every committee must continue to meet and organize as G.L. c. 52, § 4 requires, and to follow the State Committee's organization procedures and notices. This guidance does not change those obligations.
5. As always, ask before acting. If your committee is considering any action affecting a member's status, or has questions about its organization, contact us. We will make sure you get an answer, in coordination with counsel where needed. This email is party guidance, not a legal opinion.

name: Enoch for Congress
subject: The Best Response Is to Vote. The Next Best Response Is to Organize.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer
body:
Our Democracy depends on the American people believing that their vote matters.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | Hello Peter,

Last night, Donald Trump once again took the national stage to revisit grievances about past elections and to raise new doubts about the integrity of our electoral system. Instead of focusing on lowering costs, strengthening our economy, ending the illegitimate war, or solving the challenges facing working families, we were treated to more attacks on the very process that gives Americans their voice.
I've had enough!
My opponent, Warren Davidson, has repeatedly aligned himself with efforts to challenge the results of the 2020 presidential election, while never questioning the legitimacy of the election that sent **him** to Congress. If our elections are only legitimate when your side wins, that's not a principle—that's political convenience.
The hypocrisy is breathtaking!
Our democracy depends on something bigger than any one candidate or political party. It depends on the American people believing that their vote matters. It depends on citizens showing up, participating, and holding elected officials accountable.
That's exactly why I'm running.
I'm running because working families deserve representatives who spend more time solving problems than relitigating elections. We need leaders focused on lowering the cost of living, protecting Social Security and Medicare, defending voting rights, investing in our communities, and creating opportunities for every Ohioan—not fueling division or undermining confidence in our democracy.
But campaigns aren't won by speeches alone. They're won by neighbors talking to neighbors, volunteers knocking on doors, and everyday people refusing to sit on the sidelines.
**That's why I hope you'll**[**join Team Enoch**](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=675b240b47&e=c6e7dff14c)**tomorrow as we honor the legacy of Congressman John Lewis by getting into "Good Trouble."**
**Weekend of Action: John Lewis Good Trouble Rally & Canvass**
**Saturday, July 18, 2026**
**10:00 AM – 12:30 PM**
**Kemper Meadow Park**
**1201 W. Kemper Road**
**Cincinnati, OH 45240**
We'll gather with volunteers, supporters, and fellow Democrats to rally, organize, and launch our canvass across Ohio's 8th Congressional District. Congressman John Lewis reminded us that democracy is not a state,it is an act. Every conversation, every door knocked, every voter registered, and every ballot cast strengthens our democracy.
Whether you've volunteered a hundred times or this would be your very first event, we'd love to have you join us. Bring a friend, bring your family, and help us build the grassroots movement that will change Ohio's 8th District.
If you can't join us in person, you can still make a tremendous difference.
**Please consider making a contribution of**[**$5, $10, $25, $50**](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=99ad0fe8cd&e=c6e7dff14c)**, or whatever you can afford today.**
Your donation helps us print campaign literature, reach more voters, support our volunteers, keep our campaign on the road, and build the organization we'll need to win this November.This election is about more than one congressional seat.
It's about choosing truth over misinformation, accountability over excuses, and service over self-interest.
The best answer to those who would have Americans lose faith in our democracy isn't anger,it's action.
Let's organize.Let's vote.Let's win.
I'll see you at Kemper Meadow Park.With gratitude,
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch**
Democratic Candidate for Congress
Ohio's 8th Congressional District
**P.S.** John Lewis taught us that "Democracy is not a state. It is an act." Tomorrow, let's honor his legacy by getting into some **Good Trouble** together. If you can't attend, please [chip in](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=b7159406ec&e=c6e7dff14c) today to help fuel our grassroots campaign. Every contribution, no matter the size, helps us reach another voter and build the movement that will win Ohio's 8th Congressional District.
Paid for by the Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer.

Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, inf=
ormation and upcoming events.

JUST OVER A MONTH AWAY

Hi friends,=E2=80=8BEarly voting begins on July 21, and the Republican Prim=
ary is August 18, just over a month away. If you haven't registered to vote=
, you can register through your county clerk. Wyoming also allows eligible =
voters to register early or on Election Day if they bring the required iden=
tification and proof of residency; a WY-issued driver's license covers both=
requirements. We recommend avoiding lines by registering early and encoura=
ge you to help new voters who might feel timid. Make a plan with friends an=
d family to vote together, remind others to verify where and when they'll v=
ote, and offer a ride to a neighbor if transportation is needed.=E2=80=8BUn=
fortunately, we've now seen the first wave of misleading attack ads on my l=
egislative record. The ads are funded by organizations outside Wyoming that=
are trying to influence our state's election. Rather than respond with mor=
e mudslinging, we released two videos: one reiterating that we won't engage=
in negative campaigning, and another walking through the facts of my votin=
g record. Both links are below. My focus remains where it has always been: =
serving Wyoming and having honest conversations about the issues that matte=
r to our state.=E2=80=8BIn better news, Kelly and I enjoyed spending last w=
eek at Wyoming's community days, rodeos, and two powwows. These annual even=
ts celebrate our heritage, support local organizations, and honor our veter=
ans. Seeing all the community pride and smiling faces keeps our energy flow=
ing along the campaign trail, and we are grateful to be a part of it.=E2=80=
=8BThank you for your continued encouragement, support, and the many conver=
sations we have had along the road. I look forward to seeing many more of y=
ou in communities across Wyoming in the weeks ahead.-Eric

Outside, dark money groups continue to try to infiltrate Wyoming elections.=
In new ads shared on local television stations, a dark-money PAC attempts =

Here are the facts:

I believe in protecting children.=C2=A0I believe parents, not government, s=

In 2023, the Wyoming legislature refused to move forward with bills that we=
re not ready to become law. In 2024, we were ready, and I helped pass two l=

Good bills make strong laws that don=E2=80=99t get hung up in the courts. I=

Barlow Says Republican Voters Should Decide Republican Primary

GILLETTE, Wyo. =E2=80=94 Republican gubernatorial candidate Eric Barlow not=
ified the Wyoming Republican Party that he will not participate in their pr=
e-primary endorsement process or return the party=E2=80=99s platform questi=
onnaire, saying the decision on who should represent the Republican Party b=
elongs to Wyoming Republican voters.

=E2=80=9CI am a Republican, and I agree with the Republican platform,=E2=80=
=9D Barlow said. =E2=80=9CBut in a contested Republican primary, the voters=
should decide. I will not seek or accept an endorsement from the Wyoming R=
epublican Party before receiving the votes of Wyoming=E2=80=99s Republican =
electorate.=E2=80=9D

Barlow's campaign points to the rule of law as the foundation of the decisi=
on. Under current Wyoming law, political party funds may not be used to aid=
the nomination of one candidate over another candidate of the same politic=
al party in a primary election, and a growing number of county parties acro=
ss Wyoming have declined to make endorsements for that exact reason.

Barlow, the campaign says, sees no reason the state party should be treated=
differently. Additionally, the Wyoming Constitution, Article 6, Section 20=
, requires a candidate to swear that they have not violated the law or caus=
ed someone else to do so in connection with their election. Participation i=
n or acceptance of a party endorsement places an individual at jeopardy of =
defying this requirement.

=E2=80=9CThe Republican Party has long been the party of the rule of law, a=
nd I intend to hold it to that standard,=E2=80=9D Barlow said. =E2=80=9CVot=
ers, not a small group at the top of the party, should decide who is worthy=
of their consideration. That is what free speech and a fair election are s=
upposed to look like, and this process has been anything but transparent wi=
th candidates or the public.=E2=80=9D

The campaign noted that Barlow's position is not a new one. He raised the s=
ame concerns in early May, when he told WyoFile that contested primaries sh=
ould be decided by voters and that the party should not put its thumb on th=
e scale in a race between Republicans. Today's announcement reaffirms that =
stance.

=E2=80=9CThis race belongs to Wyoming Republican voters,=E2=80=9D Barlow sa=
id. =E2=80=9CI will continue traveling the state, having honest conversatio=
ns with my Wyoming neighbors, and earning their support person by person an=
d community by community.=E2=80=9D

On The Trail

PINEDALEWe toured Raven SR in Pinedale and were impressed by what this Wyom=
ing company is doing.

Raven SR converts waste including municipal solid waste, organic waste and =
methane into clean hydrogen and synthetic fuels through a non-combustion pr=
ocess. They are turning landfill and pollution into usable energy with fewe=
r emissions and higher efficiency than traditional methods.

We have the resources and the talent right here at home to drive our energy=
future forward.

PINEDALE/ROCK SPRINGS

I joined the Green River Rendezvous in Pinedale and Rock Springs Internatio=
nal Day. Two great annual community events. We had lots of support and oppo=
rtunities to talk with attendees.

ETHETEThank you to the Arapaho and Shoshone for the warm welcome at this ye=
ar=E2=80=99s Celebration Powwow. It was an honor to spend the evening celeb=
rating tradition at such a meaningful event.

I was humbled to present a woven American flag runner to the Veterans Commi=
ttee and a buffalo runner to the Powwow Committee Chairwoman as a small tok=
en of appreciation. We also had the chance to walk the grounds, visit with =
families, hand out candy to the kids, and enjoy the incredible dancing, dru=
mming and hospitality under a beautiful golden sunset

GILLETTE
Kelly and I had a wonderful evening in Gillette at an event hosted by Micke=
y and Linda Shober, Dudley and Marilyn Mackey, and Doug and Charlene Cambli=
n. While in town, I also spent time with the Gillette Realtors.=C2=A0

Good conversations with people who care about Wyoming=E2=80=99s future. Tha=
nk you for the hospitality and excellent questions!

It was an honor to join neighbors at Lasting Legacy Park for the nationwide=
reading of the Declaration of Independence.

Hearing those words read aloud was a powerful reminder that government rece=
ives its authority from the people, not the other way around. That principl=
e has guided our nation for 250 years, and it still matters today.

Thank you to everyone who helped bring Gillette together for this special m=
oment in our nation=E2=80=99s history.

CASPER
A great day in Casper started at the Central Wyoming Fair Parade! Lots of f=
riendly faces!=E2=80=8B

In the afternoon, Veterans for Barlow hosted a parade day barbecue, hosted =
by Jeannie and John Petley.

Sitting down with the men and women who served this country is always an ho=
nor.

Thank you to Jeannie and John for hosting, and to everyone who came out.

Along the way, I stopped for a good conversation with the Wyoming Rural Ele=
ctric Association Board about the opportunities and challenges of supplying=
rural Wyoming with critical electricity and working together on getting re=
sults.

SHERIDAN

Thank you to Dr. Chris Schamber and Dr. Jory Wasserburger for hosting a mee=
t and greet what a great group!

We talked about my approach to executive orders, thoughts on the direction =
of the Wyoming Business Council and finding common ground between the Gover=
nor=E2=80=99s office and the Legislature.

Protecting our public lands from sale remains a top priority we agree on.

Later in the week, we were back in Sheridan to enjoy a pancake breakfast an=
d walk the WYO parade, where we saw friends new and old along the whole rou=
te!

Following the Sheridan WYO Rodeo parade Eric and Kelly went to The First Pe=
ople=E2=80=99s Powwow.

GILLETTE
We had a great meet-and-greet with the Campbell County firefighters at Big =
Lost Meadery in Gillette.=E2=80=8B

The men and women of the CCFD showed up with thoughtful questions and did n=
ot hold back.

We talked through the longevity of firefighters and workers' comp, early pr=
evention and protection, and plans to support the emergency fire suppressio=
n account after the 2024 fire season.

We also discussed supporting first responder families and wellness, infrast=
ructure and community growth, along with the broader challenges facing Wyom=
ing, including education, healthcare, water, data centers, energy, public l=
ands, and property taxes.

First responders put everything on the line for their communities, and they=
deserve leadership that listens and follows through.

IT'S PARADE SEASON!!

We continue to meet friends, old and new, at parades and community event da=
ys around the state. Thank you to the volunteers and field staff who attend=
ed in some of the communities on my behalf. This trip included:=C2=A0=E2=80=

clean_body: Some are real, some figurative — Congressman Steve Scalise (R-LA), who calls himself "David Duke without the baggage", is one of them. | | | | | == | Peter, Some MAGA members of Congress don KKK hoods, some real, some figurative -- GOP House Majority Leader Steve Scalise, who calls himself "David Duke without the baggage", is one of them. For those outside Louisiana, David Duke is the former Grand Wizard of the KKK who almost became our Governor in the 90s. When Scalise made that comment, he was saying he shares Duke's commitment to white supremacy -- he just keeps the hood in the closet. He even spoke at an event hosted by the European-American Unity and Rights Organization, a white supremacist group founded by Duke himself. | == This isn't guilt by association. This is a pattern. The House Majority Leader has a public history of proudly aligning himself with the white supremacist movement. He's voted like it too: He voted against making MLK Day a holiday in Louisiana twice -- in 1999 and 2004. He voted no against the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act, a bill that would have required body cameras and banned chokeholds. * He voted against the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, a bill to restore protections of the 1965 Voting Rights Act. My name is Lauren Jewett, I'm the Democrat running against House Majority Leader Steve Scalise. It is deeply shameful that Louisiana's 1st Congressional district has a representative who has embraced the hateful violence of the KKK -- an organization that has murdered hundreds of Black Louisianans.
