subject: Let’s make our voices louder than the conspiracies
body:
https://www.apipennsylvania.org [https://www.apipennsylvania.org]
Hi Peter,
[https://secure.everyaction.com/npIH-E4iR0aHxi8U2uZ5kQ2?contactdata=klx1T0ihlboKTIBc/9+XMUw3HfPzUJmQL4mUq6H7GH04k9JquC6cTSrzZnVt88iDLZBOtGc9JguzWBBko2ddnxqdtF/DR/3WU4tujG4X7tKRBUaUa7eUEgVFkfs+EW9nkm+X/g+9DUfBwsle0nGKb3+U1ywyIx9Mys1hct8RHyw=]
[https://secure.everyaction.com/82Y1BXHF6Uiojy5pDtjPDw2?contactdata=klx1T0ihlboKTIBc/9+XMUw3HfPzUJmQL4mUq6H7GH04k9JquC6cTSrzZnVt88iDLZBOtGc9JguzWBBko2ddnxqdtF/DR/3WU4tujG4X7tKRBUaUa7eUEgVFkfs+EW9nkm+X/g+9DUfBwsle0nGKb3+U1ywyIx9Mys1hct8RHyw=]
[https://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/local/vigil-at-philadelphia-city-hall-calls-for-ice-accountability/4433451/] Last night, President Trump used a primetime presidential address to continue spreading lies and misinformation about our elections and immigrant communities.
Here’s the truth. We have free and fair elections, that includes the election in 2020. There is no evidence of widespread fraud, direct foreign intervention, or federal or state corruption. So why bother revisiting debunked conspiracy theories?
Let’s be clear about what Trump’s goals are: by trying to rewrite elections in the past, he’s attempting to discredit our elections in the future.
Right now, these false claims are not only unhelpful, they hurt our elections and our communities. By spreading misinformation, Trump is adding to a climate of confusion, and fear around voting. This confusion is only made worse by efforts from the Trump administration to make voting more difficult — from legal attacks on mail voting to proposing unreasonable requirements when registering to vote.
Six years, and more than sixty court losses later, it’s clear that Trump’s claims aren’t based in reality — they are just cover up for a desperate power grab in 2026. We’re not giving Trump and MAGA an opportunity to call foul on our elections this November before votes are cast and ballots are counted.
In November, we are encouraging our community members to step up and be voters. Numbers don’t lie, and when we turn out to vote in force, we make their conspiracies harder to believe. API PA is working to grow voter participation in Asian American communities in Pennsylvania ahead of this critical election — and you can be a part of our mission.
If you are eligible to vote in Pennsylvania (A citizen who is over 18 who lives here), check your voter registration! [https://vote.pa/check/?org=apipa] Make sure all of your information is up to date so you can participate in the November 3rd election. You can also sign up to vote by mail [https://vote.pa/mail/?org=apipa] so that you have plenty of time to review your ballot and get your vote in.
[https://secure.everyaction.com/npIH-E4iR0aHxi8U2uZ5kQ2?contactdata=klx1T0ihlboKTIBc/9+XMUw3HfPzUJmQL4mUq6H7GH04k9JquC6cTSrzZnVt88iDLZBOtGc9JguzWBBko2ddnxqdtF/DR/3WU4tujG4X7tKRBUaUa7eUEgVFkfs+EW9nkm+X/g+9DUfBwsle0nGKb3+U1ywyIx9Mys1hct8RHyw=]
[https://secure.everyaction.com/npIH-E4iR0aHxi8U2uZ5kQ2?contactdata=klx1T0ihlboKTIBc/9+XMUw3HfPzUJmQL4mUq6H7GH04k9JquC6cTSrzZnVt88iDLZBOtGc9JguzWBBko2ddnxqdtF/DR/3WU4tujG4X7tKRBUaUa7eUEgVFkfs+EW9nkm+X/g+9DUfBwsle0nGKb3+U1ywyIx9Mys1hct8RHyw=]
Check your voter registration [https://vote.pa/check/?org=apipa] Sign up to vote by mail [https://vote.pa/mail/?org=apipa]
If you aren’t eligible to vote yet or live outside of Pennsylvania, fund our voter registration and voter outreach programs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/api-pa-1?refcode=07.17.2026Email] so that we can make sure everyone has what they need to participate in the election this year.
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/api-pa-1?refcode=07.17.2026Email]
Let's make our voices heard,
Katrina Eames

| | | | | |

---
Peter,
In 250 years of American history, we have never faced a moment quite like this one.
**The Democratic Party is being swallowed whole by an openly socialist, anti-American wing.**
This is not name-calling. Their own platform calls for gutting our military, nationalizing private companies, abolishing cash bail, throwing open the border, and handing voting rights to noncitizens.
Their radicals are beating establishment Democrats in primary after primary. Zohran Mamdani was just the beginning.
_But here is what most Americans still do not understand, and it worries me deeply._
**The Democrats have already rigged the system. And they did it through illegal immigration.**
It works like this. Our Census counts every single resident, citizens and illegal aliens alike, when it hands out House seats and Electoral College votes.
So every illegal alien sitting in a blue state quietly pads that state's power in Washington, D.C.
Elon Musk has been sounding the alarm on this, and he is exactly right. Record illegal immigration has already shifted an estimated 15 to 20 House seats toward the Left.
Now you understand why they fight secure borders and deportations so ferociously.
**That is the entire scheme. Flood the country. Inflate the count. Redraw the maps. Lock in permanent one-party power. **
President Trump fought to base representation on American citizens where it belongs. The courts blocked him at every turn. But the plot is now out in the open for all of us to see.
Which brings me to the SAVE Act, and to my single greatest fear in this fight...
Not enough Americans even know what it is. **One poll found that only 23% could accurately describe it.** That is a catastrophe, because you cannot rally the people to save something they have never had explained to them.
**So let me tell you plainly what this bill does: The SAVE Act bars noncitizens from voting, so that only American citizens ever cast a ballot in an American election. And it requires photo ID to vote.** _**Period.** _
That is the whole fight, in two sentences.
And the American people are with us by margins you almost never see in politics. Nearly 80% want proof of citizenship to register. More than 8 in 10 support voter ID, including most Democrats, most independents, every background and every region. It is 5 to 1.
**Yet every single Democrat is fighting to block it.** _**Every one.** _
I have spent a lifetime in these battles, and I will tell you the hard truth. You never win reform inside Washington, D.C. The lobbyists and the entrenched forces always control the inside game.
Reagan understood this. His job, he said, was to shine a light on the American people so they would turn up the heat on Congress. Tip O'Neill once admitted to me that Reagan's speeches cost him 46 Democrats in a single fight.

| | Good morning Friend,
Every year, our annual gala brings together people from across Mississippi who care deeply about the future of our state. Business leaders, elected officials, community supporters, and friends of MCPP gather for an evening of thoughtful conversation, meaningful fellowship, and a shared commitment to the ideas that have helped Mississippi make remarkable progress. This year's A Celebration of Mississippi's Success promises to be one of our strongest programs yet. We are honored to welcome **Charles C.W. Cooke** , senior editor at _National Review_ , as our keynote speaker. Charles is one of the country's most respected conservative writers and commentators, offering thoughtful insight on the issues shaping our nation and the conservative movement. Joining him will be **Speaker of the House Jason White** , whose leadership has helped guide many of Mississippi's most significant policy reforms in recent years, along with **special guest Grover Norquist** , founder and president of Americans for Tax Reform.

Dear Friend, We typically don't share op-eds in our weekly email, printed in full, but this one is worth your time.**Wyoming Freedom Caucus's Rep. John Bear** asks a question below that sounds unthinkable: how long before Wyoming — one of the reddest states in America — elects a socialist? His answer is worth thinking about. It could be sooner than later. From a Denver congressional nomination to a Maine Senate primary to bureaucrats banning Constitutions at an Independence Day parade, Bear traces how radical ideas advance not by winning arguments but by wearing down, misdirecting, and infiltrating — **sometimes under a Republican banner.** Swap out the places and the names and this piece could be written about any of the 50 states. It's worth remembering as it pertains to our own backyards, our own communities, and our own states — because no deep red legislature, county commission, or parks department is immune.
---
|
---
**How Long Before Wyoming Elects A Socialist?**_By Wyoming Freedom Caucus member, State Rep. John Bear_ _Rules for Radicals_ is a book published in 1971 by Saul Alinsky, a radical leftist community activist who wrote from his decades of pro-Communist organizing efforts. Alinsky died shortly after its publication, but Rules for Radicals has lived on, even shaping today's neo-Marxist reunion tour now sweeping Blue states and universities near you. In a recent article published in Salon, the headline reads, "Trump Revives the Red Scare," accusing the president of reviving the old wave of anti-communism from the 1950s. Actually, I don't think President Trump is the originator of the most recent "Red Scare" at all – not when today's Democrat Party is doing such a fine job on its own. Last month, Democrats in Denver nominated a self-declared Socialist for U.S. Congress on her promises to deliver Soviet-style free stuff for everyone. Her empty, laughable promises are covered by Alinsky rules 1 and 2. Maine Democrats nominated a loser Communist (his word, not mine) with the added bonus of a Nazi tattoo to represent them in the U.S. Senate before deciding that serious, credible rape allegations (but not his Nazism or Communism) made him unfit for that office. Nevertheless, it is conservatives who the left brands "Nazis" and "Christian Nationalists", per Alinsky's rules 3-5. On July 3, New York Mayor, radical Islamist, trust fund baby and avowed Socialist Zohran Mamdani delivered a speech from George Washington's desk, where he attacked everything about America on its birthday. When did "Make America Great Again" become dirty words, and "the warmth of collectivism" become okay? Pure Alinsky. And lest we think Wyoming is above all this, Gillette, Wyoming's community organizations were barred by Campbell County Parks & Recreation officials from handing out U.S. Constitutions and Bibles during the Independence Day 250 parade. Is July Fourth really the best day to trash the very FIRST Amendment to the American Constitution? Socialists must control the media and other freedoms of speech to promote their bad ideas, again, straight out of the Rules.Add to the 250th anniversary celebration of our Declaration of Independence that Lander parade-goers – including kids – were handed free condoms by the local LGBT advocacy group. Since when are free condoms protected by the Constitution while Bibles are not? What do all of these outrages have in common? They are perpetuated by people who hate everything about our nation and culture. They hate anything like the Wyoming Freedom Caucus, and anyone like Donald Trump, for promoting free markets, less burdensome government, justice and liberty for all. Socialism/Communism -- flip a coin -- is focused on creating a "utopia" in which seizing wealth and killing prosperity allows everyone to live in equal misery. Our founding fathers were wise in understanding human nature and choosing a republican form of government, which thrives with free markets. When markets are free and the people are moral, the economy soars and folks share prosperity with their less fortunate neighbors. This system has led to the greatest and most compassionate nation on earth with a record of helping and improving the quality of life for all of humanity. Something we SHOULD be proud of! Every Marxist advance has led to failure of productivity, starvation and mass death. Well over 100 million people perished in the name of Marxism (Socialism, Communism -- potato, po-tah-to) during the 20th century. Even Wyoming Democrats refuse to distance themselves from these avowed communists who hate America (Zohran Mamdani, Graham Platner, Melat Kiros, AOC, and Bernie Sanders). Wyoming Democrats lead the attacks on the Wyoming Freedom Caucus while supporting the same Republican candidates who think your inalienable rights should be conditional. If you believe they will stop before coming for your guns and property, you haven't studied history. The leader of Gillette's Parks and Recreation department is a Republican candidate for the Wyoming State Senate. The staffer who made the decision to prohibit passing out U.S. Constitutions on our nation's 250th birthday is campaign manager for a Republican candidate for the Wyoming House. Misdirection from Saul Alinsky's Rules for Radicals rides again. Donald Trump is hardly the one inciting the new "Red Scare." Not when even Wyoming Democrats and weak sauce Republicans are advancing Saul Alinsky's radical principles right here in the heart of the American West.How long before Wyoming elects a socialist? It could be sooner than later if they run as Republicans.

**RADIO CLIP OF THE WEEK** **Pennsylvania Freedom Caucus member State Senator Dawn Keefer** is calling out the mindset that keeps Harrisburg's budget growing year after year — and it's not just the Democrats. Keefer recounted what a Republican colleague told her about the budget fight: _"Well, we know we're gonna spend more every year. It's a matter of what we get for it."_ Read that again. That's not negotiating — that's conceding the entire premise before the fight even starts. If your opening position is that spending _will_ go up and the only question is who gets the goodies, you've stopped being a check on government growth and become a co-manager of it. Keefer and the PA Freedom Caucus reject that framing outright: the goal is a smaller, leaner budget that actually shrinks the size and scope of state government — not a bigger one with Republican fingerprints on the line items. And the caucus put its votes where its mouth is: every PAFC member voted against Harrisburg's $50.85 billion budget, which spends nearly 6% above revenue.That's the difference between fighting and surrendering.

The **Illinois Freedom Caucus** has [led the fight](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjje1FSLOmngMfDTSplae3iyhVCT5No7yXCXqoA0Mxc45Uwyh8gV3q-2BisE3LpNiThL5xz9e7hkBxmHPwG-2FNhT0qUD4AE3V9ktHD5ISeVk4dEjIL8g0iXPz26xhERwvJGsZA-3D-3DhQCv_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerbin7uKQR4cImcRkDcFzmcyrW8-2BgXsOdQhnU-2F1QzYWiVhMhonEvFQG5lsvDGNgk9PFOqmmIk-2FhsTHnYZVdACykOaljgH6z80clRRlxxFJAOg157xQbRxh-2BGoZj1IXzLtgA2KcvC-2FBWPtqUQEfhnqTeCjzlGAZ-2BtJczf-2FvqyucCLGkLBMqQMHWCouDA4uDh5RsV-2Fgus7b4m0-2FAek5z8KkJQN-2FpwxdoPgt2-2Byf17lFSewM-3D) against this boondoggle from the start, calling in April for the commission to be dismantled as "a multi-million dollar failure for taxpayers." ⚡️**WEST VIRGINIA:** The **West Virginia Freedom Caucus** is [calling on](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjja-2FX-2BHiJMkQeHavsUeprX-2B7fu9AKqVhVzCF6oL-2Fny0AferrNtPWMTDOvwap0Kudt9qCXvQbh-2FedNJWeAqrBmCE-3DC3OF_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerbin7uKQR4cImcRkDcFzmcyrW8-2BgXsOdQhnU-2F1QzYWiVhMhonEvFQG5lsvDGNgk9PFOqmmIk-2FhsTHnYZVdACykOaljgH6z80clRRlxxFJAOhTTYuthIHr-2FleF7X0s69Cj1HVKrie8WqfRxHmi5JzLtD-2FIGKyUwGph-2F7OBaenD6K2eCQtwlwZYN3Yl8mFLeiaws-2BTDZ-2BlhkW-2FDBxcR9W-2BV7v9eeQZx6RZFqLyKT2fvXZg-3D) localities statewide to remove Flock license plate reader cameras and is vowing to force passage of the Fourth Amendment Restoration Act, which would ban warrantless mass-surveillance tech and has stalled in the Legislature two years running. "No state or local government should be mass tracking the daily movements of law-abiding citizens without a warrant," said Chairman Delegate Chris Anders. ⚡️**MISSOURI:** **Missouri Freedom Caucus alum Denny Hoskins** is delivering on his election integrity promises as Secretary of State: his office [announced this week](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjqV-2BFIHGa6YM5wdEXFWsoyLcyiFop0g7fz3xV7wn8M7aKH1c1gAsDy-2BdpW2Hmab8iQ-3D-3DnkpL_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerbin7uKQR4cImcRkDcFzmcyrW8-2BgXsOdQhnU-2F1QzYWiVhMhonEvFQG5lsvDGNgk9PFOqmmIk-2FhsTHnYZVdACykOaljgH6z80clRRlxxFJAOhbSkK7Ns-2FtSNpC3N2mSJShHKQXwN3BNB0iO04K-2B-2B0T16bRThot6Dbm1SnXTiBxiM5JDSgxPl7RB9z0W3hoh3CSNKlNGq0crG0SsOsk5NjGJeflnVhfVj3XvZbPVTrt6XI-3D) that 280,000 ineligible voters have been removed from Missouri's voter rolls under his watch. Hoskins made election integrity a centerpiece of his campaign, and this is what it looks like when a Freedom Caucus member takes those principles from the legislature into statewide office. Clean rolls are the foundation of elections voters can trust — and Missouri just got 280,000 entries cleaner.

That's the work, and it doesn't take weeks off. See you next week. In the meantime, the men and women in your State Freedom Caucuses will keep fighting.

clean_body: | | | | | Dear Friend, We typically don't share op-eds in our weekly email, printed in full, but this one is worth your time.Wyoming Freedom Caucus's Rep. John Bear asks a question below that sounds unthinkable: how long before Wyoming — one of the reddest states in America — elects a socialist? His answer is worth thinking about. It could be sooner than later. From a Denver congressional nomination to a Maine Senate primary to bureaucrats banning Constitutions at an Independence Day parade, Bear traces how radical ideas advance not by winning arguments but by wearing down, misdirecting, and infiltrating — sometimes under a Republican banner. Swap out the places and the names and this piece could be written about any of the 50 states. It's worth remembering as it pertains to our own backyards, our own communities, and our own states — because no deep red legislature, county commission, or parks department is immune. | How Long Before Wyoming Elects A Socialist?By Wyoming Freedom Caucus member, State Rep. John Bear Rules for Radicals is a book published in 1971 by Saul Alinsky, a radical leftist community activist who wrote from his decades of pro-Communist organizing efforts. Alinsky died shortly after its publication, but Rules for Radicals has lived on, even shaping today's neo-Marxist reunion tour now sweeping Blue states and universities near you. In a recent article published in Salon, the headline reads, "Trump Revives the Red Scare," accusing the president of reviving the old wave of anti-communism from the 1950s. Actually, I don't think President Trump is the originator of the most recent "Red Scare" at all – not when today's Democrat Party is doing such a fine job on its own. Last month, Democrats in Denver nominated a self-declared Socialist for U.S. Congress on her promises to deliver Soviet-style free stuff for everyone. Her empty, laughable promises are covered by Alinsky rules 1 and 2. Maine Democrats nominated a loser Communist (his word, not mine) with the added bonus of a Nazi tattoo to represent them in the U.S. Senate before deciding that serious, credible rape allegations (but not his Nazism or Communism) made him unfit for that office. Nevertheless, it is conservatives who the left brands "Nazis" and "Christian Nationalists", per Alinsky's rules 3-5. On July 3, New York Mayor, radical Islamist, trust fund baby and avowed Socialist Zohran Mamdani delivered a speech from George Washington's desk, where he attacked everything about America on its birthday. When did "Make America Great Again" become dirty words, and "the warmth of collectivism" become okay? Pure Alinsky. And lest we think Wyoming is above all this, Gillette, Wyoming's community organizations were barred by Campbell County Parks & Recreation officials from handing out U.S. Constitutions and Bibles during the Independence Day 250 parade. Is July Fourth really the best day to trash the very FIRST Amendment to the American Constitution? Socialists must control the media and other freedoms of speech to promote their bad ideas, again, straight out of the Rules.Add to the 250th anniversary celebration of our Declaration of Independence that Lander parade-goers – including kids – were handed free condoms by the local LGBT advocacy group. Since when are free condoms protected by the Constitution while Bibles are not? What do all of these outrages have in common? They are perpetuated by people who hate everything about our nation and culture. They hate anything like the Wyoming Freedom Caucus, and anyone like Donald Trump, for promoting free markets, less burdensome government, justice and liberty for all. Socialism/Communism -- flip a coin -- is focused on creating a "utopia" in which seizing wealth and killing prosperity allows everyone to live in equal misery. Our founding fathers were wise in understanding human nature and choosing a republican form of government, which thrives with free markets. When markets are free and the people are moral, the economy soars and folks share prosperity with their less fortunate neighbors. This system has led to the greatest and most compassionate nation on earth with a record of helping and improving the quality of life for all of humanity. Something we SHOULD be proud of! Every Marxist advance has led to failure of productivity, starvation and mass death. Well over 100 million people perished in the name of Marxism (Socialism, Communism -- potato, po-tah-to) during the 20th century. Even Wyoming Democrats refuse to distance themselves from these avowed communists who hate America (Zohran Mamdani, Graham Platner, Melat Kiros, AOC, and Bernie Sanders). Wyoming Democrats lead the attacks on the Wyoming Freedom Caucus while supporting the same Republican candidates who think your inalienable rights should be conditional. If you believe they will stop before coming for your guns and property, you haven't studied history. The leader of Gillette's Parks and Recreation department is a Republican candidate for the Wyoming State Senate. The staffer who made the decision to prohibit passing out U.S. Constitutions on our nation's 250th birthday is campaign manager for a Republican candidate for the Wyoming House. Misdirection from Saul Alinsky's Rules for Radicals rides again. Donald Trump is hardly the one inciting the new "Red Scare." Not when even Wyoming Democrats and weak sauce Republicans are advancing Saul Alinsky's radical principles right here in the heart of the American West.How long before Wyoming elects a socialist? It could be sooner than later if they run as Republicans. | RADIO CLIP OF THE WEEK Pennsylvania Freedom Caucus member State Senator Dawn Keefer is calling out the mindset that keeps Harrisburg's budget growing year after year — and it's not just the Democrats. Keefer recounted what a Republican colleague told her about the budget fight: "Well, we know we're gonna spend more every year. It's a matter of what we get for it." Read that again. That's not negotiating — that's conceding the entire premise before the fight even starts. If your opening position is that spending will go up and the only question is who gets the goodies, you've stopped being a check on government growth and become a co-manager of it. Keefer and the PA Freedom Caucus reject that framing outright: the goal is a smaller, leaner budget that actually shrinks the size and scope of state government — not a bigger one with Republican fingerprints on the line items. And the caucus put its votes where its mouth is: every PAFC member voted against Harrisburg's $50.85 billion budget, which spends nearly 6% above revenue.That's the difference between fighting and surrendering. 🎧 Subscribe on (or on your preferred podcast platform)📣 Follow us on X \- 🎵 Follow us on TikTok \- 👍 Follow us on Facebook \- | QUICK HITS ⚡️Illinois: The head of Illinois' troubled Commission on Equity and Inclusion, Alexandria Wilson, has quietly moved to another $154,000 state job after investigative reporting exposed the agency's failures. The Illinois Freedom Caucus has against this boondoggle from the start, calling in April for the commission to be dismantled as "a multi-million dollar failure for taxpayers." ⚡️WEST VIRGINIA: The West Virginia Freedom Caucus is localities statewide to remove Flock license plate reader cameras and is vowing to force passage of the Fourth Amendment Restoration Act, which would ban warrantless mass-surveillance tech and has stalled in the Legislature two years running. "No state or local government should be mass tracking the daily movements of law-abiding citizens without a warrant," said Chairman Delegate Chris Anders. ⚡️MISSOURI: Missouri Freedom Caucus alum Denny Hoskins is delivering on his election integrity promises as Secretary of State: his office that 280,000 ineligible voters have been removed from Missouri's voter rolls under his watch. Hoskins made election integrity a centerpiece of his campaign, and this is what it looks like when a Freedom Caucus member takes those principles from the legislature into statewide office. Clean rolls are the foundation of elections voters can trust — and Missouri just got 280,000 entries cleaner. | WE NEED YOUR HELP TO KEEP THE MOMENTUM The fights above look different on the surface — a budget in Harrisburg, cameras in Charleston, voter rolls in Jefferson City, an indictment in Springfield — but they're the same fight: holding government accountable to the people it serves, whether the people standing in the way have a D or an R next to their name. That's the work, and it doesn't take weeks off. See you next week. In the meantime, the men and women in your State Freedom Caucuses will keep fighting. We'll be back with another update soon. Until then, please be sure to our efforts so that we can support our State Freedom Caucuses!In Liberty, Andy RothPresidentState Freedom Caucus Network | |

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Donald Trump is trying to pressure the USPS to deliver handguns through the mail in Cresco. I need your help to fight back.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends,
The Trump Administration is pressuring the USPS to allow people to mail handguns for the first time.
For the past 99 years, federal law has banned the Postal Service from mailing handguns. The commonsense law has helped keep our families safe and minimize the amount of untraceable guns.
Donald Trump wants to change that. Earlier this year, his Department of Justice decided to suddenly stop enforcing the commonsense law and demanded the Postal Service prepare to start delivering handguns.
Let me be clear: The only people benefitting from this change are criminals and Trump’s gun manufacturing buddies. The rest of us will be left in more danger.
GIFFORDS is working to push back and demand the USPS not deliver handguns in Cresco and across the country, but we cannot continue this fight alone.
**[Will you please chip in $10 to help GIFFORDS get the resources to continue standing up against the Trump administration?](https://go.giffords.org/go/65324?c0=giff-em-q32026.dTscjt&refcode=em260717-1-b&t=1&akid=11643%2E3935704%2Eh1VeUW)**

name: Elisabeth Wales
subject: Helena Weekly Update + Upcoming Volunteer Opportunities!
body:
[image: image.png]

Welcome to the Helena for Rhode Island Newsletter! Each week the newsletter
will feature campaign updates and volunteer opportunities.

With less than two months until the primary, Team Helena has been busier
than ever and growing each week. Our amazing interns have been dropping off
yard signs across the state, our volunteers have cheered Helena on at the
Bristol Fourth of July parade, and this week we opened the doors to our
Broad Street office. Keep an eye on the Volunteer Opportunities and Ways to
Support Helena section of the weekly newsletter to see how you can get
involved!

A Message to the Community

Eric Hyers, Helena for RI Campaign Strategist, on the false attacks on
Helena and the road ahead:

As one of Helena’s strongest supporters, we wanted to share a strategic
update as we enter the final 60 days of the race. It’s been a busy few
weeks with Helena continuing to earn big endorsements, the Rhode Island
Democratic State Committee making the rare decision of refusing to endorse
a sitting incumbent governor, and McKee choosing to drag the campaign into
the gutter with false TV ads.

Helena is a straight shooter; she’s honest and transparent and is willing
to take any criticism head on. That’s why we went up with two ads this week
directly calling out the lies from Gov McKee and making clear what he’s
really doing—spreading misinformation and attacking CVS, Rhode Island’s
largest private employer, in a desperate attempt to save his own political
career.

Thanks to so many of you, we have the financial resources to respond. So we
are. McKee’s attacks are shameless lies and exactly what people are so
tired of in our politics.

You can check out our response ads here:

Led the Charge <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w-1zFA5W-Us>

People’s Health <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l3LI_pKnfKM>

Meanwhile, new economic rankings came out this week, and they’re not good.
Rhode Island ranks dead last for our economy, 48th for our business
environment, last for roads and bridges, and last in new homes being
constructed—all while there is not a single community in which a Rhode
Islander making $100,000 a year can afford to buy a home.

Helena is running because she’s an optimist and a fighter who loves Rhode
Island and knows we can do better.

We’re also up with social media ads that share her vision for our state.
It’s because of your generosity that we can afford to advertise across
multiple platforms to reach Rhode Islanders however they consume
information.

No matter where the Governor is spreading lies about Helena, we will be
there to meet him with the truth.

Volunteer Opportunities and Ways to Support Helena

-

Request a Helena yard sign using this form
<https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1jqqM1BwqBDNcXcpgJiLjkgeUVF2CGgdUf8Eii33I2iI/viewform?ts=6a233105&edit_requested=true>
, and her team will deliver them to your door!
-

Come table for Helena
<https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScp5pk-8KQ0lT9WOnesiAsU_6tuVGJ29VLoHAls87PV3_6v_A/viewform?usp=header>
at the Puerto Rican Festival this Sunday, July 19! The event will feature
wonderful food, culture, and music, so you won’t want to miss it. Meet us
at India Point Park and be a part of the fun.
-

SAVE THE DATE: Colombian Independence Festival, Saturday July 25 (all
day). RSVP form with volunteer sign up slots available soon.
-

Share why you are supporting Helena by clicking this link
<https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeXoj5Pkf1q1rNWh0wVL1Qi6fYhv27n1bXidKjLUylERZNzIw/viewform?usp=header>.
Need inspiration? Read Leenah’s reflection below!

Volunteer Spotlight: Leenah Gibbs
[image: b378e87c-a351-45fd-8f1e-c58b25b1bdb8.JPG]

“Why Helena?” Story Series

My name is Leenah Gibbs, and I am a 21-year-old rising senior at Trinity
College. Born and raised in Rhode Island, my love for this state was shaped
by its people and the strong sense of community that makes it such a
special place. As I prepared for my senior year, I wanted to spend my
summer at home doing work that was both meaningful and inspiring. It was
that desire that led me to intern with the Helena Buonanno Foulkes Campaign.

Although I wasn't familiar with Helena prior to joining the campaign, over
the course of the summer I have witnessed the passion, dedication, and
genuine care she brings to every community she visits. In every
interaction, public outing, or outreach, Helena has carried herself with
grace, humility, and genuine respect for those around her. She motivates
her team to give their best, not simply because they are expected to, but
because they feel appreciated and empowered to do so.

What has stood out to me most is the deep culture of respect,
collaboration, and kindness that her leadership cultivates throughout the
entire campaign team and staff. At each level of organization, her
community investment is reflected in how the team operates. Each day, I
have been surrounded by those committed both to the campaign's mission and
to uplifting one another, a quality that has made this hard work
worthwhile. Under the leadership of our Volunteer Director Elisabeth Wales,
every intern and volunteer is encouraged to contribute, ask questions, and
grow. The welcoming, supportive environment she has curated is a direct
reflection of the values that Helena continues to model and enforce.

Through this experience, I have gained a deeper understanding of public
service as not only advocating for your community but also valuing the
building of authentic relationships and creating one's own safe space. The
friendships I've built, the lessons I've learned, and the opportunities to
connect with Rhode Islanders from all walks of life have made this summer
truly unforgettable. Being part of the Helena Buonanno Foulkes Campaign has
strengthened my commitment to giving back to the state that’s given me so
much. I am incredibly grateful for this experience and proud to support not
just a campaign, but a leader who continues to exemplify a culture of
service and teamwork for the future of Rhode Island.

[image: image.png]

subject: “Out Gunned Under Siege”

body:
It took me a long time to get this right

# **Trump declassifies election security documents, alleges Chinese influence campaign**
President Donald Trump **[addressed the nation Thursday from the East Room,](https://substack.com/redirect/d0bca5c1-c4a4-4cc6-9577-abd92eb1f309?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** releasing declassified intelligence documents alleging China obtained American voter data, including names, addresses, political affiliations, and phone numbers, and used it to form a dedicated unit for influence operations. # **DSA publishes manifesto calling to abolish Senate, Electoral College, and presidency**
The Democratic Socialists of America **[released a sweeping political manifesto](https://substack.com/redirect/d31125c4-6277-4ecd-84f4-32b7897a4d50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** titled "Workers Deserve More," calling for the elimination of the Senate, Electoral College, and presidency and replacing them with a European-style parliamentary system. Under the proposal, an expanded House of Representatives would select both the executive and members of the Supreme Court, stripping those institutions of their independence from the legislative branch.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d31125c4-6277-4ecd-84f4-32b7897a4d50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The manifesto calls for public ownership of the nation 's largest corporations and essential industries,** aggressive wealth taxes on the richest Americans, and proportional representation and ranked-choice voting in all elections. DSA drafters argued the Senate is undemocratic because it gives equal representation to states regardless of population, and that the presidency has accumulated too much unilateral power.
* **Additional proposals include defunding the Defense Department,** abolishing ICE, and eliminating Israel while recognizing Jerusalem as the capital of a Palestinian state. The DSA acknowledged some goals would require "building a new society from the ground up."

body:

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [|

| | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/s74AtIu4hgJ?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720)
| | Hi Peter,
In 1971, three out of four members of Congress had worn the uniform. Today, it's less than one in five. That decline of military veterans in Congress is significant. Data shows that veterans in Congress are [35 to 46 percent more effective](https://us.list-manage.com/13jEfoGd31s?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720) at moving legislation and significantly more likely to work across party lines.
With Honor Co-Founder & CEO Rye Barcott joined Michael Smerconish to discuss his new book, [_Courage Can Save US_](https://us.list-manage.com/l329Ek05dny?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720) , and why we need to rethink how America builds a culture of service, both in and out of uniform. The research shows that shared sacrifice—whether in the military or through national service—creates something our polarized politics desperately lacks: a common mission larger than yourself.
Listen to the full interview [here](https://us.list-manage.com/JdO5b3N18D7?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720).

|
---
| |

# **The MOLD Act: Protecting Military Families at Home**
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/9q6B3Jc3Zae?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720)
| | Many military families live in housing provided by privatized contractors, and there continue to be significant problems with unsafe living conditions in many of the houses. The systemic failures include inconsistent inspections, poor contractor accountability, and even the use of non-disclosure agreements to silence tenant concerns.
With Honor Action is advocating for the passage of the Military Occupancy Living Defense (MOLD) Act, [H.R. 7188](https://us.list-manage.com/LKKqS1hdw_m?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720) / [S. 3654](https://us.list-manage.com/O2iaERlrii5?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720), led by Founding For Country Caucus Co-Chair **Rep. Jimmy Panetta** alongside Reps. Gus Bilirakis and James Moylan, and Sens. Richard Blumenthal, **With** **Honor Action allies Joni Ernst and Tim Sheehy** , and Mazie Hirono.

The proposed legislation would implement new, comprehensive standards for privately-contracted military housing across the Department of Defense (DoD), including establishing DoD-wide acceptable humidity level requirements, mandating third-party inspections whenever a tenant moves in or out, and, in response to tenant complaints, creating a 24/7 hotline for reporting hazards and submitting complaints, and introducing penalties for noncompliance, such as imposing fees or allowing tenants to retain their Basic Allowance for Housing. The MOLD Act was successfully included as a provision in the draft of the Senate FY27 National Defense Authorization Act, but continued advocacy is needed to ensure its inclusion in the final negotiated bill.

body:
He’s a teacher running for Congress to bring down costs, take on corruption, and invest in the places being left behind.
#
Peter,
**I’m proud to endorse Jake Johnson for Congress in Minnesota’s 1st Congressional District.**
Jake is a teacher running to lift up the small towns of Southern Minnesota that robber barons like Elon Musk and the Trump administration are trying to gut. [**Can you help him win by splitting a donation between his campaign and Small Town PAC today?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260717-jj.0zumEi&amount=5&refcode=em20260717-870&t=2&akid=870%2E34582%2EsGeAFT)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260717-jj.0zumEi&amount=5&refcode=20260717-870&t=3&akid=870%2E34582%2EsGeAFT)**
Before I was governor, I used to represent this very district in Congress. I know what folks there actually care about. They want real investments in our communities that will make life affordable. They want a farm bill that works for everyone, not just massive corporations. _And they want to protect the vital services Jake’s opponent voted to gut in Trump’s budget._
**Instead of a far-right politician who acts as a rubber stamp for Donald Trump and the MAGA agenda, this district deserves a real leader who will fight for working families.** That’s _exactly_ who Jake Johnson is.
Jake was raised by hard-working parents in Stewartville alongside ten siblings. Growing up, times were tough, but they got by thanks to life-saving programs like SNAP and Medicaid, along with help from his small-town community, his church, and his teachers. He mowed lawns and received Pell Grants to afford college, and went on to teach K-12 math in Rochester Public Schools.
He’s served his community as an educator, going above and beyond as a bargaining team member for his union and a Governmental Relations Coordinator to improve the lives of people around him. Now, he wants to serve them in Washington so he can fight to bring down costs, take on corruption, and invest in the places being left behind.
**Jake feels the same call to service that I did when I first ran for office. When leaders like him step up, we have to have their back.**
He’s running to flip a Republican-held district this November — which won’t be easy, but I truly believe Jake is the candidate who can do it.
[**Peter, will you join me in supporting Jake by splitting $5 between his campaign and Small Town PAC to help him flip this seat and fight for our small towns?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260717-jj.0zumEi&amount=5&refcode=em20260717-870&t=4&akid=870%2E34582%2EsGeAFT)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260717-jj.0zumEi&amount=5&refcode=20260717-870&t=23&akid=870%2E34582%2EsGeAFT)**
Thank you,
Tim Walz

Together, we're finding and recruiting thoughtful, hardworking people to run for office, and supporting a new generation of leaders who truly reflect and understand their communities.
**[It’s time for Democrats to expand the map and put small towns back at the forefront: pitch in now to help build our movement from the ground up.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-footer?refcode=em20260717-870&t=24&refcode2=870_34582_sGeAFT&akid=870%2E34582%2EsGeAFT)**

_U.S.[ escalates](https://substack.com/redirect/f79d43f2-da8f-4ddf-91bb-2459a3997198?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) strikes on Iran. Iran [widens](https://substack.com/redirect/d8857e89-6c12-4f72-a4f5-a9a37e04b799?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its retaliatory attacks. Iran's UN ambassador [condemns](https://substack.com/redirect/7173c4ae-42e5-4fc5-90f8-d08ee68d0aa8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) U.S. attacks on civilian infrastructure as "war crimes." Oil market [burning](https://substack.com/redirect/db98ce70-6877-4a8a-83bd-15238e2e8ea8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) through its emergency stocks, threatening wider shock. U.S. Vice President JD Vance [responds](https://substack.com/redirect/de4bc42a-0a49-4c74-9aff-63bba2e877e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Drop Site's reporting on Iran, Kushner, and Witkoff. Israel [continues](https://substack.com/redirect/ff5f8f33-c95b-42b7-8464-6a58cba7698e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) violating Lebanon ceasefire with overnight attacks. Israel [kills](https://substack.com/redirect/d4e91a75-c5fc-4789-a1ab-f363ff92c86b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 14 in attacks on Gaza. Israel [pushes](https://substack.com/redirect/7e11cd7b-b89d-42f5-88c1-9eba663dafe4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its "Yellow Line" to Gaza's main north-south artery. Israeli guards [beat](https://substack.com/redirect/4c686949-1d16-47be-a740-23c596022088?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Palestinian physician and denied him medical care. Gaza flotilla participant [files](https://substack.com/redirect/763a16a3-75b0-42a4-9176-36f494962cce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) rape complaint against Israeli prison guards. [Al Jazeera](https://substack.com/redirect/c504f73c-46ed-4f20-bbac-a298be9a2f1e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): Undercover investigation exposes alleged UK and Canadian funding of illegal Israeli settlements. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio [launches](https://substack.com/redirect/086e1341-7a63-4e81-a8f6-9677190dbee9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) major push against "far-left terrorists," says new designations are coming soon. ICE agent who [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/854298d0-d2f0-485d-99cd-27041cc61b38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) man in Maine accused of violent, troubled past. Rep. Ilhan Omar [pushes](https://substack.com/redirect/89482e99-b911-494f-8696-4662ba591550?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) U.S. to join the ICC. Court-appointed UAW monitor [pressured](https://substack.com/redirect/574a1c26-56c9-482b-b67f-329e8ab77205?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Fain over Gaza. Trump Media to [charge](https://substack.com/redirect/887f9808-abcb-40f3-a85f-2d0d6a8d51e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for quicker access to Truth Social posts. # Iran and Ceasefire
* **U.S. escalates strikes on Iran** : The U.S. military escalated its assault on Iran late Thursday and early Friday, hitting targets across the country, including civilian infrastructure, for the sixth straight night.
* The U.S. [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/f79d43f2-da8f-4ddf-91bb-2459a3997198?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at least six bridges, a railway junction, an airport, and a telecommunications tower in the country's south, according to officials in the Hormozgan province. One of these attacks, on the Bandar-e-Khamir bridge, [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/a7a8840e-0f7f-4929-b7ca-bcf8eb81db74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at least seven and wounded nine others, according to Fars News agency.
* Iran's energy ministry [confirmed](https://substack.com/redirect/d506bd42-68d0-40b0-bc47-e80ad6cb20dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) damage to power lines in the area of Bandar Abbas and said that electricity had been restored in some areas and that the country's grid had been stabilized.
* The U.S. also [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/cb170796-13de-4323-8a47-a556081f9a3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a maritime control tower in the southern city of Chabahar for a third time in a week, according to Iran's Mehr news agency.
* The U.S. [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/ffce5c32-6077-4d40-8e13-d4fe35191f33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Qeshm Island on Thursday evening, Iranian media confirmed.
* Explosions were reported across other southern and southwestern sites, including Sirik and Bushehr, and farther west in the oil-rich Khuzestan province, Ahvaz, Behbahan, Hamidiyeh, Susangerd, and the Karoun area. Explosions were also [heard](https://substack.com/redirect/ffce5c32-6077-4d40-8e13-d4fe35191f33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the Lorestan province, and civilian infrastructure was reportedly damaged in the northern province of Semnan.
* Additionally, CENTCOM [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/dbe022fe-5033-4afd-9f87-4591595320c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that U.S. Marines boarded the tanker M/T Wen Yao in the Gulf of Oman as part of Washington's renewed naval blockade of Iran, which it claims had redirected three commercial vessels and disabled one that refused to comply.
* Iranian Health Ministry spokesperson Hossein Kermanpour [said](https://substack.com/redirect/2a29cf81-aeb1-4a94-a0b6-7d5e7f934937?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on X that renewed U.S. airstrikes have killed at least 38 people and wounded more than 400 so far in July.
* **Iran widens its retaliatory attacks:** Iran launched attacks on U.S. military installations in the Gulf, hitting targets in Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, and Bahrain. It also widened its range of targets, hitting locations in Jordan, Syria, and Iraq.
* Iran [launched](https://substack.com/redirect/d8857e89-6c12-4f72-a4f5-a9a37e04b799?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Arash attack drones at the Isa Air Base in Bahrain, its army reported, targeting U.S. helicopters and reconnaissance aircraft.
* Iran [attacked](https://substack.com/redirect/ae73a6a1-e6b0-4d3b-9d77-4502f4d8ccbc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a base in Kuwait, claiming to have targeted its defensive radar capacities, weapons depot, HIMARS launchers, and missile stockpile. Kuwait [said](https://substack.com/redirect/2efe3c5f-6bd1-4f17-b8e6-77766bf9a18e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Friday one of its power generation and water desalination plants was hit in what it called a "sinful Iranian attack," sparking a fire and damaging the facility and several electricity generation units.
* Iranian missiles [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/c3cf4e59-dd06-4934-978d-493363c3d1d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Qatar, with debris from one attack injuring a child, according to the country's Interior Ministry. The country's Defense Ministry reported multiple missile interceptions on Thursday and Friday, and condemned Iran for its "sinful aggression." Iran's Revolutionary Guard claimed to have destroyed a "long-range radar system" and several military targets in an attack on the U.S. Al-Udeid Air Base in Qatar.
* The Iranian Revolutionary Guard also [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/9f7f51c9-1a4e-4da7-bdbb-f8103606a026?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that it carried out a "surprise attack" on a U.S.-led coalition special operations center in Al-Tanf, southern Syria. The U.S. announced that it had left Al-Tanf in February, and it is not clear whether any U.S. personnel were at the facility at the time of the attack.
* The Iranian navy [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/7f386d6e-234e-48db-9d26-73c0fe999467?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) early on Friday that it had targeted a maritime-control radar installation on Oman's As Salamah islands and air-control radar in Oman's Ghanam region.
* Iraqi authorities said five drones struck the city of Erbil on Thursday, adding that two of these crashed and one was shot down. Satellite imagery published by an open-source intelligence account [suggests](https://substack.com/redirect/ee3bf0d7-ffb4-4211-b5b1-e95694c89d45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that an Iranian Shahed drone hit a U.S. Patriot missile launcher in the city, though no official confirmation has been issued and Iran's military had not claimed responsibility for the attack.
* Satellite imagery [published](https://substack.com/redirect/3394ee08-04fd-4459-8324-3615ed5edb39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Thursday by the mapping firm Soar appeared to contradict earlier claims by the UAE that a fire at the Zayed Military City was on July 13 "accidental," potentially adding to the list of confirmed Iranian strikes over the course of the last week.
* **Iran 's ambassador condemns U.S. attacks on civilian infrastructure as "war crimes":** Amir Saeid Iravani, Iran's UN ambassador, [condemned](https://substack.com/redirect/7173c4ae-42e5-4fc5-90f8-d08ee68d0aa8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) U.S. attacks on Iranian civilian infrastructure as "acts of aggression" and "war crimes" in a letter to the UN Secretary-General and the Security Council, accusing Washington of deliberately and illegally striking civilian targets.
* **Oil market burning through its emergency stocks, threatening wider shock:** Fatih Birol, the chief of the United States Energy Information Agency, warned Bloomberg about the danger of rising energy prices, telling the outlet the danger is "not months. It is weeks."
* IEA chief Fatih Birol [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/db98ce70-6877-4a8a-83bd-15238e2e8ea8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the U.S.'s historic 400-million-barrel emergency release helped push barrel prices down by $20.
* Birol also told Bloomberg that higher petroleum production from the U.S., Brazil, and Kazakhstan had also limited the shock, as did draws from the U.S.'s reserves, and Saudi and Emirati efforts to bypass Hormuz. But, he warned, none of these reprieves were "endless."
* The U.S. EIA has reported crude stocks at Oklahoma's Cushing facility fell below 20 million barrels in June and may continue to be near "tank bottoms," the minimum oil that must remain in tanks and pipelines for pumps to work.
* The analytics firm Kpler separately [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/dfc26ac3-4748-47ed-8690-409129340602?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Thursday that oil transit through the Strait of Hormuz had fallen by 62% to 4.1 million barrels a day, claiming that a full shutdown had been prevented by the use of alternate export routes and softer Chinese demand for petroleum, roughly corresponding to a similar report by Goldman Sachs analysts.
* The firm reported only eight crossings through the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, seven of which used the northern Iranian corridor.

* **Vance responds to Drop Site 's reporting: **Vice President**** JD Vance****[ denied](https://substack.com/redirect/de4bc42a-0a49-4c74-9aff-63bba2e877e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a Thursday report from Drop Site's Jeremy Scahill and Ryan Grim, in which a senior Iranian official said that Tehran sent Vance a private message warning that Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff were exploiting their access to U.S.-Iran negotiations for financial gain.
* "This is completely bogus. I never received a message like this," Vance wrote, calling the allegation that they traded on insider information "absurd," adding that "no one has done more" than Kushner and Witkoff "to work towards peace and prosperity" in the Middle East.

# Palestine
* **Israel kills 14 Palestinians in attacks on Gaza:** Israel [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/d4e91a75-c5fc-4789-a1ab-f363ff92c86b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 14 Palestinians and wounded at least 37 in separate attacks in Gaza on Friday, Al Jazeera reported.
* At least eight Palestinians were killed and 20 others wounded after an Israeli drone struck a group of Palestinians in the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, according to Gaza-based Safa News Agency. The strike targeted the gathering as the funeral procession of a Palestinian who had been killed earlier passed through the area.
* Israel struck an apartment building in Gaza City, killing one and wounding others.
* In northern Gaza, an Israeli drone strike in Beit Lahia killed a 52-year-old woman.
* One person was also killed and three others injured after an Israeli strike hit a makeshift shelter housing displaced people, west of the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza.
* **Israel pushes its "Yellow Line" to Gaza's main north-south artery: **Israeli forces [entered](https://substack.com/redirect/7e11cd7b-b89d-42f5-88c1-9eba663dafe4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Gaza City's Zeitoun neighborhood under heavy gunfire, killing one Palestinian, wounding three others, destroying homes and shops, and forcing families to flee, according to reporting from Drop Site contributor Mohamed Ahmed.
* By morning, they had pushed the "yellow line," the boundary marking the edge of Israeli military control, in violation of the October 2025 agreement, to Salah al-Din Road--the 45-kilometer artery connecting northern and southern Gaza and passing through every governorate.
* A witness described quadcopters and shelling surrounding displaced families overnight, forcing women to sleep in the street. "We don't know where to flee to," he said.
* Separately, on Thursday, senior military officials reportedly [told](https://substack.com/redirect/e7d097b7-73d5-4216-9f07-5e58bafc676f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Israel's Security Cabinet that Israel now controls between 67% and 70% of the Gaza Strip, according to the Jerusalem Post.
* **Israeli attacks in Gaza at highest level since October "ceasefire," conflict monitor reports: **Israeli attacks on Gaza [reached](https://substack.com/redirect/ce02ae5b-b562-4e37-a699-0f2aa01dc65b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) their highest level since the October 2025 agreement, according to the Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED) via Reuters.
* ACLED recorded more than 40 Israeli air and drone strikes in June--the highest monthly total since the truce.
* **Israeli guards beat Palestinian physician and denied him medical care:** Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya [told](https://substack.com/redirect/4c686949-1d16-47be-a740-23c596022088?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his lawyers on July 14 that Israeli prison guards beat him again following a previous legal visit on July 2, adding that he remains in solitary confinement in an underground prison and has been denied medical care for an injury to his right eye, according to Physicians for Human Rights Israel.
* "Do everything possible to get me out of this place," Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya told his lawyers, noting the discontinuation of his pain medication and a refusal to give him the results of a recently conducted X-ray.
* During the visit, Abu Safiya was concealed from his lawyers behind an opaque partition and forced to communicate by telephone while masked prison guards remained close enough to hear the conversation.
* Abu Safiya, the former director of Kamal Adwan Hospital, has been imprisoned without charge or trial since December 2024 after refusing to abandon his patients.
* **Gaza flotilla participant files rape complaint against Israeli prison guards:** Anna Liedtke, a 25-year-old activist aboard the Gaza-bound aid Freedom Flotilla, [filed](https://substack.com/redirect/763a16a3-75b0-42a4-9176-36f494962cce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a criminal complaint in Israel accusing female guards at Givon Prison of raping her during a forced strip search, according to The Guardian.
* Liedtke alleges guards forced her to her knees, restrained her and covered her mouth to stop her screams, while male guards watched and laughed. Israeli forces detained Liedtke after seizing her Gaza-bound aid ship in international waters on October 8, 2025, and held her for five days.
* Liedtke said the abuse was intended to intimidate activists into abandoning solidarity with Palestinians, adding that her assault was "way, way less than what Palestinian prisoners experience."
* More than a dozen other flotilla activists have also reported sexual assault. In May, Drop Site published Liedtke's first-person account, co-authored with journalist Noa Avishag Schnall, detailing their abduction and abuse. **Read[ here](https://substack.com/redirect/fae78da5-32c3-4c24-90fd-e12650a317f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
* **Channel 14 report shows Israeli officials praising Gaza 's destruction and displacement of Palestinians: **A new report by Israel's Channel 14 [features](https://substack.com/redirect/f29c22fd-f1eb-48e0-aa79-f3dd8e0bb0bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) senior Israeli government and military officials openly celebrating the destruction of large parts of Gaza and the mass killing and displacement of Palestinians.
* Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz said he felt "good" seeing neighborhoods such as Jabaliya and Shuja'iyya "destroyed" and "in ruins," describing the devastation as the result of a deliberate policy. He added that Israeli forces would not withdraw from the so-called "yellow line" unless Hamas disarms, saying: "And even after that, we will remain in Gaza!"
* Deputy Israeli military chief Maj. Gen. Tamir Yadai described the situation as a "victory," citing Israel's control of 65% of Gaza, claiming that "70,000 terrorists" had been killed.
* **Al Jazeera: Undercover investigation exposes UK and Canadian funding of illegal Israeli settlements:** An undercover investigation by Al-Jazeera says it has uncovered evidence that charities and donors in the United Kingdom and Canada are helping channel tax-deductible donations to Israeli settler organizations in the occupied West Bank, despite laws prohibiting charitable funds from supporting illegal settlements.
* Posing as prospective donors, Al Jazeera's undercover reporters were allegedly told by pro-settler organisations that donations could be routed through registered charities before being used to expand settlements, campaign for the demolition of Palestinian homes, and provide military-grade equipment, including drones, to settlers.
* Watch the full investigation by Al Jazeera [here](https://substack.com/redirect/c504f73c-46ed-4f20-bbac-a298be9a2f1e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

* **Marco Rubio launches major push against "far-left terrorists," says new designations are coming soon:** Speaking at a conference attended by officials from more than 60 countries, Secretary of State **Marco Rubio** said that the U.S. is building an "international counterterrorism coalition" focused on transnational far-left networks, alleging links to Iranian proxies and Cuba. Rubio promised further terrorist designations and coordinated intelligence, law enforcement, and financial action.
* Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the government is examining nonprofits and charities for alleged illicit financing, foreign influence, and tax-exempt abuse, while claiming a "new operational alliance" between "international Marxism and radical Islamic movements."
* Homeland Security Adviser Stephen Miller said NSPM-7 would be used to debank, defund, and disrupt left-wing groups, dismissing civil-liberties objections and calling them "enemies of civilization."

* It also released new visa rules for foreign students, journalists, and cultural exchange visitors. Student and cultural exchange visas would be limited to four years. Visas for foreign journalists will be cut down from five years to 240 days, and just 90 days for Chinese journalists.
* **Trump uses televised address to allege Chinese interference in 2020 election:** In a primetime [address](https://substack.com/redirect/000128fa-bb5d-42fa-86bd-b24595f9eb67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Thursday evening, President Trump made a series of unsubstantiated claims about the 2020 election and claimed he was "declassifying" additional documents that would corroborate what he called "shocking vulnerabilities in our election infrastructure."
* Several networks, including ABC and NBC, refused to carry the speech (but streamed it online), which Trump criticized during his remarks, calling it "part of a plot."
* He also addressed the war in Iran, saying that the U.S. was "winning big" and promising his audience that they would "see the fruits of that labor very, very shortly."
* **ICE agent who killed man in Maine accused of violent, troubled past:** The ICE agent who shot and [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/854298d0-d2f0-485d-99cd-27041cc61b38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 26-year-old **Johan Sebasti an Duran Guerrero** in Biddeford, Maine, on Monday has been identified as **David Michael Brouillette** , 37, a former Maine law enforcement officer and Army veteran, the Portland Press Herald reported.
* His ex-wife, **Ashley Brouillette** , said he called her and admitted to the shooting and asked her to "lie for him."
* Ashley Brouillette also alleged that her ex-husband was abusive during their relationship and that she had previously reported concerns about his mental health to his military superiors. DHS has refused to confirm his identity.
* **Rep. Ilhan Omar pushes U.S. to join ICC:** Rep.**Ilhan Omar** [introduced](https://substack.com/redirect/89482e99-b911-494f-8696-4662ba591550?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a resolution on Thursday urging the United States to join the International Criminal Court, The Guardian reports, marking the first congressional pushback against **Rubio** 's pledge to "systematically disable" the war crimes tribunal.
* "The ICC is a crucial tool for justice in places where victims have nowhere else to turn," Omar said. "No one is above the law."
* The resolution comes after the Trump administration imposed waves of sanctions on the court and its officials over its investigations into Israeli war crimes in Gaza and the West Bank. 125 countries recognize the ICC.

* **Court-appointed UAW monitor pressures Fain over Gaza:** The Detroit News reported on Thursday that **Neil Barofsky** , the court-appointed monitor overseeing the United Auto Workers, had bullied UAW President **Shawn Fain** over the union's call for a Gaza ceasefire in 2023.
* Drop Site obtained and authenticated a recording of this conversation, which contradicts several claims Barofsky made about the call's contents.
* In the December 2023 phone call, Neil Barofsky told Fain that his statement invoking the union's history against fascism and apartheid "potentially cross[ed] the line into the area of antisemitism" by drawing a parallel to Israel's conduct.
* Fain, now under a federal grand jury investigation over allegations of corruption and retaliation following a highly critical report issued by the union's federal monitor, has described Barofsky's conduct as driven by a "personal vendetta" stemming from a "political grudge" Barofsky holds.
* Rep. Rashida Tlaib, who represents a district covering much of the Detroit area, has called on Barofsky to resign.
* **A full transcript of the call and more about the dispute is available in the latest from Ryan Grim for Drop Site[ here](https://substack.com/redirect/574a1c26-56c9-482b-b67f-329e8ab77205?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
* **Trump Media to charge for quicker access to Truth Social posts:** Trump Media & Technology Group [unveiled](https://substack.com/redirect/887f9808-abcb-40f3-a85f-2d0d6a8d51e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "Truth API," a licensed data feed set to launch August 1 that will give banks and trading firms "the fastest access" to posts from the platform's 10 most influential accounts, including President Donald Trump's, the company announced on Thursday.
* The product is reportedly being marketed towards algorithmic trading firms and was designed, according to its interim CEO, to provide the company with a new revenue stream.
* Trump has made several announcements on Truth Social that have dramatically moved the markets, including announcements about the ongoing war against Iran and the announcement of tariffs on "Liberation Day."
* **White House teleprompter operator probed for insider betting on speeches** : **Gabriel Perez** , President Trump's teleprompter operator since 2016, is in [talks](https://substack.com/redirect/5c97b1db-f34c-4c9d-b176-f10d6d172fe6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission to settle allegations that he used inside knowledge of Trump's speeches to win more than $100,000 betting on the prediction market Kalshi, ABC News reported on Thursday.
* Trump placed Perez on unpaid administrative leave after Kalshi flagged the suspicious trading activity to regulators, according to White House Press Secretary **Karoline Leavitt.**
* **War official could profit heavily from suit against the Pentagon:** Deputy Secretary of War **Stephen Feinberg** , who helped found the private-equity giant Cerberus, could stand to benefit tremendously from a lawsuit filed by the satellite firm Ligado Networks, which is a major recipient of Cerberus backing, against the Pentagon, according to a new investigation from The American Prospect.
* Ligado Networks is suing the Department of War for $40 billion over a satellite spectrum dispute, one of the largest in American history.
* Feinberg's Cerberus holdings are in trusts controlled by his children, Sen. **Elizabeth Warren** has pointed out, and, in a 2026 ethics statement, Feinberg said he would continue contracting with the firm he helped found for "administrative services."
* Read the full article from The American Prospect [here](https://substack.com/redirect/cd93a253-a283-4d32-9092-8ebe2a224462?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

# Other International News
* **Ansarallah promises to block Saudi access to Bab al-Mandab in retaliation for airport attack:** Mohammed al-Bukhaiti, a high-ranking official in Yemen's Ansarallah, told Drop Site News that the group will block Saudi access to the Bab al-Mandab strait, the chokepoint linking the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden, in retaliation for Monday's strikes on Sana'a airport.
* Al-Bukhaiti called the strait a "legitimate leverage tool" and promised a "blockade-for-blockade" arrangement, targeting only countries "participating in the aggression against Yemen."
* The leader of the Houthi movement, Abdulmalek al-Houthi, went further on Thursday, declaring "all Saudi oil facilities and vital installations" targets.
* **Read the Drop Site exclusive from contributor Iona Craig[ here](https://substack.com/redirect/3414fa28-628f-4583-9335-97e3b0c875c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**

* **Armed assailants seize chemical tanker off Yemen coast:** Armed assailants [boarded and took control](https://substack.com/redirect/38a77115-94ad-42e1-8c96-ee07b6bb1bdf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the chemical tanker Asana off Yemen's southern coast in the Gulf of Aden on Friday, in an incident maritime security sources believe is linked to Somali piracy rather than Yemen's Houthi militia, Reuters reported.
* The vessel issued a distress call around 10 a.m. local time and had no armed security team aboard, according to British maritime security group Ambrey.
* The circumstances of the takeover and the current status of the crew and the vessel were unclear as of Friday morning. The EU's Aspides naval mission has been tasked with assisting in recovery efforts, and a South Korean warship remains in the area.
* **Nigeria completes evacuation of 1,490 citizens from South Africa** : Nigeria's foreign ministry [said](https://substack.com/redirect/63f0c174-176b-4225-a10b-e0c0a6bfb9d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday it has completed the voluntary evacuation of 1,490 citizens from South Africa following xenophobic attacks, according to Reuters.
* The Nigerian government said the evacuations followed talks with South African authorities over security concerns, including the deaths of at least two Nigerian nationals allegedly assaulted by security officials.
* **Russian attacks on Ukraine kill 4:** Russian attacks on Ukraine overnight killed four people and wounded others, the Associated Press [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/f0b1d985-d6bd-457e-80bf-8efabe60ee4e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), with two killed in a strike on Odesa and 10 wounded and two others killed in Zaporizhzhia, where five additional people were injured. One of the people killed in Odesa was a woman walking her children, Ukrainian officials said, noting that her children survived the attack.
* Three civilians were killed and seven were injured in Russian-occupied Kherson, Russian authorities relayed.
* The strikes come amid a major shakeup in Ukraine's leadership: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced his intention to replace Mykhailo Fedorov as the country's defense minister with Yevhen Khmara, the head of Ukraine's security services. Fedorov's ouster sparked protests in Kyiv on Thursday.
* **Sudan 's army says it destroyed over 200 RSF vehicles in two-week offensive:** The Sudanese army [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/79583508-ff95-4a52-b4eb-de0ec836171b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Thursday that it destroyed about 205 combat vehicles, 17 supply trucks and four Rapid Support Forces drones between July 1 and July 15, with the heaviest losses reported in North Kordofan and Darfur, according to Sudan Tribune.
* The military also said it recaptured the Blue Nile town of Kurmuk after intense fighting and pledged that operations would continue across all fronts "until security and stability are restored."
* **U.S. approves nearly $2 billion weapons sale to Saudi Arabia** : The State Department [approved](https://substack.com/redirect/25395696-dad5-49e2-8c9c-8d4496e9fa05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a potential $1.96 billion weapons sale to Saudi Arabia on Wednesday, including up to 20,000 Advanced Precision Kill Weapon Systems, aimed at bolstering the kingdom's air defenses as the U.S.-Israel war on Iran re-escalates, Al Jazeera [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/25395696-dad5-49e2-8c9c-8d4496e9fa05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* The sale, with BAE Systems as principal contractor, comes as Saudi Arabia faces potential renewed conflict with Yemen's Houthis, who threatened to target Saudi oil facilities if Riyadh joins what they called "comprehensive aggression" against Yemen.
* **China condemns UK nationalization of British Steel** : China's Ministry of Commerce [said](https://substack.com/redirect/020bf1b0-e0d5-44c4-8c86-67809ea6b8c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Friday that the UK's nationalization of British Steel, formalized Thursday, "severely undermined" Chinese companies' confidence in investing in Britain, calling the move a "forcible" takeover that disregarded former owner Jingye's contributions.
* Jingye, one of China's biggest companies, bought British Steel for $94 million in 2020 and, by 2025, reported daily losses of $942,000 on the company.
* The British government began its nationalization in response to concerns that Jingye would begin shutting down British Steel's Scunthorpe Blast furnaces, and has promised to appoint an independent valuer to "assess whether any compensation is payable" to Jingye.
* **Kim Jong Un meets senior Chinese official, pledges deeper ties:** North Korean leader Kim Jong Un [met](https://substack.com/redirect/88803897-c5f7-4eeb-b073-05b649f5493c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday with Wang Huning, China's fourth-highest-ranked official, and pledged to deepen ties with Beijing, state-run KCNA reported.
* Following the visit, Wang said that China's "firm support for the cause of Korean socialism led by Comrade General Secretary Kim Jong Un will never be changed."
* The summit follows Chinese President Xi Jinping's June visit to Pyongyang, his first in seven years, and is seen as an effort by Beijing to reinforce its influence over North Korea.
