Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | President Trump — a sweeping change that could forever alter retirement accounts, including millions of 401(k)s. | | Welcome back to Fact Friday! **This Friday, I want to talk with you about Community Project Funding — what it is and why it's so important for El Paso.** Let's dive in together! Community Project Funding (CPF) is a way for Members of Congress to directly influence how and where funding is directed in our country and communities. Each year, my office receives dozens of CPF requests from eligible community partners, including local governments, public agencies, and other organizations. I then work with my team to decide which 15 (or this year, 20) projects we think have the most impact on El Pasoans and the best chance of getting funded through the appropriations process, and submit them to the Appropriations Committee. From then on, I advocate for each project to the Committee as they evaluate it. When it comes to El Paso, our community has many, many needs. My work brings home federal dollars to invest in projects that make a positive difference in your day-to-day lives. Projects and resources include _water and wastewater infrastructure_ , _growing our manufacturing_ , _local law enforcement, healthcare_ , and so much more. Since Community Funding Projects were created in 2022, I've secured nearly $71 million for 51 projects that help our community. Part of delivering for you means understanding the issues and challenges that affect you, so I can provide the very best for our community. [**Visit my website for a breakdown of how Community Project Funding has enabled me to deliver for you.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135465625/634315549/-595982827?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NDAzODYzZC1mZDgxLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oGCuCnWbH0-upZzmH7ztSpGeESmU9FuJTKWrHK2ObLA=&emci=80c49804-4979-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&emdi=8403863d-fd81-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=14565883) When I say I'm centering the needs of Texas 16 in the halls of D.C., I mean it — I look forward to developing and supporting as many Community Funding Projects for our district as possible to ensure we're not just surviving but thriving. clean_body: | | | | Welcome back to Fact Friday! This Friday, I want to talk with you about Community Project Funding — what it is and why it's so important for El Paso. Let's dive in together! Community Project Funding (CPF) is a way for Members of Congress to directly influence how and where funding is directed in our country and communities. Each year, my office receives dozens of CPF requests from eligible community partners, including local governments, public agencies, and other organizations. I then work with my team to decide which 15 (or this year, 20) projects we think have the most impact on El Pasoans and the best chance of getting funded through the appropriations process, and submit them to the Appropriations Committee. From then on, I advocate for each project to the Committee as they evaluate it. When it comes to El Paso, our community has many, many needs. My work brings home federal dollars to invest in projects that make a positive difference in your day-to-day lives. Projects and resources include water and wastewater infrastructure , growing our manufacturing , local law enforcement, healthcare , and so much more. Since Community Funding Projects were created in 2022, I've secured nearly $71 million for 51 projects that help our community. Part of delivering for you means understanding the issues and challenges that affect you, so I can provide the very best for our community. When I say I'm centering the needs of Texas 16 in the halls of D.C., I mean it — I look forward to developing and supporting as many Community Funding Projects for our district as possible to ensure we're not just surviving but thriving. If you want to keep getting clear, fact-based breakdowns of the issues affecting our community, make sure you stay connected and share this with someone who should be paying attention, too. _John Lewis was an American Hero._
I had the honor of serving with John in the House. His presence was like a torch of justice, drawing you in, giving you warmth, and lighting the way. He was the conscience of our Congress, and his life of activism has shaped our nation.
He participated in the **Freedom Rides of 1961,** and was one of the organizers and youngest speakers of the **1963 March on Washington.**
In the fight for civil rights, he was arrested at least **45 times at peaceful protests.**
After passing the landmark Civil Rights Act of 1964, he went on to serve in Congress and even pioneered the FIRST piece of legislation in 1992 to address pollution in communities of color.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135465863/634316374/-1698453517?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.07.17_Honor-John-Lewis_B1_F1_S1_C1_210DONx90DO_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNWE4ZjcxMS1mZTgxLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=drP_nz73wtQP7Q_6XzNb-TS1AULDhRUV8bUd9H-9MDM=)
John’s work was far from over. He introduced _the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act_ to restore the true function of the _Voting Rights Act of 1965:_**protecting Black and brown voters from discrimination.**
His worst fear was realized in April of this year, when the Supreme Court gave the greenlight to states like Alabama to redraw their maps and blatantly suppress majority-Black districts. I want to show you exactly what corruption looks like — and then I want to ask you to do something about it.
But, if you already agree that Washington corruption needs to stop, chip in to Equal Opportunity Now today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
Chip In To Equal Opportunity Now! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
Now let me tell you why I'm so fired up.
In his first year back in office, Donald Trump personally raked in more than $2 billion while working families struggle to keep up with rising prices.
More than $1.4 billion of it came from a crypto memecoin he launched days before his inauguration, and a venture called World Liberty Financial run by his own sons. He turned the office of the President of the United States into a personal ATM, and he didn't even try to hide it.
And it gets worse.
Just weeks ago, we learned that Trump and his Commerce Secretary negotiated a deal handing an American company access to one of the largest untapped tungsten reserves on earth — in Kazakhstan. The administration approved as much as $1.6 billion in federal financing to make it happen. Your tax dollars.
And then? Within weeks of the negotiations, a firm partly owned by Don Jr. and Eric Trump took a 20% stake in a company tied to that very same project.
Let me put that plainly: the President used your money to enrich his own sons. While more than 2 million Americans lost their health coverage. While hospitals and nursing homes were being defunded. While working families were told there just wasn't enough to go around.
There was plenty to go around. It just went to the Trumps.
This is the most corrupt administration in American history. It is not close.
And here's what makes me angriest of all: Corruption like this isn't just theft. It's the theft of opportunity itself. Because there is no equal opportunity if the game is rigged. When the powerful write the rules for themselves, working families don't get a fair shot — they get whatever scraps are left over after the well-connected have taken theirs.
That's exactly what Equal Opportunity Now was built to fight.
We know how to win. We've helped elect fighters who take on corruption, who champion honest government, who believe that public service means serving the public — not your own bank account. And we're building the bench of leaders who will do it up and down the ballot, in every corner of this country.
But we can't do it without you.
If you're in agreement that Washington corruption needs to stop, will you chip in $25 or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
DONATE TODAY TO DEFEAT MAGA! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
The game is rigged. Let's un-rig it.

Hey folks,
This one gets fired up fast.
[Joe Walsh](https://open.substack.com/users/263371025-joe-walsh?utm_source=mentions) and I dig into Trump's latest election grievance tour, why even Fox News seemed ready to move on, and what it says about where the country is right now. But we also get into something bigger: what Democrats need to do if they actually want to meet this moment--and why simply waiting for the pendulum to swing back isn't enough.
We also talk about accountability, the future of the Republican Party, the state of Democratic leadership, and a horrifying ICE shooting that deserves far more attention than it's getting.
**Here are some moments you don 't want to miss:**
* **00:01:07** Trump launches back into 2020 election conspiracies--and we break down why the claims don't hold up and why even conservative media seemed eager to move on.
* **00:08:58** We talk about accountability, why January 6 and the attempts to overturn the election still matter, and what Democrats must do if they regain power.
* **00:15:31** A bigger conversation about Democratic strategy, performative politics, and why viral moments aren't a substitute for actually governing.
* **00:24:03** We examine Republican leaders continuing to question legitimate elections, what happened to the old GOP, and whether there's any road back.
* **00:34:25** We close with the tragic ICE shooting in Maine, the disturbing details surrounding the officer involved, and why meaningful reform can't wait.

At its core, this episode is about whether our politics can move forward--or whether we're going to stay trapped reliving the same fights while real problems keep piling up. If you're frustrated by performative politics, worried about where the country is headed, or looking for a conversation that goes beyond the headlines, this one's for you.

Peter,
In 250 years of American history, we have never faced a moment quite like this one.
**The Democratic Party is being swallowed whole by an openly socialist, anti-American wing.**
This is not name-calling. Their own platform calls for gutting our military, nationalizing private companies, abolishing cash bail, throwing open the border, and handing voting rights to noncitizens.
Their radicals are beating establishment Democrats in primary after primary. Zohran Mamdani was just the beginning.
_But here is what most Americans still do not understand, and it worries me deeply._
**The Democrats have already rigged the system. And they did it through illegal immigration.**
It works like this. Our Census counts every single resident, citizens and illegal aliens alike, when it hands out House seats and Electoral College votes.
So every illegal alien sitting in a blue state quietly pads that state's power in Washington, D.C.
Elon Musk has been sounding the alarm on this, and he is exactly right. Record illegal immigration has already shifted an estimated 15 to 20 House seats toward the Left.
Now you understand why they fight secure borders and deportations so ferociously.
**That is the entire scheme. Flood the country. Inflate the count. Redraw the maps. Lock in permanent one-party power. **
President Trump fought to base representation on American citizens where it belongs. The courts blocked him at every turn. But the plot is now out in the open for all of us to see.
Which brings me to the SAVE Act, and to my single greatest fear in this fight...
Not enough Americans even know what it is. **One poll found that only 23% could accurately describe it.** That is a catastrophe, because you cannot rally the people to save something they have never had explained to them.
**So let me tell you plainly what this bill does: The SAVE Act bars noncitizens from voting, so that only American citizens ever cast a ballot in an American election. And it requires photo ID to vote.** _**Period.** _
That is the whole fight, in two sentences.
And the American people are with us by margins you almost never see in politics. Nearly 80% want proof of citizenship to register. More than 8 in 10 support voter ID, including most Democrats, most independents, every background and every region. It is 5 to 1.
**Yet every single Democrat is fighting to block it.** _**Every one.** _
I have spent a lifetime in these battles, and I will tell you the hard truth. You never win reform inside Washington, D.C. The lobbyists and the entrenched forces always control the inside game.
Reagan understood this. His job, he said, was to shine a light on the American people so they would turn up the heat on Congress. Tip O'Neill once admitted to me that Reagan's speeches cost him 46 Democrats in a single fight.
**That is exactly how we win this one. Not with insiders. With a grassroots army of patriots like you, moving all at once.**

I’m honored that the people of Iowa have put their faith in me. I’m ready to take this once-in-a-generation shot to win this OPEN seat. I’m ready to be the champion working people deserve in Washington.

subject: Hegseth’s extreme pastor is now “mainstream”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Friends [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50] , do you remember this guy? NPR just published a new interview with Pete Hegseth’s personal spiritual leader — the extremely fringe, right-wing pastor Doug Wilson. And this headline has all the alarm bells ringing:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Mainstream. That’s the word religion and history scholars are using to describe how Wilson’s teachings have moved from the fringes of our society to the mainstream, now that Donald Trump’s administration is filled with Christian nationalists.
In case you need a refresher on who this guy is: He’s made disturbing and shameful claims defending slavery and saying it wasn’t that bad . He thinks we should criminalize homosexuality. He said God created women “to make the sandwiches” and that wives should submit to their husbands. And he believes the 19th Amendment should be repealed — because granting women the right to vote was a “bad idea.”
To be extremely clear: My role in society isn’t to submit to a man. It’s to be a Member of Congress. And a member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee and Ranking Member of the Subcommittee on Africa. And a member of the House Armed Services Committee. And to serve as the Parliamentarian in the House Democratic Caucus, making me one of the youngest members of Democratic House leadership.
Get the picture, pastor?
But in case there was any doubt about Wilson’s vision for our country, he’s made it clear in the NPR interview that his full focus is on banning abortion nationwide, overturning marriage equality, and gradually turning the United States into a Christian theocracy — where religion controls our government and politics, in direct violation of our Constitution. Under his vision, non-Christians wouldn’t be able to hold public office.
This is despicable.
We can’t be shocked anymore by this administration, but we can stay outraged — and channel that anger into getting these racist, sexist, homophobic, egotistical losers out of power so they stop infecting our country with their rot and putting us on the fast-track to white nationalism and authoritarianism.
That’s my mission, and I know we can do it if we roll up our sleeves and get to work. I’m all in on this — my team and I are laser-focused on retaking a Democratic House majority, working to support Democratic challengers and incumbents, and of course winning my own re-election. If you’re in, too, will you chip in today to support our work? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]

Edmund Pettus was a racist who betrayed our country to keep slavery alive during the Civil War.

He even served as a Grand Dragon in the KKK after the Civil War.

Right now, a bridge in Selma, where the brutal beatings of Rep. John Lewis and many other civil rights activists took place, is named after him.

[_It’s time for America to forgo its racist past and honor REAL heroes like Congressman John Lewis._](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14383?source=LOC_EM_PET_2026.07.17_CBCPAC-JLewis-Bridge_B2_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=8&akid=2670%2E259176%2ExUeh2E)

And we can’t think of a more powerful gesture than renaming the Edmund Pettus Bridge after Rep. John Lewis, who dedicated his life to freedom and equality on this very bridge.

[In order to rid this nation of a dark cloud of bigotry, we must stop honoring the names of racists like Edmund Pettus.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14383?source=LOC_EM_PET_2026.07.17_CBCPAC-JLewis-Bridge_B2_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=9&akid=2670%2E259176%2ExUeh2E) | [SIGN MY NAME NOW →](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14383?source=LOC_EM_PET_2026.07.17_CBCPAC-JLewis-Bridge_B2_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=10&akid=2670%2E259176%2ExUeh2E)

name: LeftNet
subject: have you taken our summer survey?
body:
We're a little over 100 days before Election Day.
#
Hey,
It's mid-July, which means we’re less than four months and a little over 100 days away from Election Day.
As we inch closer to November 3rd, more and more people across the country are tuning in, and we want to make sure we’re focusing on what matters most to you.
So we’re checking in mid-summer with a quick priorities survey.
**[Will you take a minute to tell us what you want to see LeftNet focus on between now and November?](https://act.leftnet.org/survey/summer-priorities-survey/?source=em20260717-1684&t=1&akid=1684%2E2118727%2EvZfAbO)**
**[Take The Summer Priorities Survey](https://act.leftnet.org/survey/summer-priorities-survey/?source=em20260717-1684&t=2&akid=1684%2E2118727%2EvZfAbO)**
Whether it’s confronting the climate crisis with the urgency it demands, organizing against ICE, defending democracy, taking on corporate greed, or protecting reproductive rights — we know the stakes are high, and there’s a lot competing for attention.
But we’re not just collecting responses and moving on. We want our work from now til November to reflect the priorities and values of the people who power this movement, and that starts with hearing directly from you.
Your responses help shape our messaging, the organizations we ask you to support, issues we elevate, and the fights we take on next.
Whether you joined our movement last week or you’ve been with us for a long time, your voice matters here. [**So please take a moment to tell us what’s on your mind!**](https://act.leftnet.org/survey/summer-priorities-survey/?source=em20260717-1684&t=3&akid=1684%2E2118727%2EvZfAbO)
Thanks for taking the time to fill out this survey!
— LeftNet

**LeftNet is an online political network fighting for progressive causes and candidates focused on social, racial, economic, and environmental justice.**

Hi, Mike Cortese here. I want to talk to you today not as a candidate for Congress, but as someone who believes the people we send to Washington should **reflect our values.** It's time we fix the problem this 2026, and we have under a month to raise enough money to keep us in the fight (you can **[join here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9ae54860-5278-40fc-ab4e-5cb6bb24b420?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**).
## The Problem
Before talking about solutions, we have to know the problem. Everyone tosses around "MAGA this," "Trump that," but _**someone**_**is doing the dirty work to make things move in the direction they are.**
That someone is Scott Desjarlais, MAGA fanatic, and my opponent.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5978b672-ba7d-493b-bd7f-f3a0daeb5b66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
After Trump's State of the Union address, DesJarlais chased the president down as he left the House chambers and said "Thank you, Mr. President, you earned this night."
He's shown hypocrisy, missed over _400_ votes, and he has kept his head down, stayed in line with what MAGA tells him, and collects a taxpayer-funded paycheck along the way.
_**We got to show Americans this kind of "representation" has no place in government. **_**Our primary is just 1 month away, and we need your help to keep our fight strong!**_**:**_
[ DONATE $20 = "Kick'em Out Mike!"](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9ae54860-5278-40fc-ab4e-5cb6bb24b420?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## The Solution
When I talk to folks across our district, they are worried about this kind of behavior. So much so, my whole campaign is based around it: I believe _**Hometowns over Headlines**_. It means we hold ourselves and our representatives to a higher standard, and I'm ready to meet it.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/26baad38-750a-4938-bad0-14ae1d0f3e26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I'm running because just like the Democrats Desjarlais refuses to represent, I'm just an American taking it one day at a time. Providing for my family and working hard.
_**If it 's a crime to give Americans the opportunity to prosper... arrest me man!**_
When I first moved to Tennessee, I had no "in" for business. **But I made it**. Hard work, positivity, and grit got me where I am today: a music industry veteran, public servant, and proud husband and father of two boys.
If you want to help build a campaign that stands for that, a campaign that replaces controversy with competence, I hope you'll donate today:

# [Leftist Billionaire Neville Roy Singham in major China foreign agent investigation](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Neville Roy Singham, husband of Code Pink founder Jodie Evans and major backer of left-leaning nonprofits, is under criminal investigation by a grand jury in New York's Southern District for possible[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/13409221-3683-463c-ac44-9fb043ec3895?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Foreign Agents Registration Act violations and tax issues involving his organizations.](https://substack.com/redirect/13409221-3683-463c-ac44-9fb043ec3895?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Grand jury probes funding:** The investigation started with potential FARA breaches and expanded to examine whether money was unlawfully funneled through nonprofits Singham controls and if he lied on their 990 tax forms.
* **Wealthy donor network:** Singham sold Thoughtworks for $785 million in 2017, moved operations to Shanghai, and has funded global nonprofits and think tanks with hundreds of millions, including up to a quarter of Code Pink's operations.
* **Congressional scrutiny:** Republican lawmakers, including House Ways and Means Chairman Jason Smith and Senate Judiciary Chairman Charles Grassley, have alleged ties to China and demanded documents over influence campaigns.
* **No charges yet:** Singham has not been charged, denies acting for any government, and CBS News reached out for comment while Code Pink and the People's Forum did not immediately respond.

# [Discovery of alien tech in ancient Egypt?](https://substack.com/redirect/db5f96c0-9d43-4c34-ae5c-786631dc22db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### [How do they explain this?](https://substack.com/redirect/db5f96c0-9d43-4c34-ae5c-786631dc22db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/db5f96c0-9d43-4c34-ae5c-786631dc22db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The evidence for ancient Egyptian aliens is bizarre and impossible to explain. Historical legends of "Gods" that came from the sky on flying discs... The Temple of Seti hieroglyph from 1239 BC showing a helicopter, submarine, and airplane...
## _3,000 years before they were invented._
**Pyramids made of 2.3 million blocks that weigh up to 100 tons each ...Perfectly constructed without the use of modern tools or technology.**
* There's a good reason some people say ancient Egypt was visited by an advanced alien culture. But for those who laugh at the idea, **[how do they explain this](https://substack.com/redirect/db5f96c0-9d43-4c34-ae5c-786631dc22db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**?
* A discovery found half-buried in the sand inside King Tut's tomb. Written into papyrus scrolls as the legendary... "Cure for Every Disease Except Death."
* But when modern scientists tested it against cancer, diabetes, heart disease, arthritis, COPD, pain, Parkinson's, and liver disease...

# [Netflix stock plunges after disappointing Q2 earnings forecast](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Netflix reported second-quarter revenue of $12.56 billion and earnings per share of 80 cents roughly in line with estimates, **[but its stock fell over 8% after-hours as investors reacted to the company's outlook](https://substack.com/redirect/18dde931-dd3d-4dae-9565-022bd906705b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and reduced engagement reporting.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Revenue driven by growth:** Revenue rose 13% year over year due to membership growth, pricing increases, and higher advertising revenue while net income reached $3.40 billion.
* **Outlook narrows:** The company expects 12% third-quarter revenue growth and narrowed its 2026 full-year forecast to $51 billion to $51.4 billion from a wider prior range.
* **Engagement remains healthy:** Netflix called engagement healthy with over 97 billion viewing hours in the first half of 2026, highlighted live events, but will shift "What We Watched" reports to annual starting 2027.
* **Ad revenue doubles:** The company anticipates roughly doubling ad revenue year over year to $3 billion, with strong demand for live sports like NFL games and WWE.

# [Chinese Moonshot AI strikes with Kimi K3 rivaling OpenAI models](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Chinese startup Moonshot AI released its largest model yet, Kimi K3 with 2.8 trillion parameters, claiming it **[closes the gap with U.S. leaders and outperforms some on coding and agent benchmarks](https://substack.com/redirect/e7602210-0419-4875-b8c6-e94c78ef02f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** despite trailing top models.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Performance claims:** K3 trails Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and OpenAI's GPT 5.6 Sol overall but beat Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT 5.5 on coding and general agents.
* **Scaling innovation:** Despite hardware constraints in China, the model shows pre-training scaling and architectural advances can deliver gains for Chinese flagship systems.
* **Market reaction:** Shares of Chinese AI rivals like Z.ai dropped 28% and MiniMax fell 16% following the announcement.
* **Funding and backers:** Founded in 2023, Moonshot raised $2 billion at over $20 billion valuation with backers including Alibaba and Tencent.

# [Microsoft CEO blasts Anthropic over Fable editorial controls](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella told engineers that Anthropic's limits on its top-tier Fable AI model requests **[feel overly editorially controlled and do not make sense for creation tools.](https://substack.com/redirect/9e37b69a-95a9-4998-ad20-201a5443b11b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Specific concerns:** Nadella questioned refusals on topics like large-scale model creation, noting it differs from typical creation tools.
* **Broader strategy:** Comments reflect push toward cost-efficient models and internal development rather than sole reliance on frontier labs.
* **Partnership context:** Microsoft invested $5 billion in Anthropic, uses its models in Copilot, but is also building in-house options and offering multiple models via Foundry.
* **Copilot unification:** Nadella noted unifying consumer and corporate Copilot products should have happened earlier, with over 20 million paid seats.

# [Chinese fraud rings steal billions from retailers using tap-to-pay scams](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Organized Chinese crime rings and opportunists **[are exploiting tap-to-pay and retail apps with stolen credit cards](https://substack.com/redirect/4f2e4c11-2ae1-4b53-8f13-21499e755624?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to buy gift cards and goods, generating up to $1 billion annually with low visibility for retailers.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Fraud tactics:** Suspects use stolen cards at self-checkouts like Lowe's for gift cards, coached remotely, then resell or ship high-value items to China.
* **Scam methods:** Mass texts about tolls or arrests lead to data theft; credentials sold on Telegram for retail apps with stored cards.
* **Law enforcement response:** HSI's Project Red Hook has led to 239 arrests since January 2024; cases involve multiple retailers including Lowe's, TJX, Target.
* **Security gaps:** Retail apps lack bank-grade security prioritizing convenience, making them targets unlike traditional shelf-clearing theft.

# [Nvidia launches Cosmos 3 Edge AI model in major Japan expansion](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia introduced its Cosmos 3 Edge world model for physical AI and is[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/7b53c309-11df-4439-b1da-1008bd99b0ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[expanding partnerships in Japan with firms like Fujitsu and Hitachi](https://substack.com/redirect/7b53c309-11df-4439-b1da-1008bd99b0ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for intelligent industries and healthcare.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Model capabilities:** Cosmos 3 Edge helps robots and vision agents perceive and navigate real-time physical environments following the May Cosmos 3 launch.
* **Japan ecosystem:** CEO Jensen Huang highlighted Japan's manufacturing opportunity in physical AI during his Tokyo visit, forming a coalition with local industrial giants.
* **Healthcare push:** Nvidia extends into agentic AI for drug discovery via Tokyo-1 consortium with partners like Astellas Pharma and Daiichi Sankyo.
* **Market opportunity:** Japan's AI market is projected to reach $27.9 billion by 2029 amid government promotion and international ties.

# [Alphabet shares drop sharply on Gemini 3.5 Pro AI model delay](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Alphabet shares fell after a report that its flagship Gemini 3.5 Pro AI **[model release has been delayed months due to performance shortfalls,](https://substack.com/redirect/20d6abb1-3b29-4d5a-878e-3c2acf952bcf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** especially in coding capabilities.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ba95791e-b966-4225-b6fa-5490ecd4242b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Internal expectations:** The model, announced in May for internal use, fell short on coding where rivals like OpenAI and Meta have advanced.
**Company response:** Alphabet said it is shipping models quickly while keeping them cost-effective and testing 3.5 Pro with partners and government.
**Competitive pressure:** Comes as Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Grok 4.5 push coding and agentic capabilities forward.
**Stock impact:** Shares sank 4% on the news of the delay for the upgraded model.

subject: DEVELOPING… Trump guts Endangered Species Act
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM4NDI4MjcS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjUwMDA5OTQ4NAS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
DEVELOPING... reversing more than 50 years of environmental law, the Trump
administration has just gutted the Endangered Species Act, opening up the
habitats of protected species to logging, oil drilling, and other development. Under the new rule, destroying an endangered species’ habitat will no longer be
considered illegal. An oil company could even rip apart the nest of an endangered bird so long as
they don’t “directly” injure or kill listed wildlife. We’re turning to our members for help, Peter. We’ve extended our Summer Membership Drive through the end of July. I hope we’ll hear from you — a group of donors is tripling the first 5,000 donations to the campaign. Here’s your status: https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/9zEZMdz_ PLEASE REVIEW:
LCV Summer Membership Drive Status Name: Peter Willis
LCV Member Status: PENDING

Match Offer: FIRST 5,000 GIFTS TRIPLE MATCHED

Deadline: JULY 31

Renew your LCV membership for $15 now >> https://links.messages.lcv. In just the past month, Trump has launched into a series of attacks on bedrock
environmental protections: He’s once again trying to gut protections for more than 90% of Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante national monuments.He handed over more than 70,000 acres in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge to oil and gas companies.He’s gutted the National Park Service, the National Forest Service, and the Bureau of Land Management. It doesn’t have to be this way.Every developer that tries to build on the land of endangered animals needs to
feel grassroots pressure. Every lawmaker that supports these moves needs to be
flooded with letters and calls from their constituents. But that only happens when the environmental movement stands together.Your support goes directly to organizing communities threatened by Trump’s
attacks, mobilizing as many voters as possible, and ensuring elected officials
hear from people who believe animals are worth saving and that public lands
should remain in public hands. Will we hear from you today? Please, renew your LCV membership today. I need you to meet him.
Peter, I want to tell you about someone I trust.

Zach Dembo worked for me as a policy advisor. He's a Navy JAG veteran who's spent his career serving this country – most recently as a federal prosecutor in the U.S. Department of Justice.

Now Zach's running to flip Kentucky's 6th Congressional District, and I believe this could be one of the most important races in the country this cycle. But before I tell you why I'm backing him, I need to tell you what he did.

When Zach saw the Trump administration using the Department of Justice to protect the powerful and punish anyone who spoke up, he didn't stay quiet and he didn't go along to get along. He resigned. He walked away from a career most people spend a lifetime building, because he wasn't willing to be part of a system that had stopped serving justice and started serving power.

I've said it before: character is doing the right thing when nobody's watching. Zach did the right thing when everybody was watching, and it cost him something real.

That's the kind of person I want representing Kentucky in Congress.

Folks in Central Kentucky are working hard, playing by the rules, and still getting squeezed by rising costs and cuts hurting working families. We don't need more folks in Washington who are just angry. We need people who know how the system works, aren't afraid to take it on, and will actually fight for the people it's failed.

clean_body: I need you to meet him. Peter, I want to tell you about someone I trust. Zach Dembo worked for me as a policy advisor. He's a Navy JAG veteran who's spent his career serving this country – most recently as a federal prosecutor in the U.S. Department of Justice. Now Zach's running to flip Kentucky's 6th Congressional District, and I believe this could be one of the most important races in the country this cycle. But before I tell you why I'm backing him, I need to tell you what he did. When Zach saw the Trump administration using the Department of Justice to protect the powerful and punish anyone who spoke up, he didn't stay quiet and he didn't go along to get along. He resigned. He walked away from a career most people spend a lifetime building, because he wasn't willing to be part of a system that had stopped serving justice and started serving power. I've said it before: character is doing the right thing when nobody's watching. Zach did the right thing when everybody was watching, and it cost him something real. That's the kind of person I want representing Kentucky in Congress. Folks in Central Kentucky are working hard, playing by the rules, and still getting squeezed by rising costs and cuts hurting working families. We don't need more folks in Washington who are just angry. We need people who know how the system works, aren't afraid to take it on, and will actually fight for the people it's failed. # [Florida Man Finds a Drill Press](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=207321123&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA3MzIxMTIzLCJpYXQiOjE3ODQzMTE2NzUsImV4cCI6MTc4NjkwMzY3NSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.-GdQgi_2MTySG9xFik3J4D-4EfwD9hybVYlpBc1AeFE)
### Mike Rogers is a multi-millionaire from Florida. He's certainly not made a Michigan working-class hero
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jul 17
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/florida-man-finds-a-drill-press?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-restack-comment&action=restack-comment&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA3MzIxMTIzLCJpYXQiOjE3ODQzMTE2NzUsImV4cCI6MTc4NjkwMzY3NSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.-GdQgi_2MTySG9xFik3J4D-4EfwD9hybVYlpBc1AeFE&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/florida-man-finds-a-drill-press?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Mike Rogers has a new ad out.
He's wearing one of those tech-guy fleece vests, strolling through a factory, posing next to a drill press, and drinking a beer in a bar. Because I guess all of that is supposed to say _I 'm a working Michigander_?
You may remember his previous ad, where he wore a brand-new Carhartt jacket and pretended to be an expert in Michigan manufacturing. Well, now it's the fleece vest, and he's pretending to be middle class. The ad even says that's "who we are."
Respectfully, I disagree.
Let me tell you who Mike Rogers is: **Mike Rogers is a super-rich Florida man with a giant waterfront mansion.** In the winter, when Michiganders are scraping ice off their windshields in the cold, Mike Rogers is enjoying the palm trees at his mansion in Cape Coral and his two luxury yachts. (No joke, Google it.)
That's Mike Rogers. There's nothing wrong with relaxing on the beach, but there's something deeply wrong with being a carpetbagger millionaire who films himself at a factory and tells Michigan he's one of us.
Rogers doesn't know anything about Michigan grit. Most Florida millionaires don't.
But I know who we are. The Michigan way is folks busting their tails - it's calloused hands, shop floors, union halls. It's pride. It's building things that last. It's standing up for your neighbor. It's having the backs of your fellow workers. It's about looking out for community. It's not about hightailing it to your Florida mansion.
**So here 's what I want to say to Mike Rogers directly: Standing next to a drill press doesn't make you a fighter for the people who run it. Chatting with workers for a camera crew before flying home to Florida is not the same as working like hell to keep their factory open. And having a beer with some folks in a Michigan bar doesn't change your values. It doesn't suddenly give you credit. Working families shouldn't trust you, despite your (literal) costume changes.**
I've actually done the work. I served as Chief of Staff on President Obama's auto rescue when the whole world was ready to write off Michigan, and we helped save 200,000 jobs here. I helped write and pass the CHIPS and Science Act to bring manufacturing back to American soil, and to Michigan.
I didn't stop to shoot a commercial to make sure everybody saw how working-class I was. I was too busy busting my tail for the people who actually run those factories.
So let's be honest about what Mike Rogers would actually do for Michigan's working families: exactly what Donald Trump has done. That's who he answers to. Trump endorsed him (twice), MAGA billionaires fund him, and if he ever made it to the Senate, he'd vote however they tell him to. Rogers doesn't care if your grocery bill goes up, if gas prices skyrocket again, or if you lose your health insurance. _He cares about looking like he cares._
This ad just started running, and there is a heap of money behind it. Last cycle, Mike Rogers had $82.3 million in ad support from Republicans for his Senate campaign. He lost anyway, because Michiganders know B.S. when they see it.
But the out-of-state far-right billionaires funding him are going to run it back, bigger. The fleece vest is going to be in your living room, on your phone, and in the middle of your Tigers games - then your Lions and Red Wings and Pistons games - from now until November.
It's going to be exhausting.
So here's the plainest thing I can tell you about how we fight back: **We keep our new TV ad on the air.**
Their MAGA Trump consultants think a guy who walks around factories talking about being middle class is going to win votes here. They think Michiganders can't tell the difference. But Rogers is a fake. He wouldn't know the Michigan way if it bit him on the keester.
Our ads tell the truth: about my record, about fighting for working families, about who actually shows up for Michigan. Keeping them running is the single most strategic thing this campaign can do right now, and I truly can't do it without you.
So if you're able, **[will you chip in today, drown out Mike Rogers ' ads, and help us keep telling Michiganders the truth while people are starting to vote absentee?](https://substack.com/redirect/b99159f3-b368-43b1-9882-a57b012bfe4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
We have to win this primary, beat Mike Rogers, flip the Senate, and stop Donald Trump - and all of it starts with fighting back against this ad. It's simple, but it's true. That's where your $20 donation goes. Telling the world who Mike Rogers really is.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/b99159f3-b368-43b1-9882-a57b012bfe4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Mike Rogers can keep the vest. He can keep the Florida mansion and the luxury yachts, too.
But Michigan is ours.
With grit,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/0e79668c-97d4-4d3d-baec-7a8c43b7fe12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

clean_body: What he’s really up to: | | | Last night, Donald Trump got on national TV and gave a prime-time speech from the White House. Usually, when a president does that sort of thing, they have something new and important to say. But honestly, Trump just loves surrounding himself with the trappings of the presidency. He loves hearing the sound of his own voice. And he wanted to invite himself into millions of living rooms to retread desperate lies about the election he lost in 2020 — to lay the groundwork for future attempts to overthrow upcoming elections. Here’s what you need to know (without having to watch him rant and rave): He’s desperate to validate his conspiracy theories about 2020. He’s selectively disclosing a cherrypicked set of classified documents that paint a false picture of alleged foreign interference. * It’s a predictable disinformation playbook to make people doubt the results of future elections — like the ones his party may very well lose this November. Meanwhile, he’s effectively shut down a federal elections agency, continued to demand passage of a bill that could keep tens of millions of Americans from voting in the midterms, and tried to pre-determine the results by getting Republicans to rig new maps around the country. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- Thanks for everything you do, Lauren Groh-Wargo CEO, Fair Fight | = = | 1270 Caroline Street | Suite D120-430 | Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2026 Fair Fight - All rights reserved. **Peter, that was unhinged.** Donald Trump just went on primetime television to reheat his election denier leftovers — hefty portions of straight-up lies and crackpot conspiracy theories with a side of allegations that, if true, raise a lot of questions about the incompetence of his own administration. It’s all nonsense, of course. He knows it. Congress knows it. The vast, vast majority of the American people know it. What we see is a sad, desperate man who can’t handle the fact that he lost an election _six years ago_ and is terrified to face voters now, knowing that 61% of them disapprove of the job he’s doing. **But we can’t laugh this off. What we just witnessed is truly dangerous. ** This administration is escalating the rate at which they churn out intentional misinformation — because they are determined to cheat to win. Checks and balances aren’t coming to the rescue — not while Washington is run by Trump sycophants and our courts have repeatedly demonstrated they’ll overlook precedent to help their preferred party’s electoral outlook. For Stacy Garrity, honoring veterans isn't politics. It's a lifelong mission.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/tM1rrAh6gaL?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
| | | | | | Hi Peter,
Last week, Treasurer Garrity returned a long-lost military medal to the family of a World War II veteran who fought on D-Day.
More than 80 years after Sgt. George Pershing answered his nation’s call, his Army Good Conduct Medal was finally reunited with the family who had spent decades without it.
For most politicians, that would make for a nice photo opportunity.
For Stacy Garrity, it’s something much deeper.
As a retired Army Reserve Colonel who served our nation for 30 years — including three deployments to the Middle East and earning two Bronze Stars and the Legion of Merit — Stacy understands that a military decoration is never “just a medal.”
It represents sacrifice.
Duty.
Honor.
And a promise that America will never forget those who served.
That belief has guided Stacy throughout her time as State Treasurer, where Pennsylvania Treasury has reunited more than 500 lost military decorations with veterans and their families.
And it’s exactly the philosophy she’ll bring to the Governor’s Office.
Stacy believes our responsibility to veterans doesn’t end when they take off the uniform.
It means making Pennsylvania the best state in America for veterans to build their lives after service. That starts with recognizing the skills they earned in uniform by cutting unnecessary licensing barriers, making it easier for employers to hire veterans, expanding access to rural healthcare in rural communities, honoring Gold Star families, helping end veteran homelessness, and protecting the benefits veterans have earned.
These aren’t just policy ideas.
They’re shaped by someone who has lived the Army values of Loyalty, Duty, Respect, Service, Honor, Integrity, and Personal Courage.
Pennsylvania owes our veterans more than our gratitude.
We owe them opportunity.
We owe them respect.
And we owe them leadership from someone who understands their service because she’s lived it herself.
[**You can read the story here.**](https://us.list-manage.com/_SM8z07l6Rs?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
\- Team Garrity

subject: They want me gone.

body:
#
Hi Peter,
I've never been afraid to tell the truth, even when it made powerful people uncomfortable.
That's why they're spending millions to spread lies about me and defame my name. **_$2.2 million to be exact..._**
But ask yourself this: **_why_ are they spending so much money trying to defeat one Democrat?**
Because they're afraid of what we've built together. They're afraid of a movement that can't be bought. They're afraid of people organizing instead of billionaires calling the shots.
That's why they spent millions trying to silence me before, and it's why they're coming after me again.
But I've **_never_** fought for billionaires. I've fought for people who've been ignored, pushed aside, and told to settle for less.
My primary is fast approaching, and I'm asking you to help me finish this fight.
**[If you believe Congress should answer to everyday people, not wealthy donors and corporate interests, can I count on you to split a donation between me and Justice Democrats before my primary on August 4th?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260717-1-cb.GcrCCr&refcode=em20260717-38043&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=2&akid=38043%2E1203867%2EG0Mhmg)**

We're going to win this the same way we've always done it: _together._
In solidarity,
_Cori Bush_

| Last week, I asked you to share your thoughts about this movement, what you want us to fight for, and how we can keep building together.
Since then, our team has been reading every response.
We heard hope, urgency, policy ideas, deeply personal stories, and a clear demand that we keep listening, keep organizing, and keep pushing for more.
People often say progress happens slowly, then all at once.
After reading your comments, I feel more optimistic than ever that we are standing on the precipice of the "all at once."
Just look at what happened in Congress this week.
Two years ago, only 37 House Democrats voted against a major Israel aid package. This week, 103 House Democrats voted to block $3.3 billion in annual military aid to Israel.
While the amendment didn't pass, the shift is undeniable.
Things are changing because people like us organized, voted, donated, knocked doors, challenged powerful incumbents, and refused to accept the establishment's excuses.
Now our elected officials are realizing that they can join a movement demanding courage and accountability, or voters will move them out of the way and elect someone who will.
Your comments are already shaping where we show up, how we organize, and what we fight for next.
Here's a few that really stuck with us:
"It's easy to be jaded about politics these days, but these kinds of victories remind us we don't have to be." - Nick T.
"Continue to listen. Town halls, one-on-one meetings, gatherings, surveys, social media. Do these early and often." - Sam B.
"Keep the campaign focused on affordability, a system rigged by corporate interference, and a new style of governing that is bold and has conviction." - Kristen G.
"Without insurance, I imagine most people simply forego treatment. Our healthcare system is diabolically abysmal." - Austin M.
We are taking these comments seriously. They are informing how we approach constituent services, how we connect with our communities, and how we'll fight for Medicare for All, affordable housing, climate action, immigrant rights, campaign finance reform, and a government that works for working people.
If you haven't responded yet, we're still reading.

Healthcare costs are too high.
Most politicians respond by promising new programs, new spending, or more bureaucracy.
I have a different plan.
Here's how we'll bring down healthcare costs in Ohio immediately in 2027:
1\. [Prosecute Medicaid fraudsters – aggressively.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._p4A) Every dollar stolen by fraudsters is a dollar taken from hardworking taxpayers.
2\. [Strike a deal with the federal government](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._-bW0nyDyEj2Q) that allows Ohio to keep a majority of the savings. If Ohio helps root out waste, Ohio taxpayers should benefit.

[It's a simple idea: stop subsidizing fraud and start rewarding honest citizens.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._Q)

clean_body: The same tired, brute-force tactics that AIPAC and billionaires have tried all across year. | | | Peter, With three weeks until the Michigan primaries, the billionaire class is taking their desperation to a whole new level. Outside ad spending for Haley Stevens has officially passed the $50 million mark — the majority of it coming from AIPAC’s Super PAC, United Democracy Project. 1 That’s a $16 million increase in just the last two weeks. It’s the same tired, brute-force tactics they’ve tried all across the country this year. They aren’t trying to talk about policy — just trying to drown out the opposition, and smother every radio station and TV channel across the state. But we were able to beat them in Colorado, Pennsylvania, New York, and California. And we can beat them here in Michigan, too. The relentless support from AIPAC and the billionaire class isn’t just about winning a single election. It’s about trying to influence U.S. policy. This week, more than 100 Democrats voted yes on the Massie Amendment to block unconditional military aid to Israel. Although the measure failed, it marked a historic shift by our government to put an end to our ongoing complicity in the genocide in Gaza. Rep. Haley Stevens voted to continue sending billions in lethal aid to Israel. That’s the true corrosive power of big money in politics. Those who are elected to Congress are, naturally, beholden to the people that got them there. So it stands to reason that when a bunch of billionaires and Super PACs spend more money than the GDP of the country of Tuvalu to elect you, they’re bound to expect something in return. Abdul doesn’t have that problem. The only people he’s beholden to are the working class people who are giving their time, energy, and money to his campaign. No corporate PACs. No billionaires. Just YOU. It won’t be easy, but we’ve proven time and time again this year that we CAN beat AIPAC and the billionaire class. And we have less than three weeks to do it again. body:
I did not run for Congress to explain testosterone to this man. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135475910/634339705/-785282667?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YWRmNWIxNS0wZDgyLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yZTcHUsurGx0htJ7dVANgeyW5DQN2ackRyYHYz3f71g=)
---
Peter, It’s Becca! **Apparently, I caused a bit of a stir yesterday when I weighed in on Pete Hegseth’s latest fixation of turning the Pentagon into what he calls a “High-T Department of War,” complete with mandatory testosterone screenings for troops over 30.** **So when I was asked what I made of all this, I said exactly what was on my mind** : _“I think it is indicative of the fact that there are so many people in this administration that have some weird, intense, homoerotic, feelings towards men while also being incredibly homophobic, and not just homophobic, but like hate-mongering, fear-mongering about the LGBTQ community.”_ So, let me be clear here. I don't think the homoeroticism is the weird part. The weird part is that they pretend that that's not what it's about. And yes, I went on to compare Hegseth’s whole manly, manly, rugged, macho persona to Tom of Finland.🤭 **But underneath the absurdity is a serious question I'd like to hear your opinion on.**
* * *
**Do you agree that military service should be based on talent, experience, and commitment, not gender, race, or who fits Pete Hegseth’s preferred image?** | **[YES](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135475913/634339706/-1329107145?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YWRmNWIxNS0wZDgyLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yZTcHUsurGx0htJ7dVANgeyW5DQN2ackRyYHYz3f71g=)**
---
**[NO](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135475915/634339707/-1329107145?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YWRmNWIxNS0wZDgyLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yZTcHUsurGx0htJ7dVANgeyW5DQN2ackRyYHYz3f71g=)**
---
* * *
**Look, I am a lesbian. I have been around long enough to recognize homoeroticism when I see it, and I have absolutely no problem with it.**
The problem is building an entire political movement around worshipping hypermasculinity while using LGBTQ people as a punching bag when it’s convenient.
This administration is removing transgender Americans from military service and restricting their access to gender-affirming care.

trinaforcongress.com [trinaforcongress.com]
Team,
It’s been a tough week for everyone impacted by the devastating wildfires burning.
My heart is with the families who have been evacuated, those worried about their homes, the businesses forced to close, and everyone living with days of smoke-filled skies and hazardous air. I’m especially grateful to the MN and U.S. Forest Service, Minnesota National Guard, local law enforcement and fire departments, the Tribal Nations, and heroes of all kinds on both sides of the border who are doing everything they can to contain these fires.
The Boundary Waters is a place that means so much to so many of us. It's where families make memories, where friendships grow around campfires, and where people come to find peace. Seeing these places threatened is heartbreaking.
In moments like this, though, Minnesota does what it always does. We show up for one another.
If you’re able, I hope you’ll consider - supporting the relief efforts. United Way of Northeastern Minnesota is partnering with the American Red Cross, St. Louis County, and Ely Community Response to distribute assistance.
You can donate here: https://www.unitedwaynemn.org/firehelp [https://www.unitedwaynemn.org/firehelp]
The road ahead will be long. There will be homes, businesses, trails, campgrounds, and communities that need help rebuilding. There will also be neighbors carrying the emotional weight of what they've experienced. They'll need us long after the smoke clears.
Today, I'm asking you to join me in supporting these relief efforts. [https://www.unitedwaynemn.org/firehelp]
Thank you for caring, for helping if you're able, and for continuing to look out for one another.
With gratitude,
Trina Swanson
