name: Office of U.S. Senator Angela Alsobrooks
subject: Senator Alsobrooks Newsletter -- July 17, 2026
body:
|

---
Dear friends and neighbors, This week, I was proud to vote to advance the bipartisan **Water Resources Development Act of 2026 (WRDA)** out of the Senate Environment and Public Works Committee. As Ranking Member of the Transportation and Infrastructure Subcommittee, I worked to ensure this legislation delivers meaningful investments that strengthen our infrastructure, protect our natural resources, and support communities across Maryland. Water touches every aspect of our daily lives--from the drinking water that reaches our homes, to the ports that drive our economy, to the Chesapeake Bay that defines our state's identity. That's why I fought to include provisions that address Maryland's unique needs and create lasting benefits for families, businesses, and local communities. Among the Maryland priorities secured in this legislation are:
* **Environmental Infrastructure Implementation** : Streamlines Army Corps environmental infrastructure projects by allowing local partners to lead design and construction while receiving federal reimbursement, reducing costs and accelerating improvements to Maryland's water infrastructure.
* **Potomac River Basin Water Supply Study** : Authorizes a study of long-term backup water supply options for Montgomery County, Prince George's County, Washington, D.C., and Northern Virginia. With many communities relying on the Potomac River for drinking water, this study will help prepare for emergencies such as chemical spills or infrastructure failures.
* **Assateague Island Shoreline Restoration** : Authorizes a study to extend federal participation in shoreline restoration efforts at Assateague Island, helping protect the island from accelerated erosion and storm-related damage.
* **Chesapeake Bay Oyster Recovery Program** : Increases the program's authorized funding from $120 million to $150 million, ensuring continued restoration of native oyster reefs that improve water quality, strengthen marine habitat, and support the Chesapeake Bay ecosystem.
* **C &O Canal Re-Watering Project**: Reduces Cumberland's local cost share from _35 percent to 10 percent_ , allowing work to resume on the historic C&O Canal terminus. The project will support downtown revitalization, tourism, economic development, and ongoing flood resilience efforts.
* **Mussel Restoration** : Expands the Chesapeake Bay Oyster Recovery Program to include mussel restoration, enabling Maryland to continue important efforts to restore native mussel populations and improve water quality.
* **Curtis Creek Navigation Channel** : Authorizes the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers to maintain the Curtis Creek Federal Navigation Channel at **27 feet** , ensuring continued access to the U.S. Coast Guard Yard in Baltimore. This supports national security while protecting more than **6,500 Maryland jobs** and nearly **$900 million in annual economic activity**.

This legislation reflects what can happen when we work across the aisle to invest in our communities and prepare for the future. I look forward to continuing to advocate for these priorities as the Water Resources Development Act moves through Congress and to delivering results that strengthen Maryland for generations to come. The bill text is available [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15404.19430011.6272590.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.epw.senate.gov%2fpublic%2f%3fa%3dFiles.Serve%26File_id%3d9CAC580C-538C-43B9-A5AE-0D526C318261&redir_log=698450750584577).

A section-by-section overview of the bill is available [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15404.19430011.6272590.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.epw.senate.gov%2fpublic%2f%3fa%3dFiles.Serve%26File_id%3d44B71549-2B3E-4380-8FCF-F5A003055BA2&redir_log=984835155678576). **Holding the Trump Administration Accountable** As a member of the U.S. Senate Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs, I had the opportunity to question Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Acting Director Russell Vought during the hearing "The CFPB Semi-Annual Report: A New Day at the CFPB Through Reform." I have been waiting for the opportunity to question Mr. Vought, also the director of OMB, to demand an explanation for his draconian actions to undermine our public institutions, politicize federal grant programs, and stall funding for the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).

You may recall that Russell Vought infamously said, "we want the bureaucrats to be traumatically affected when they wake up in the morning. We want them to not want to go to work because they are increasingly regarded as the villain."

When I asked him Thursday if the workers deserved to feel traumatized, [he attempted to gaslight me and the thousands of civil servants](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15404.19430011.6272590.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fx.com%2fSen_Alsobrooks%2fstatus%2f2077840597151343027%3fs%3d20&redir_log=690310375867360) who have been fired, harassed, and threatened by this Administration, but I held him to account.

You can watch my full questioning [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15404.19430011.6272590.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fyoutu.be%2fkk5uC7gUgGY&redir_log=646494789825188).

**Fighting Through Legislation **
It has been a busy couple of weeks here on Capitol Hill, and I continue to fight for legislation that will help Maryland families thrive. In addition to delivering for our residents through the Water Resources Development Act of 2026, which was a major focus in recent weeks, I worked on legislation ranging from a bill that protects reproductive health care to legislation requiring transparency regarding the luxury Qatari jet gifted to the President. These are the bills I cosponsored: The Water Resources Development Act of 2026: This biennial legislation authorizes flood risk management, navigation, and ecosystem restoration projects for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (Corps). WRDA 2026 also reauthorizes the Environmental Protection Agency's (EPA) drinking water and wastewater infrastructure programs, including the State Revolving Funds (SRFs). Luxury Jet Ethics and Transparency Act: This bill would bar President Trump from transferring the jet away from the U.S. Air Force to his personal control. The bill would also require an independent GAO review of the cost of the jet's retrofit and the potential conflicts of interest and national security impacts of the president accepting a $400 million plane from a foreign country. Strength In Diversity Act: This bill would create a grant program that offers support to school districts that are developing, implementing, or expanding local public school diversity initiatives. Grants could fund projects such as: studying segregation and developing policies to address continuing socioeconomic and racial isolation, revising public school boundaries and expanding equitable access to transportation in order to foster diversity, or recruiting qualified new teachers to improve teacher diversity. The bill authorizes such sums as may be necessary to implement the new grant program. Let Doctors Provide Reproductive Health Care Act: This bill would establish a federal right for licensed providers and those assisting them to provide abortion, contraception, in vitro fertilization, and other reproductive health care that is lawful where delivered, including care for patients from other states. It also appropriates $40 million for legal assistance grants and $40 million for provider security grants, prohibits federal funds from being used to pursue lawful providers, and prevents liability insurers from penalizing them. The Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia Act of 2026: This bill will hold major purchasers of Russian oil and gas accountable for supporting Russia's war in Ukraine. I joined 60 of my colleagues in introducing this legislation this week.

A resolution recognizing the 250th anniversary of the United States of America and reaffirming the commitment of the Senate to the Nation's founding ideals of liberty, equality, and opportunity for all immigrant communities in the United States.

A resolution recognizing June 2026 as "LGBTQ Pride Month."

A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services of the Department of Health and Human Services relating to "Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, HHS Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters for 2027; and Basic Health Program."

A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Department of Education relating to "Reimagining and Improving Student Education-Federal Student Loan Program Final Regulations." **In the Community **
I was honored to join Ebenezer AME for Scholarship Sunday and celebrate over 40 years of investing millions in scholarships for the next generation. I shared a message from Elijah's story: Don't Run. Stand on truth, trust God's direction, and lean into discomfort.
Congratulations to the 5th grade class at Patuxent Elementary School on your promotion to middle school! Seeing your excitement, determination, and potential filled me with hope for Maryland's future. Keep dreaming big, working hard, and believing in yourselves. Go Eagles!

What an exciting morning in Dundalk! Thank you to everyone who came out for the 92nd Annual Dundalk Independence Day Parade. As we celebrated the Fourth of July, it was an honor to be part of this cherished Maryland tradition and spend the morning with so many members of our community.

130 years of solidarity, courage, and fighting for working families is a legacy worth celebrating. I was honored to join International Association of Machinists & Aerospace Workers members and thank them for continuing the fight for better wages, safer workplaces, and stronger opportunities for workers across our country.

When I served as Prince George's County Executive, I believed our children couldn't wait for better schools. That's why I, along with former PGCPS CEO Dr. Monica Goldson and the county's delegation, worked to pass legislation in the Maryland General Assembly that made it possible to use a public-private partnership (P3) for school construction -- the first time this model had been used for a school construction project of this size. Last week, we broke ground on the new Springhill Lake Elementary. Through this approach, students will see 14 new P3 schools in just six years -- 18 new schools in total, including those built through traditional construction. Every child deserves a safe, modern school where they can learn, grow, and thrive.

**Small and Disadvantaged Business Virtual Town Hall
** I'd like to invite our small business community to join me, Senator Chris Van Hollen, Congressman Glenn Ivey (D-Md.-04), and other select experts for a virtual town hall discussion specifically for small and disadvantaged businesses in Maryland looking to discuss the Small Business Administration's 8(a) Business Development Program, the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) program, additional information for DBEs (Disadvantaged Business Enterprise) and ACDBEs (Airport Concession Disadvantaged Business Enterprise), and to hear more about the ways my colleagues and I continue to fight for small businesses in Maryland to get ahead.
To register for the virtual town hall, click [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15404.19430011.6272590.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fdocs.google.com%2fforms%2fd%2fe%2f1FAIpQLSfmt3yvww7gHj0i6iHnyjwAjufqtUIHw86IF3NwgNidUYTWCg%2fviewform%3fpli%3d1&redir_log=068562094931711). **
** **Service Academy** Nominating Marylanders to the United States Service Academies is one of the greatest honors and responsibilities of U.S. Senators and Congresspersons. The U.S. Naval Academy, U.S. Military Academy at West Point, U.S. Air Force Academy, or the U.S. Merchant Marine Academy all require applicants to receive a nomination from their Member of Congress, Senator, or the Vice President.

My application for nomination to the Class of 2031 is now open until Monday, September 21, 2026. Eligibility information and the application itself can be found on my website at the link below.

[https://www.alsobrooks.senate.gov/services/academy-nominations/](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15404.19430011.6272590.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.alsobrooks.senate.gov%2fservices%2facademy-nominations%2f&redir_log=065285420972448) **Know Before You Go** The summer travel season is upon us and if you are planning to travel internationally, make sure you enroll in the State Department's Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP). This is a free service to allow U.S. citizens and nationals to register their trip abroad so the Department of State can accurately and quickly contact them in case of emergency. By enrolling in STEP, you will receive updates about health, weather, safety, and security for your destination, and you can use information from the local U.S. embassy to help plan your trip. This also helps the embassy or consulate contact you if there's an emergency like a natural disaster, civil unrest, or a family emergency.

Click [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15404.19430011.6272590.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2foutreach.senate.gov%2fiqextranet%2fiqClickTrk.aspx%3f%26cid%3dSenAlsobrooks%26crop%3d15677QQQ16580457QQQ5969621QQQ7124639%26report_id%3d%26redirect%3dhttps%253a%252f%252fmytravel.state.gov%252fs%252fstep%253fgad_source%253d1%2526gad_campaignid%253d21758807661%2526gbraid%253d0AAAAAqbBk5tE7eqSiBcXCv4TYEQOwrMDQ%2526gclid%253dEAIaIQobChMIss3a18z3kgMV7h9ECB0SmTh-EAAYASAAEgIy9PD_BwE%26redir_log%3d034687519171218&redir_log=216915669172449) to enroll in STEP. **Grant Spotlight **
I wanted to share a few grant opportunities for nonprofits, public, and private institutions that will go a long way to help Maryland families. _**[Department of Housing and Urban Development - FY 2026 Continuum of Care Competition and Youth Homelessness Demonstration Program Grants NOFO](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15404.19430011.6272590.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.grants.gov%2fsearch-results-detail%2f361999&redir_log=229394980747341)**_ funds programs to support the development and implementation of a coordinated community approach to preventing and ending youth homelessness and sharing that experience with and mobilizing communities around the country toward the same end. The population to be served by the demonstration program is youth ages 24 and younger who are experiencing homelessness, including unaccompanied and pregnant or parenting youth. 7000 awards are expected. (Posted June 1, 2026 - August 26, 2026 deadline) [_**Department of Justice - Office on Violence Against Women OVW Fiscal Year 2026 Grants to Improve the Criminal Justice Response to Domestic Violence, Dating Violence, Sexual Assault, and Stalking Program (ICJR Program)**_ ](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15404.19430011.6272590.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.grants.gov%2fsearch-results-detail%2f362686&redir_log=78659011018340)**[_Synopsis_ 1](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15404.19430011.6272590.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.grants.gov%2fsearch-results-detail%2f362686&redir_log=78659011018340) **assists Tribal, state, and local governments and courts to strengthen the criminal justice response to domestic/dating violence, sexual assault, and stalking by improving offender accountability, victim safety, homicide reduction, protection-order enforcement, and coordinated law enforcement and prosecutorial action. These sorts of activities treat these offenses as serious violations of criminal law and seek safety and autonomy for victims. (Posted June 4, 2026 - August 18, 2026 deadline)

_**[Department of Justice - Office on Violence Against Women OVW Fiscal Year 2026 Rural Domestic Violence, Dating Violence, Sexual Assault, and Stalking Grant Program (Rural Grant Program) Synopsis](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15404.19430011.6272590.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.grants.gov%2fsearch-results-detail%2f362636&redir_log=419594029077340)**_ 1 helps states and territories, Indian Tribes, local governments, and nonprofits to enhance safety and justice for child, youth, and adult victims in rural communities. It funds victim services (such as advocacy, legal assistance, and shelter), investigation, prosecution, adjudication, parole and probation, and other ways of addressing domestic and sexual violence. These grants are meant to encourage collaboration, establish and expand nonprofit victim services, increase safety and well-being for women and children in rural communities, and ensure victims in rural areas have access to sexual assault medical forensic exams. (Posted June 1, 2026 - July 24, 2026 deadline)

**[Department of Justice - Office on Violence Against Women OVW Fiscal Year 2026 Legal Assistance for Victims of Domestic Violence, Dating Violence, Stalking, and Sexual Assault Grant Program Synopsis 2](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15404.19430011.6272590.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.grants.gov%2fsearch-results-detail%2f362684&redir_log=636903460155340)** increases access to legal assistance for victims of domestic/dating violence, sexual assault, and stalking who are seeking relief in legal matters relating to or arising out of that abuse or violence. It funds projects that provide comprehensive legal assistance. The projects must include organizations that have a mission and history of providing direct services to victims of domestic/dating violence, sexual assault, or stalking. (Posted June 4, 2026 - July 31, 2026 deadline) **Stay in the Fight ** I know these are difficult times. But please know that I will continue fighting for you every step of the way. We will not give up. We will not give in to this Administration, and I ask that you continue to fight alongside us. Please continue to reach out to us. You can call the office or connect with us at [alsobrooks.senate.gov](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15404.19430011.6272590.7190525&report_id=&redirect=http%3a%2f%2falsobrooks.senate.gov%2f&redir_log=346519414955204). clean_body: | Dear friends and neighbors, This week, I was proud to vote to advance the bipartisan Water Resources Development Act of 2026 (WRDA) out of the Senate Environment and Public Works Committee. As Ranking Member of the Transportation and Infrastructure Subcommittee, I worked to ensure this legislation delivers meaningful investments that strengthen our infrastructure, protect our natural resources, and support communities across Maryland. Water touches every aspect of our daily lives--from the drinking water that reaches our homes, to the ports that drive our economy, to the Chesapeake Bay that defines our state's identity. That's why I fought to include provisions that address Maryland's unique needs and create lasting benefits for families, businesses, and local communities. Among the Maryland priorities secured in this legislation are: Environmental Infrastructure Implementation : Streamlines Army Corps environmental infrastructure projects by allowing local partners to lead design and construction while receiving federal reimbursement, reducing costs and accelerating improvements to Maryland's water infrastructure. Potomac River Basin Water Supply Study : Authorizes a study of long-term backup water supply options for Montgomery County, Prince George's County, Washington, D.C., and Northern Virginia. With many communities relying on the Potomac River for drinking water, this study will help prepare for emergencies such as chemical spills or infrastructure failures. Assateague Island Shoreline Restoration : Authorizes a study to extend federal participation in shoreline restoration efforts at Assateague Island, helping protect the island from accelerated erosion and storm-related damage. Chesapeake Bay Oyster Recovery Program : Increases the program's authorized funding from $120 million to $150 million, ensuring continued restoration of native oyster reefs that improve water quality, strengthen marine habitat, and support the Chesapeake Bay ecosystem. C &O Canal Re-Watering Project: Reduces Cumberland's local cost share from 35 percent to 10 percent , allowing work to resume on the historic C&O Canal terminus. The project will support downtown revitalization, tourism, economic development, and ongoing flood resilience efforts. Mussel Restoration : Expands the Chesapeake Bay Oyster Recovery Program to include mussel restoration, enabling Maryland to continue important efforts to restore native mussel populations and improve water quality. Curtis Creek Navigation Channel : Authorizes the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers to maintain the Curtis Creek Federal Navigation Channel at 27 feet , ensuring continued access to the U.S. Coast Guard Yard in Baltimore. This supports national security while protecting more than 6,500 Maryland jobs and nearly $900 million in annual economic activity. This legislation reflects what can happen when we work across the aisle to invest in our communities and prepare for the future. I look forward to continuing to advocate for these priorities as the Water Resources Development Act moves through Congress and to delivering results that strengthen Maryland for generations to come. The bill text is available . A section-by-section overview of the bill is available . Holding the Trump Administration Accountable As a member of the U.S. Senate Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs, I had the opportunity to question Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Acting Director Russell Vought during the hearing "The CFPB Semi-Annual Report: A New Day at the CFPB Through Reform." I have been waiting for the opportunity to question Mr. Vought, also the director of OMB, to demand an explanation for his draconian actions to undermine our public institutions, politicize federal grant programs, and stall funding for the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). You may recall that Russell Vought infamously said, "we want the bureaucrats to be traumatically affected when they wake up in the morning. We want them to not want to go to work because they are increasingly regarded as the villain." When I asked him Thursday if the workers deserved to feel traumatized, who have been fired, harassed, and threatened by this Administration, but I held him to account. You can watch my full questioning . Fighting Through Legislation It has been a busy couple of weeks here on Capitol Hill, and I continue to fight for legislation that will help Maryland families thrive. In addition to delivering for our residents through the Water Resources Development Act of 2026, which was a major focus in recent weeks, I worked on legislation ranging from a bill that protects reproductive health care to legislation requiring transparency regarding the luxury Qatari jet gifted to the President. These are the bills I cosponsored: The Water Resources Development Act of 2026: This biennial legislation authorizes flood risk management, navigation, and ecosystem restoration projects for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (Corps). WRDA 2026 also reauthorizes the Environmental Protection Agency's (EPA) drinking water and wastewater infrastructure programs, including the State Revolving Funds (SRFs). Luxury Jet Ethics and Transparency Act: This bill would bar President Trump from transferring the jet away from the U.S. Air Force to his personal control. The bill would also require an independent GAO review of the cost of the jet's retrofit and the potential conflicts of interest and national security impacts of the president accepting a $400 million plane from a foreign country. Strength In Diversity Act: This bill would create a grant program that offers support to school districts that are developing, implementing, or expanding local public school diversity initiatives. Grants could fund projects such as: studying segregation and developing policies to address continuing socioeconomic and racial isolation, revising public school boundaries and expanding equitable access to transportation in order to foster diversity, or recruiting qualified new teachers to improve teacher diversity. The bill authorizes such sums as may be necessary to implement the new grant program. Let Doctors Provide Reproductive Health Care Act: This bill would establish a federal right for licensed providers and those assisting them to provide abortion, contraception, in vitro fertilization, and other reproductive health care that is lawful where delivered, including care for patients from other states. It also appropriates $40 million for legal assistance grants and $40 million for provider security grants, prohibits federal funds from being used to pursue lawful providers, and prevents liability insurers from penalizing them. The Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia Act of 2026: This bill will hold major purchasers of Russian oil and gas accountable for supporting Russia's war in Ukraine. I joined 60 of my colleagues in introducing this legislation this week. A resolution recognizing the 250th anniversary of the United States of America and reaffirming the commitment of the Senate to the Nation's founding ideals of liberty, equality, and opportunity for all immigrant communities in the United States. A resolution recognizing June 2026 as "LGBTQ Pride Month." A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services of the Department of Health and Human Services relating to "Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, HHS Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters for 2027; and Basic Health Program." A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Department of Education relating to "Reimagining and Improving Student Education-Federal Student Loan Program Final Regulations." In the Community I was honored to join Ebenezer AME for Scholarship Sunday and celebrate over 40 years of investing millions in scholarships for the next generation. I shared a message from Elijah's story: Don't Run. Stand on truth, trust God's direction, and lean into discomfort. Congratulations to the 5th grade class at Patuxent Elementary School on your promotion to middle school! Seeing your excitement, determination, and potential filled me with hope for Maryland's future. Keep dreaming big, working hard, and believing in yourselves. Go Eagles! What an exciting morning in Dundalk! Thank you to everyone who came out for the 92nd Annual Dundalk Independence Day Parade. As we celebrated the Fourth of July, it was an honor to be part of this cherished Maryland tradition and spend the morning with so many members of our community. 130 years of solidarity, courage, and fighting for working families is a legacy worth celebrating. I was honored to join International Association of Machinists & Aerospace Workers members and thank them for continuing the fight for better wages, safer workplaces, and stronger opportunities for workers across our country. When I served as Prince George's County Executive, I believed our children couldn't wait for better schools. That's why I, along with former PGCPS CEO Dr. Monica Goldson and the county's delegation, worked to pass legislation in the Maryland General Assembly that made it possible to use a public-private partnership (P3) for school construction -- the first time this model had been used for a school construction project of this size. Last week, we broke ground on the new Springhill Lake Elementary. Through this approach, students will see 14 new P3 schools in just six years -- 18 new schools in total, including those built through traditional construction. Every child deserves a safe, modern school where they can learn, grow, and thrive. Small and Disadvantaged Business Virtual Town Hall I'd like to invite our small business community to join me, Senator Chris Van Hollen, Congressman Glenn Ivey (D-Md.-04), and other select experts for a virtual town hall discussion specifically for small and disadvantaged businesses in Maryland looking to discuss the Small Business Administration's 8(a) Business Development Program, the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) program, additional information for DBEs (Disadvantaged Business Enterprise) and ACDBEs (Airport Concession Disadvantaged Business Enterprise), and to hear more about the ways my colleagues and I continue to fight for small businesses in Maryland to get ahead. To register for the virtual town hall, click . The U.S. Naval Academy, U.S. Military Academy at West Point, U.S. Air Force Academy, or the U.S. Merchant Marine Academy all require applicants to receive a nomination from their Member of Congress, Senator, or the Vice President. My application for nomination to the Class of 2031 is now open until Monday, September 21, 2026. Eligibility information and the application itself can be found on my website at the link below. This is a free service to allow U.S. citizens and nationals to register their trip abroad so the Department of State can accurately and quickly contact them in case of emergency. https://www.everyaction.com/ [https://www.everyaction.com/]
Peter,
I’m writing this after stopping yesterday at Upper St. Croix Lake near Solon Springs, where like much of the last two days, the smoke was sitting so heavy we could smell it on our clothes and our eyes were burning. And if you were outside in northern Minnesota, Wisconsin, or Michigan this week your eyes were probably burning too. All that smoke is coming our way from massive fires in Ontario, and in the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness, which the U.S. Forest Service just closed.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/fred-clark-email?refcode=7172026 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/fred-clark-email?refcode=7172026]
Yesterday our current Congressman, Tom Tiffany, blamed these fires on “fuel buildup in overgrown forests” and claimed forest management has been “sidelined by green lobby policies.” The land that’s burning right now isn’t locked up or overgrown.
As a forester, I can tell you we cannot log our way out of the growing problem of larger, more intense wildfires. The real issue is a warming, drying climate creating longer, more dangerous fire seasons, at the same time Tiffany is cheering on budget cuts and a reorganization at the Forest Service that would eliminate key programs and staff and weaken our ability to respond.
What we’ve all experienced from these fires this week is just one example of why we so badly need new leadership in Washington. I want to ask you to pitch in 25, or whatever you can afford today, to help send a Congressman to Washington who understands what’s happening to our forests and our climate and will invest in the people fighting these fires instead of cutting them.
Chip in now → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/fred-clark-email?refcode=7172026]
It’s worth asking why Tom Tiffany would rather talk about logging than climate. His campaign has taken thousands of dollars from fossil fuel and extractive‐industry PACs, and he backed a budget that stripped funding from programs that reduce wildfire fuel and protect old‐growth forests while pushing for more commercial logging with no new resources to manage it. He’s not short on rhetoric about forest management. But he’s very short on providing the resources needed to actually get that work done.
If there’s one thing we can be certain of, it’s that with a changing climate, we are going to see more extreme heat, fires, and floods in the years ahead. And we need to make the investments today to reduce those risks and respond to those events.
Wisconsinites deserve a Congressman who believes scientists, tells the truth about our air, water, and land, and isn’t beholden to fossil fuel lobbyists. If you can make a grassroots contribution to our campaign now, we’ll put it straight to work building a people‐powered campaign across all 26 counties that fights for the forests and communities we love.
Chip in now → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/fred-clark-email?refcode=7172026]
Take care of yourself in this smoke, look out for your neighbors, and thank you for being in this with us.

name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: Donald Trump just attacked Michigan
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOCELYN BENSON FOR GOVERNOR]
body:
[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
Last night, Donald Trump undermined our
democracy on live television.

In a speech filled with false claims and dangerous rhetoric, Trump
directly attacked Michigan’s voting systems and spread lies about the
safety and security of our 2020 elections.

Don’t be fooled. This is all a ploy for
Donald Trump to rewrite history and make it look like he won in the 2020
election — because after six years, he still can’t move on.

I’ve seen what happens when Trump and right-wing media outlets
deliberately spread lies about our elections — six years ago, it ended
with my family and me sheltered in my home while armed protesters stormed
our lawn.

As Secretary of State, when our voting systems were under attack, I stood
my ground — not just because it’s the right thing to do, but because I
believe in defending the truth, defending our democracy, and defending the
right for every Michigander’s vote to be counted.

And with our democracy actively being attacked by the man in the White
House, it’s more important than ever that we have a governor that will

# DNC Coalitions Newsletter
---
| | This past Fourth of July, we celebrated 250 years of America. Since its inception, “generations of advocates have marched, protested, and sacrificed so that all Americans — regardless of race, gender, or background — can participate in our democracy. Democrats are proud to carry on this tradition as we fight for a freer, fairer, and more just America. We remain focused on restoring the American Dream, which has become out of reach for far too many families.” - [DNC Chair Ken Martin](https://us.list-manage.com/19amDw540O7?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)

Democrats believe in an American Dream attainable for everyone. As midterm elections approach, the stakes have never been higher. Let’s mobilize, protect our progress, and secure a future that works for all!
---
|
---
| **ELECTION HIGHLIGHTS** **Colorado**
* [Phil Weiser](https://us.list-manage.com/CjrzIJ_Pw9e?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Democratic primary for governor of Colorado.
* [John Hickenlooper](https://us.list-manage.com/KHcQSeyLjAN?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) clinched the Democratic nomination to run for another term as Colorado’s voice in the U.S. Senate. He will face Republican Mark Baisley in the November general election.

**District of Columbia**
* [Janeese Lewis George ](https://us.list-manage.com/VdCyDY6Ajfz?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)won the Democratic primary for mayor of Washington, DC.

**Georgia**
* [Adrienne White](https://us.list-manage.com/lz3FNNZpx6j?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the special election for Georgia State Senate District 7, further safeguarding the State Senate from a Republican supermajority.
* [Keisha Lance Bottoms](https://us.list-manage.com/sARYqvP9Vxh?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Democratic primary for governor of Georgia.

**Maryland**
* [Wes Moore](https://us.list-manage.com/5Xj3u01IU2H?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) secured the Democratic nomination to run for a second term as governor of Maryland.

**Nevada**
* [Aaron Ford](https://us.list-manage.com/169C6c4WcI0?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Democratic primary for Nevada governor. He will face Republican incumbent Joe Lombardo in November.

**New York**
* [Kathy Hochul](https://us.list-manage.com/pnNRuxjyaEi?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Democratic nomination for governor of New York.
* [Letitia James](https://us.list-manage.com/_QGQ_B_oSPm?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Democratic primary for attorney general of New York.

**South Carolina**
* [Dr. Annie Andrews](https://us.list-manage.com/TDNOUb5gwGm?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) won the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate in South Carolina.

In case you missed it, the DNC hosted a successful Stuff Costs Too Much Weekend of Action, during which Democrats across the country held more than 200 on-the-ground events, engaged thousands of volunteers, trained 150 new organizers, and had nearly 10,000 conversations with working families. Read more [here](https://us.list-manage.com/7mY7RsPkAxU?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e).
---
|
---
| **When We Count Fellow Spotlight**
---

---
|
---
| **Summer Balcony Series**

Our Balcony Series continues! Designed to foster community, celebrate diversity, and connect with key allies, this series has provided a vital space for collaboration as we head toward the midterms. From honoring LGBTQ+ leaders during Pride Month to highlighting the incredible work of youth organizers, these events have allowed us to network and strategize together. Stay tuned for our final series event before we officially kick off our get-out-the-vote efforts!
---
|
---
---
|
---
| **Know Your Rights Trainings**
Our "Know Your Rights" (KYR) trainings defend against voter suppression, misinformation, and intimidation. By equipping community members to navigate barriers, we ensure every voter can confidently and securely cast a ballot.

Since June, we’ve hosted hundreds of participants nationwide across diverse coalitions—including our Trans, Native, and AAPI partners—proving that knowing our rights strengthens our democracy.

Want to bring this vital work to your community? We are looking to partner with you. If you're interested in hosting a "Know Your Rights" training, please reach out to [coalitions@dnc.org.](mailto:coalitions@dnc.org)
---
|
---
---
|
---
| **Ongoing Opportunities**
---
|
---
|
---
| **Join Our Storyteller Network!**
We’re building a national network of storytellers whose lived experiences on housing, health care, food costs, jobs, and dignity help shape how Democrats communicate and organize. These voices will guide our work and strengthen our narrative heading into 2026 and 2028.
**WHAT TO EXPECT:** Storytellers may be featured in written content, digital videos, press opportunities, or events, and can participate in optional training. See the power of these stories in our recent features on [Stuff Costs Too Much Weekend of Action](https://us.list-manage.com/CDDVMhIeL7j?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) and [Immigrant Heritage Month](https://us.list-manage.com/u2VaKJWit0a?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e).
**SHARE YOUR STORY** : If you or someone you know has a story that reflects the challenges and resilience of America’s working people, please fill out the form: **[Storyteller Network Form](https://us.list-manage.com/faRQxtGwv8R?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e).**
---
|
---
| **Voter Protection & Registration**
Whether it’s protecting the vote in your community, organizing an event in your neighborhood, or making sure your voter registration is up-to-date, there are plenty of ways to get involved. Ready to take action?
* **Support Voter Protection Programs:** Be a part of the team ensuring the midterm elections are fair and free. Volunteer for voter protection programs across the country.

---
| [Volunteer Interest Form](https://us.list-manage.com/NWUUkPpmtit?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e "Volunteer Interest Form")
---
|
* **Host a Voter Registration Drive:** Hosting voter registration drives is one of the most powerful tools we have to grow the electorate and build long-term Democratic power. By connecting with our community and neighbors about the importance of voting, we build a stronger democracy.

---

Peter, it’s Beto.
Something powerful is happening in Texas right now.
**[Before I tell you more about the shift I see happening in Texas, will you donate $5 to Gina’s campaign for governor?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260717_2_beto.BXayic&refcode=em20260717-1593&amount=5&t=2&akid=1593%2E299639%2Ev1Uyph)**
For _years,_ we’ve been doing the hard work to flip Texas — a state where Republicans have always tried to make voting harder.
**We’ve registered voters, recruited candidates for every place on the ballot, and found ways to overcome the extreme voter suppression from the Republicans in power. And now, this race has the potential to capitalize on all of the hard work, all of the campaigns that have come before, to break through and win.**
Back in March, Gina won her Democratic primary, which sparked real energy across the state. From Amarillo to Brownsville, El Paso to Austin, she and other Democrats on the ballot helped generate turnout numbers we haven’t seen in decades.

subject: Join me in supporting Roy Cooper
body:
Winning this race is absolutely critical if we’re going to flip the Senate.
|

Hi, Peter – it’s Ken Burns.
Today, I’m asking you to make a donation to Roy Cooper’s campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina. Winning this race is absolutely critical if we’re going to flip the Senate, so I hope you’ll join me in supporting Roy. [**_Will you chip in $5?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk830&amount=5&t=9&akid=2229%2E124072%2EsEwiCY)
Across this country, people are hurting in ways that don’t always make the history books but shape lives all the same.
The grocery bills that are too high. A lifesaving prescription that forces a difficult choice. A paycheck that just doesn’t stretch as far as it once did. | These are the real pressures that define a moment.
**Roy Cooper has spent much of his life as a public servant working to ease those burdens.**
Not seeking attention but doing the work. Expanding access to affordable health care. Investing in public schools. Defending the idea that government, at its best, is not distant – but present, steady and accountable to the people it serves.
It is the kind of leadership that rarely makes noise, but over time, it leaves a mark.
Right now, there are those who want to take North Carolina – and our country – in a different direction. They see division as a strategy; they mistake power for purpose. They are organized. They are well-funded by dark-money and special interest groups.
**The only way we can defeat them is if dedicated, caring people like you choose not to sit back but to take part. The power rests in our hands, and we must use it.**
[**_Will you make a donation of $5 or any amount today to help Roy flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk830&amount=5&t=10&akid=2229%2E124072%2EsEwiCY)

Ken Burns

Peter, Last night, President Trump took over primetime television to talk about our democratically held elections. He called it "really big news." He said it was about whether America has "free and fair elections" at all. We already know where this is going. This president has made his disdain for us as voters clear since he refused to say whether he'd accept defeat to Hillary Clinton back in 2016, then convened a voting integrity commission that disbanded without finding any evidence of the fraud he claimed cost him the popular vote. This is the same president who called Georgia's secretary of state and pressured him to find enough votes to overturn his 2020 loss—a pressure campaign that led to his indictment. Multiple audits, including ones run by Republicans and Trump's own attorney general, found no significant fraud in that election. And he STILL hasn't stopped. Last night, he completely made up claims about election fraud, even while the White House released documents that explicitly say the opposite. He claimed our election protections are weak, but he just removed the remaining members of the bipartisan Election Assistance Commission and shut down the FBI’s foreign interference department. And earlier this year, his FBI agents raided election offices in Fulton County, Georgia, seizing 2020 election materials in an attempt to intimidate election officials. It's about what he's building toward in November. Every time he floats these claims unanswered, he's laying groundwork to try to steal the election, and if that doesn’t work, to challenge any results he doesn't like. [Cliff Schecter](https://open.substack.com/users/31941177-cliff-schecter?utm_source=mentions) and [David Shuster](https://open.substack.com/users/16891317-david-shuster?utm_source=mentions) sit down with Emmy-winning journalist and Navy veteran Ken Harbaugh from [The Ken Harbaugh Show](https://open.substack.com/users/277451069-the-ken-harbaugh-show?utm_source=mentions), whose latest dispatch for _**The Atlantic**_ pulls back the curtain on the best-kept secret of Ukraine's resistance: women operating alone behind enemy lines, turning a Russian soldier's flirtatious text into a map, and a map into a fireball. There is a Chechen commander who thought he was messaging a 35-year-old housewife. There is a target taken out mid-conversation. There is a bridge the Ukrainians left standing on purpose, a crown jewel called Crimea, and a long-range strike campaign now reaching places Moscow swore were untouchable. Harbaugh has been to the zero line to report it, and what he brought back is equal parts thriller and warning. We are not going to tell you how any of it ends.
Then the show takes a hard left turn. After the war room comes the confessional, and Cliff welcomes a guest who holds an office that outranks the entire U.S. Senate: [God](https://open.substack.com/users/191871255-god?utm_source=mentions). What follows is catharsis by way of gallows humor: abolishing the Senate, a certain photograph of a certain Kentucky senator, _Weekend at Bernie 's_, and a closing that somehow travels from a bunker in Berlin to Gandalf to the voting booth. It is funny until it is not, and it lands exactly where this whole moment lands--on the only question that matters, which is what each of us decides to do with the time we are given. You will want to see this one for yourself.

name: Dylan for Wisconsin
subject: Join Me at the Democratic State Treasurer Forum on July 21!
body:
I'm excited to invite you to one of the last opportunities to hear directly from both of the Democratic candidates for Wisconsin State Treasurer.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ddafe4de912f/c2y1sg9w12-10123210?e=f59034ca3e)

| | | | | | Hi Peter,

With the primary on August 11 right around the corner, I'm excited to invite you to one of the last opportunities to hear directly from both of the Democratic candidates for Wisconsin State Treasurer.
On **Tuesday, July 21** , from **6:30 to 8:00 PM** , I'll be participating in the State Treasurer Forum hosted by the Young Democrats of Wisconsin, the 3rd Congressional District Democrats, and the La Crosse Dems.
The forum will take place in La Crosse and will also be available by Zoom and livestreamed on Facebook, making it easy to join from anywhere in Wisconsin!
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/cNzRXJ4qDzw?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| |

I would love for you to attend or watch online as I share my vision for bringing transparency, accountability, and accessibility to the Treasurer's Office while Public Power for the Public Good. Please share this invitation with anyone else who may be interested in joining.

| |

[Please also consider contributing to help us finish this campaign strong. Every dollar helps us travel the state, connect with voters, and build the grassroots campaign we need to win on August 11.](https://us.list-manage.com/iX4qx4rg0s7?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
Thank you for your support, and I hope to see you there!
Sincerely,Dylan

Thank you for your consideration of our sponsors.
The Just The Truth Team [](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_Iak_A3vE3uVASREtIbJ4_yqLLZzWvy-c8Fh4nEfe1aNW00U0eEf3ZdmRcfUdNLTvpTOlvfpx4yiyInjMyrgzgUU1-ZBmvb6jlTZ1Hqb6eYV3_8fGmGRn3iaJHkW1pef7taIPgQBn1ZqO8Awdj-qHcSEc1akl67V5tc6NoRY0MF3IRtQv_VsjVqVXrF5eV2hokw8I_T5Rm0W2OmfUa1rMBWWbxq1daF8bDwiBmETce2J3ZpZy72Z347weQK4sF9Rv17NJ5B58JPebedrexwwCFSHNIgrbbRczQwMbTrp6WAg8d2nUffYy2tULlBX8ZnCdA/4se/BmulM8r5TwOGe8FQmmy00w/h1/h001.Q21AqiKwlG8hZtg385zoYpnp5JSSlfKztl-smyAgbEk)Dear Friend,Imagine growing up in a country where owning a Bible is illegal.Where the name of Jesus is not spoken in public. Where choosing to follow Christ could cost you your family, your job, or your freedom. Where a missionary can't get a visa.For millions of people, this is not a hypothetical. It is everyday life.This summer, many of them are coming to the World Cup.They are coming to cheer for their national team and experience something larger than themselves. When they arrive in cities across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, they will step into something they never experienced before: a place where someone can walk up to them, hand them a Gospel of John in their language, and tell them about Jesus without anyone stopping it._This moment is what we are preparing for._ IMB teams will be on the ground in Fan Zones and near stadiums throughout the tournament. Trained volunteers will be ready to have conversations, distribute resources, and connect fans with digital discipleship tools in their language that they can take home, back to countries where that kind of follow-up would otherwise be impossible.For some of these fans, this will be the only time in their lives they are handed the gospel freely.We cannot show up unprepared.You can help us be ready by giving a gift today.Here is what your gift does:
* $25: 200 evangelism tracts placed directly into the hands of fans
* $50: 25 soccer patches for sparking evangelistic conversations
* $100: 100 Gospel of John booklets
* $250: Rents an English Club outreach location where fans can hear the gospel in a welcoming space

At the Paris Olympics and the Winter Olympics, this approach worked. Thousands of spiritual conversations occurred. Tens of thousands of New Testaments were distributed. People made commitments to Christ during conversations with our teams. People interested in the gospel connected with discipleship tools that followed them home to their own countries.The World Cup is far-reaching. The opportunity to connect with people who have never had access to hear the gospel is greater than anything we have seen at a single event.But only if we are there, fully funded and fully prepared.**Will you give today to ensure our teams are on the ground and ready for the World Cup?**[**Click here to give.**](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_Iak_A3vE3uVASREtIbJ4_yqLLZzWvy-c8Fh4nEfe1aNW00U0eEf3ZdmRcfUdNLTvpTOlvfpx4yiyInjMyrgzgUU1-ZBmvb6jlTZ1Hqb6eYV3_8fGmGRn3iaJHkW1pef7taIPgQBn1ZqO8Awdj-qHcSEc1akl67V5tc6NoRY0MF3IRtQv_VsjVqVXrF5eV2hokw8I_T5Rm0W2OmfUa1rMBWWbxq1daF8bDwiBmETce2J5UqnrE9uqT9H77gkgLI4Xq0MnpkAV1bkl4wywFtBVR3-ddij79uX6QQ1DGemthmCFZIRNBFoKv-mRYXKj70N1Q/4se/BmulM8r5TwOGe8FQmmy00w/h2/h001.-y2cGGl5uyL5TJXajDlvZD8J5vpi0lQ-wAfa1amh_uI) Grateful for you,

When they arrive in cities across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, they will step into something they never experienced before: a place where someone can walk up to them, hand them a Gospel of John in their language, and tell them about Jesus without anyone stopping it.This moment is what we are preparing for. IMB teams will be on the ground in Fan Zones and near stadiums throughout the tournament. Trained volunteers will be ready to have conversations, distribute resources, and connect fans with digital discipleship tools in their language that they can take home, back to countries where that kind of follow-up would otherwise be impossible.For some of these fans, this will be the only time in their lives they are handed the gospel freely.We cannot show up unprepared.You can help us be ready by giving a gift today.Here is what your gift does: $25: 200 evangelism tracts placed directly into the hands of fans $50: 25 soccer patches for sparking evangelistic conversations $100: 100 Gospel of John booklets $250: Rents an English Club outreach location where fans can hear the gospel in a welcoming space At the Paris Olympics and the Winter Olympics, this approach worked. Thousands of spiritual conversations occurred. Tens of thousands of New Testaments were distributed. People made commitments to Christ during conversations with our teams. People interested in the gospel connected with discipleship tools that followed them home to their own countries.The World Cup is far-reaching. The opportunity to connect with people who have never had access to hear the gospel is greater than anything we have seen at a single event.But only if we are there, fully funded and fully prepared.Will you give today to ensure our teams are on the ground and ready for the World Cup? ## From Quadruple Amputee to Track Star
Chase Merriweather just qualified for the Pennsylvania state track championships. That alone would be a milestone for any high school athlete, but Chase competes after losing all four limbs at age 3 after contracting what is believed to have been an aggressive strain of the flu that led to [septic shock](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuqzAUgOGnMVuiYxt8YPBwdSW2dO1ogX0cTmswMg5R3r5KX6HzL33D_3lzt4kTb_ePaSUb79HVmN1GzyNRrVRcLZP_roUf674sVGY-c8mPI7JToMwF8CLRhYnTy7VNsJFIkW7ISuxbLXsDfbNYDIje6GjmFoPuB4wBIA4UusF3epAN27cGKFEBaNVeNcDQdRjRoJ49RdECBa65XL8yb3WhmF75pHL1eW2SXWrdD6H_CTUKNZpp9u8g1HhyoPw_8S7UKAfdY9dJocam2LA_OSU-DIoW7uvE6deqf55wWvUTAAD__0ufcD0). Doctors told his parents the only way to save his life was to amputate his arms and legs. Chase had to relearn how to walk, then threw himself into sports, including swimming, soccer, and basketball, before finding his calling on the track at [Wissahickon High School](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDtu6zAQAE8jdTSWpCzaBYvXuPNrUwqUuJQ24S_82PDtA-cKqQcYDObjvtwNeYr7fxNQu90tzaUl4rN6bA3L0orZvlqhHvJxYFnpkUrq1dEiQMwMFONqsYb8a5lGqx2iQDmi5uoySX6Z4TIeer3ayVyVs2aVgnMAsQJsG3LkXIDkI-m3DRRXAkCK6SQBruezcmpWct3QDROgpZbK6TNRbAc6_0oPLKcthdHro7VcB_lvELdB3DKm7PGNBnFriJF9d2NLzx6ZCbk3RJZ7qR0rswVNYMmx0mOkuDOKrB3IsinGv0KmrTIugEtQfCza5id5T3VWwwR7MOR_C9qf1z20-AkAAP__xtGGPQ) in Montgomery County. His coach said his ability "surprises me more and more." This year has been his most successful season yet. He placed in a dual meet for the first time, competed at districts, and advanced to states. His next goal: a [gold medal at the Paralympics](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GOkfGNjgpXGxDl223RBMzg2fXYNY2ifj7J94vvOYWV1dXR-fPc3oCR96W37Cio4WmSmna8FMi1op5qhn8v5r5WPcQML_4nXI6CvGkpBqEtKKz0wwcz8m0syNEhbpF19m70d19kPc2OItqph77ru_IokX1MGTQ-E5r2YN6teyuN2k7q6TUyty0lI--t2QHq18eqTESZ64p3_4m3mpAimd6Y775tLbRhVr30uhfjRobNRJ4VFcAZfZwbRo1Qq7sIzZq_H_AnI89ooB1PyqiwBN5W8QOGeK57uyLKAEyFhHSRwQUlI5tFoGL8BAvXwKoYhYgIhMKH2BbrpZj3LCUNrt5_3CMXAbbGLmswPGbtf5Y8tuprwAAAP__8b6XLw) in 2028 or 2032. ## Recording Every WWII Veteran's Story
Rishi Sharma started interviewing World War II veterans at 18, driving around his Southern California neighborhood with a camera. Ten years later, the 28-year-old has [crisscrossed all 50 states](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuxCAURE-DOywM2JCCIo27TZsSsfhjfoLNClhbe_vIe4V0Iz1pRvO-b_bmMOG-frkNTFiDbSHbHc6aoDUothXnf1vB5_aIEcodj1zyswa0nPGJMkUHZReH6WVlt5gAwEF0YAalpRj0xHQXzRj4wEA658OktHeLkCLocdDBj1IH1aG52pgaFGdMcNkLxj7GUQU1KXH3EIhksGDLpf_JuLcIIb3yAaX3eeuSia09KhGfhM-Ez-d59v5erxcXJ3y-4hsg0gMaFLdXinuDciCcNMHq_IsWrBFpja5sjvC5K2Z5nJgS1kkRydbNYXoPtn-bOgz_CwAA__-W7IEg) and recorded more than 3,000 interviews. He says he has spent every day of the past decade on the mission. Rishi's parents immigrated to the United States from India. He has no military background. His project, [Remember WWII](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL_OnDAQxJ8GOp_MGjBf4SIN3Zc2JfKf9bGJsU_23iHePiKvkGY0o5HmJ82v7-3bUqL8_GkPNPEZN45ly3i2hMxYN67W_-FK7-O171gdfUot7xZpAwmzkFoMeguW0rWNfTAREVD1aAa9jGpYZrn0u3GAi5LBBY9-dH5wTn-5EKSehgmUDD2Ze03qQYOUCsaHkvJrmnTUs1bOY-xGiYG41MfvQpl3jOkqH6wPX44-mZ351Tr1o4O1g5XLmXeb0l3ekV5tR-QOVntcwr8rU-tgvZEdrFLfcjtYxIW2ipKCCMW_D8xM-SnOk0h8kLHa3ETjUgmbyDDrZZmgrya8TkqJ2qy7UT4PS__QPf_3oR8DfwMAAP__oGCL5w), is funded entirely by donations, and each recording is given to the veteran's family. "_My parents were given the opportunity to immigrate and raise a family because of veterans like these,_ " [he has said](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGS3CAQRL8GZagAacVeQOBE2Tl1qJqDQRobwdaApNq_d8n-hEs6etXd9X59Lp9AifL6E3Z0cY1Li2XJeNWErSEvjcH_aUzH_to25C86C5ejRlqMMpNUVmq7BKD0XsYuuIhocOjQafscB_2c1LPbHHqvbVSPOEU1DR_GjMaOGoL2PmgfoSN3tymrrVFqMGM_KPXxeNhoJzt8eYxiVBioFe5_F8ptw5je5UTufdm75LbWXlUMP4SZhZmv6-rbhpQDQa5HvqEeDmHme0WYWdk7HsLM_xkJOzJ5yLK-MIcqQQb0EFAy-sKB8iqvwinIC1gSyRMbMuQqaytMWGUsLOPRDka5YkaGRiVXYeaOXXhdlBLVyYpRrTtQ-ve6fVv36czfAAAA__9Tspig). "_It's a debt of love I'll spend my entire life trying to repay_." When Rishi began, roughly 700,000 WWII veterans were still alive. Today, only about [30,000 remain](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGynDAQBNDTQDaUECyCgMDJZt-pQ0qgEcz_QqJGs6j29q71FXyAftXdf76WL0uB4v7bnjj73S_i0xKx5IAiyIuw3X6E6XVex4G80p04vbKnRSs9gDLQmsVZCu-lr93sETV2Nc6tGfuuHQc11sdsOuutmdbRD4_eTOu22tFP2m7OjuukXU3zR1OmNVqpTvdNp9T0eBhvBtOtG_qqV-hIEjffiaIc6MM73cjNls46zIfIlavuV6WflX6WUpo9JfeZEVFK4p8m8V7p5zu94g6njUBRkG_CkqFTSkFJHBwUy0AEN0qGDw-tgjdahovTN24CF2P-5OIOciAxZElMmCv9rHl2V6EQKA-m6tV-Wgr_-sl_H3vP-m8AAAD__9DPkxg). His most recent interview was with 100-year-old Marine veteran Nils Mockler, a combat intelligence scout whose first battle was Iwo Jima. When asked what it meant to see the American flag raised there, Nils said, "_The hair on my arms still stands up when I think about how beautiful it was_." "_For so long they have been the moral compass of our society_ ," Rishi said. "_Just the advice that they impart silently steers the ship of this country_."
## Donkeys Keep Spanish Park Fire-Free
Doñana National Park in southern Spain, one of Europe's most important protected wetlands, has not recorded a single wildfire in nine years, thanks in part to [18 rescued donkeys](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGK2zAURb_G3r2gSLZkL7woBDNQJhS6mKV5Yz3Zr1EkIykx7teX5Be6uYvL5cI5X5_TJ7LnsFzxToNb3FRcnALt2VMplKaScL6VxI_7tq6UvvkZU3xkx5MUUoMwcDaTRfbH1NR2cESSVE3D2XSNOndadPU6KCc60_RGzb1rpdR9h52bu1brWQvTzjUPrzdhzkYKoWRzUkL0bWuc0UZ9z-SqRpDlEtPpT-RQVnL-iE9Kpzneaz-spWy5Uj8qOVZy3Pf9lB8hHPl2_H0tKjkuMVp4cVVy1LIxlRx_b8gBhOohv3PkRI6XtXBY3sUlhhsdGT7wSfBBfiMLP4k2uETAgHDFwjGgh1-YbjAmIogOvthbx4kyuJjgSpj8AQgXmtFSnQa77ew9Z22qRix3ZP-GKP9t_znIfwEAAP__7LOa2A) with big appetites. Since around 2014, the nonprofit El Burrito Feliz releases the herd into hard-to-reach areas that fire crews and heavy equipment can't easily reach. Working up to seven hours a day from March through November, the donkeys graze on dry grass, shrubs, and scrub that become dangerous fuel during Spain's hot summers. Unlike cattle or sheep, donkeys can eat much tougher vegetation, making them especially effective at clearing fire-prone landscapes. The nonprofit calls them "herbivorous firefighters." The herd's unofficial leader, Galileo, was rescued in poor health as a young donkey and spent his first months recovering in a dog shelter, where he reportedly picked up a few canine habits. His caretakers say he [sniffs like a dog and has even tried to bark](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupSAURb8GOwyCilNQTGN3p53SHOUg510Eg6i5f__i-4XXr6zsvf6_phdQoLj-gw2NW91UXJoi3kfAUjBPJcPyLpnObfce80xXyuk8HE1SyJ4LzRs9WaDwmdrKGocoUVVoGj20qhl6MVTeaBwaBIWq6ztQEpfByQXaTlvZ9GKGisxjE7rRUggl21oJ8afrtNO9VvOCjrUCLZWU669EsXh04ZMuzPWStioYX8p-MPWXyZHJ8b7vGs-cnhsPwOT46JkcRcvk2HRMjscOFA9uU3zjhzvK6Gj1BfPBb5-4hwtj4QHLg0AEPp85cpcyB25xAYtVNna_KQQ6es1asW5A4WdP-XXIy8jvAAAA__9S9Yoo). Spain's Military Emergency Unit has visited the project and symbolically adopted one of the donkeys in recognition of its service.

Working up to seven hours a day from March through November, the donkeys graze on dry grass, shrubs, and scrub that become dangerous fuel during Spain's hot summers. Unlike cattle or sheep, donkeys can eat much tougher vegetation, making them especially effective at clearing fire-prone landscapes. The nonprofit calls them "herbivorous firefighters." Steve Scalise House Majority Leader

Fellow Conservative,

> In 2016, President Trump became the first Republican to win Michigan and Wisconsin since 1988.
>
> In 2024, he took Nevada for the Republican Party for the first time since George Bush in 2004.
He created a movement. He proved the DC insiders and political pundits wrong.

body:
| This is the Big Lie again — repackaged as "election security," and aimed this time at the election ahead of us, not the one behind.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9943%2E5257348%2EDlnF-E)
Derek, Five years ago, on January 6th, I evacuated the House floor — where I was a floor manager of the debate over certifying the election — while rioters beat down the Capitol doors. Later, as we sheltered in a secure room, a colleague found me and said something I would hear again and again in the weeks that followed: _"You warned that he would try to cheat again."_ I had. It didn't require any great clairvoyance, only a willingness to look at the evidence: a president who cheats in one election and pays no price will try to cheat in the next. That brings us to this week. Last night, Donald Trump stood in the East Room and told the American people that our voting systems can be "rigged and stolen." He demanded that Congress pass a bill he has claimed would "guarantee the midterms" for his party. He offered no credible evidence of fraud. He never does. _This is the Big Lie again — repackaged as "election security" and aimed this time at the election ahead of us, not the one behind._ Look at the record of the last month alone. Fired the commissioners who keep our elections secure. Gutted the agencies that guard against foreign interference. Suggested we shouldn't even have midterms at all. The question is no longer whether he will try to cheat again, because he is telling us that he will, on primetime television from the White House, and daring anyone to stop him. We have seen what happens when this president is not held to account, and Trump knows it too. But if Democrats win back the Senate, we can put a real check on his power. So he is already working to discredit an election he is afraid his party will lose. **[That’s what’s at stake. And that's why we cannot let him intimidate us, and why we cannot let him keep us from organizing to win. clean_body: | This is the Big Lie again — repackaged as "election security," and aimed this time at the election ahead of us, not the one behind. Derek, Five years ago, on January 6th, I evacuated the House floor — where I was a floor manager of the debate over certifying the election — while rioters beat down the Capitol doors. Later, as we sheltered in a secure room, a colleague found me and said something I would hear again and again in the weeks that followed: "You warned that he would try to cheat again." I had. It didn't require any great clairvoyance, only a willingness to look at the evidence: a president who cheats in one election and pays no price will try to cheat in the next. That brings us to this week. Last night, Donald Trump stood in the East Room and told the American people that our voting systems can be "rigged and stolen." He demanded that Congress pass a bill he has claimed would "guarantee the midterms" for his party. He offered no credible evidence of fraud. He never does. This is the Big Lie again — repackaged as "election security" and aimed this time at the election ahead of us, not the one behind. Look at the record of the last month alone. Fired the commissioners who keep our elections secure. Gutted the agencies that guard against foreign interference. Suggested we shouldn't even have midterms at all. The question is no longer whether he will try to cheat again, because he is telling us that he will, on primetime television from the White House, and daring anyone to stop him. We have seen what happens when this president is not held to account, and Trump knows it too. But if Democrats win back the Senate, we can put a real check on his power. So he is already working to discredit an election he is afraid his party will lose. That is exactly why I started Equal Opportunity Now.
We need leaders in office who will stand up for immigrant families and for every community that Trump has decided to make an enemy.
Those leaders exist. They are running for office right now. They need our support.

# Anthropic begs Meta for a compute life raft after Musk Colossus hookup
Anthropic's crawling to Zuck for a fat $10B compute lease just weeks after latching onto SpaceX's Colossus cluster. These AI labs are starving for Nvidia iron while Meta preps cloud muscle with ex-AWS talent and $145B capex war chest. Classic supply crunch power play exactly **[the resource grab I nailed in](https://substack.com/redirect/4f3e7538-8446-46a6-b1f0-12d99a049715?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** where they ditched safety theater for survival.
**• Winners?** Meta and NVDA kings printing as everyone leases their GPUs.
**• Losers?** Cash-burning labs without their own infra getting squeezed hard.
**• Next?** Frenzied bidding wars for every watt, accelerating hyperscaler monetization.
Smart money sees this as validation of my earlier Anthropic piece where they flip from rules to resource grabs. The real winners hoard the electrons. Load the compute plays, juniors--this arms race is just igniting and valuations will follow the power bills sky high.

### [How do they explain this?](https://substack.com/redirect/5f05ef8a-96d8-48d8-a30a-c4ab9eb3c8ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5f05ef8a-96d8-48d8-a30a-c4ab9eb3c8ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The evidence for ancient Egyptian aliens is bizarre and impossible to explain. Historical legends of "Gods" that came from the sky on flying discs... The Temple of Seti hieroglyph from 1239 BC showing a helicopter, submarine, and airplane...
## _3,000 years before they were invented._
**Pyramids made of 2.3 million blocks that weigh up to 100 tons each ...Perfectly constructed without the use of modern tools or technology.**
* There's a good reason some people say ancient Egypt was visited by an advanced alien culture. But for those who laugh at the idea, **[how do they explain this](https://substack.com/redirect/5f05ef8a-96d8-48d8-a30a-c4ab9eb3c8ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**?
* A discovery found half-buried in the sand inside King Tut's tomb. Written into papyrus scrolls as the legendary... "Cure for Every Disease Except Death."
* But when modern scientists tested it against cancer, diabetes, heart disease, arthritis, COPD, pain, Parkinson's, and liver disease...

**[>>They could not believe their eyes. [Click to see]<<](https://substack.com/redirect/5f05ef8a-96d8-48d8-a30a-c4ab9eb3c8ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
P.S. On November 4, 1922, in Egypt's Valley of the Kings, archaeologist Howard Davis discovered a stone door stamped with the image of Anubis, the dog-headed God of Embalming. **[What appeared behind that door could change your life - see it here now.](https://substack.com/redirect/5f05ef8a-96d8-48d8-a30a-c4ab9eb3c8ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

# Iraq-Syria pipeline deal carves escape hatch from Iran Hormuz hell
Iraq's oil output halved to 1.9M bpd in the Iran war chaos, Basra bottlenecked. Now signing to revive 700k bpd Kirkuk-to-Mediterranean line damaged in '03\. Gulf states piling on bypasses. Geopolitics meets black gold reality.
**• Winners?** Iraq production ramp, Syria, pipeline constructors, diversified oil exporters.
**• Losers?** Iran strategic leverage, pure Hormuz-dependent tankers and insurers.
**• Next?** More Red Sea/Fujairah builds, oil prices find floor as hedges bite, but Iran missiles keep volatility hot.
Brutal reminder people, war destroys flows but markets route around. Energy independence plays get the edge here. Position for the bypass winners before the next flare-up spikes crude and crushes the weak hands who bet on the chokepoint.

# SpaceX shares get hammered retail and The Street fight back hard on the dip
SpaceX crashing 9% below IPO $135 to $122, 44% off highs, options heavy on puts but bulls selling OTM and loading. Banks underwater too after extra $11B raise. This is what I meant when I said **["If there's any post-pop pullback, you buy it aggressively"](https://substack.com/redirect/aedbbcfb-16e2-4bc3-8a8d-5349560cc8c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **and**["if the frenzy flips to panic selling by weak hands. That's when the real players reload for cheap and wait for the next pop!"](https://substack.com/redirect/4ff76ea4-a6d5-4427-9bfe-b2400dd7514b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **This would be that pull back moment! You can get this stuff now for less than IPO day! Weak hands puke, believers buy.
**• Winners?** Dip-buying Musk missionaries and value vultures grabbing at $120.
**• Losers?** Panic retail calls holders and flippers who chased the top.
**• Next?** Consolidation phase, then catalyst-fueled rebound as Starlink/rockets deliver, trillion+ still in play.
These crybabies calling it failure missed the mission. As in my pieces, this beast consolidates then launches. Buy every dip like Kaufman, it's going to $300+ and the shorts get vaporized when the next Starship flight sticks the landing.

# Apples trade secrets hammer smashes OpenAI IPO right on schedule
Apple is dropping bombs on OpenAI for poaching 400+ staff including a hardware chief, and the trade secrets theft suit. Timing is brutal for Altman's IPO plans. Apple's fortress defense is talent and hardware. OpenAI started a war before they IPO'd. Ooops.
**• Winners?** Apple locking its AI moat and talent edge.
**• Losers?** OpenAI valuation haircut, delayed IPO, hardware ambitions stalled.
**• Next?** Likely settlement or drawn fight that boosts Apple's own silicon push while scaring investors off OpenAI hype.
This is war for the future stack. Protect the crown jewels, OpenAI gets the reality check. Apple longs stay fat and the copycats who thought talent raids were free get the bill. Load AAPL on this dip; the moat just got deeper.

# A Crisis of Belief in Democracy
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

[](https://us.list-manage.com/v3DHuD3zC8p?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)

I recently posted a [meditation](https://us.list-manage.com/8RMaAcz_eQv?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) on the death of Lindsey Graham. The general consensus on Graham is that he’s a cautionary tale. He knew everything that was wrong with Donald Trump and his policies, he warned us against him—and then he joined Trump and flattered him and protected him, just to stay connected to someone with power. One of his colleagues posted a recollection in which he talked about how Graham “just loved being a senator.” Well, that’s the problem, isn’t it?
And where did it get him in the end? The same place we will all end up, sooner or later. And there’s a lesson there about how the pursuit of power is less important that what you can say about your own character and your legacy.
My wider conclusion is about the general crisis of belief in our democratic system. Maybe our system ought to be run by people who actually believe in it. And that’s why I’m running.
On a similar theme, see [my statement](https://us.list-manage.com/FDerRrvbchb?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) on my disturbing lack of scandals, in response to the case of another fellow named Graham, up in Maine. My sharpest comment is on the perverse incentives created by the media and some in the activist class.
“I realize that by the rules of American politics these days, this does not entitle me to any press coverage, or to any chorus of defenders who can rise up to make excuses for my transgressions. It means I don’t have the ‘rough edges’ that will cause political consultants to swoop down and build a slick campaign for me. And it won’t mobilize a bunch of clever pundits to tell everyone that being a jerk makes me seem ‘genuine’ and appeals to the common man—because that’s their idea, I guess, of what the average American voter wants these days....
“I’m betting voters want someone who actually believes in the American system and wants to restore it and defend it.
“And who knows, maybe we can get the press to finally pay a little bit of attention to that.”
The danger right now is the crisis in belief in liberal democracy and the American system—but this is also an opportunity to renew that belief and our dedication to it.

If you want to help renew that confidence in our founding principles, support my campaign.
Speaking of which, there is one specific thing you can do to get involved in our electoral system. I’m looking for supporters willing to do a little phone-banking in the final weeks of the primary. This means making calls to Fifth District democrats to make them aware of my campaign and get them out to the polls.
You don’t have to live in the district, so just reply to this e-mail, and I or one of my people will get you set up.

---
| [DONATE TO HELP ME GET THIS IMPORTANT MESSAGE OUT](https://us.list-manage.com/T1PBKy3j6ek?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)
---
| |

### Good Old-Fashioned Americanism

See a [questionnaire](https://us.list-manage.com/svC6UZmNJCQ?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) I completed for _Cardinal News_ , a fairly widely read political news site for Central and Southside Virginia. The questionnaire is all the better because apparently I was the only candidate to reply to it—and I thought my answers were pretty good.
Here’s my succinct case for the main problem the US faces right now.
“The US faces many problems right now—a war, rising cost of living, violations of civil rights, and so on. But they all have one cause: Donald Trump is asserting unlimited presidential power, going far beyond constitutional limits, and that's what is driving all the other problems.
“ Take the war in Iran, which he started without permission from Congress. If he had gone to Congress, they might haves asked about his strategy and whether he had one, and the costs of the war, and what could go wrong. It's clear by now he had no answers to those questions—and we're all paying the price at the gas pump and on the farms in the Fifth District.
“But the problem isn't just Trump, it's that congressmen like John McGuire are just rubber stamps. That's why I'm running. Congress has enormous power, and we need a member of Congress who will act like it and really represent the interests of people in this district instead of the interests of one guy at Mar-a-Lago.”
As we near the end of the primary, it’s time we start looking forward to the general election and the need to appeal to voters outside the Democratic Party. And that’s where I think this agenda has a unique power, because it’s not about fighting for a partisan or left-wing agenda. It’s about fighting for an _American_ agenda.
“I am not a traditional Democrat—15 to 20 years ago, I was active in the Tea Party movement in Charlottesville. I won't be down-the-line on every issue, which perhaps makes me a better fit for the Fifth District. Democrats here have a tendency to nominate candidates from the left-leaning Charlottesville area who have a hard time connecting with voters outside Albemarle County. I think I have an opportunity to change that, precisely _because_ I'm not a traditional Democrat.
“I signed up for the Democratic Party because of the ‘democracy’ part, and I think that's something that can unify people across the district. I don't view this as a partisan campaign, but as a campaign for good old-fashioned Americanism and restoring the constitutional balance of powers.”
If good old-fashioned Americanism sounds like a good idea to you, help me get that message out by[ donating with ActBlue](https://us.list-manage.com/GzVDTIROKJJ?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a). Even $100 or $200 can make a difference, especially in these crucial final weeks of the primary.

I think I have an opportunity to change that, precisely because I'm not a traditional Democrat. “I signed up for the Democratic Party because of the ‘democracy’ part, and I think that's something that can unify people across the district. I don't view this as a partisan campaign, but as a campaign for good old-fashioned Americanism and restoring the constitutional balance of powers.” If good old-fashioned Americanism sounds like a good idea to you, help me get that message out by.
